title: Controlling transport with structured long-range hopping
summary: The combined effects of disorder and long-range hopping play an important role in determining localization and transport in low-dimensional quantum systems. We study transport in a one-dimensional disordered chain with nearest-neighbor hopping supplemented by a long-range hopping term. The long-range coupling is characterized by site-dependent amplitudes that may be either uniform or random. We investigate the interplay between diagonal disorder and long-range hopping, characterizing the resulting transport efficiency. We find that nearest-neighbor hopping in the presence of uniform long-range hopping amplitudes strongly suppresses delocalization over a range of weak disorder. The disorder-enhanced transport regime, established in previous studies, can be understood here as the recovery of delocalization from this strongly suppressed regime. An analytical solution in the Anderson eigenstate basis reveals the microscopic origin of this behavior. In particular, we show that the low-disorder regime of strongly suppressed delocalization can be eliminated by introducing randomness into the long-range hopping amplitudes, providing an additional mechanism for enhancing transport and qualitatively changing the response of the system to disorder.

AI.tldr: 研究一维无序链中最近邻跃迁与长程跃迁共同作用下的输运效率，揭示均匀长程跃迁在弱无序下强烈抑制离域化，而长程跃迁振幅的随机化可消除该抑制并增强输运。
AI.motivation: 低维量子系统中无序与长程跃迁共同决定局域化和输运；需厘清对角无序与长程跃迁的相互作用及其对输运效率的影响。
AI.method: 构建一维无序链模型：最近邻跃迁加长程跃迁项，长程耦合振幅为位点依赖且可取均匀或随机；结合数值输运分析与安德森本征态基下的解析解。
AI.result: 均匀长程跃迁振幅与最近邻跃迁共同作用时，在一段弱无序区间强烈抑制离域化；既有“无序增强输运”可解释为从该抑制区恢复离域化。安德森本征态基解析解给出其微观起源；将随机性引入长程跃迁振幅可消除低无序强抑制区。
AI.conclusion: 长程跃迁振幅的均匀性可导致弱无序下的强抑制输运，而长程跃迁随机化提供了额外增强输运机制，并定性改变系统对无序的响应。

title: Dynamic Pseudogap Model: Analytic Results vs Monte Carlo Numerics
summary: Recently proposed dynamic pseudogap model analytical results for spectral density of an electron scattered by random time-dependent Gaussian field representing fluctuations with finite nesting vector ${\bf Q}$, characteristic oscillation frequency $\omega_0$ and damping $\gamma$, leading to pseudogap formation, are compared with exact numerical solution by Monte Carlo (MC) approach. We consider both commensurate (real) and incommensurate (complex) fluctuations, for a wide range of parameters of the model. Electron Green's function is approximated either by a double Poisson series with history-dependent Bogoliubov gaps or by exact static continued fraction solution. In the coherent regime double-series representation provides description of dynamic sideband formation in the spectral density. As coherence is progressively lost, the theory crosses over to the quasistatic fluctuating-gap regime described by the exact continued-fraction solution. The exact MC solution overcomes the limitations of analytic approach, such as neglect of Magnus-type corrections in commuting approximation, and establish the limits of analytic approach, as well as confirming the exactness of continued fraction solution in static limit. In general, analytic expressions demonstrate rather satisfactory agreement with exact MC numerics within their limits, confirming the overall qualitative physical picture of dynamic pseudogap formation.

AI.tldr: 该文将动态赝能隙模型中电子谱密度的解析结果与Monte Carlo精确数值解进行系统比较，检验解析近似的适用性并确认动态赝能隙形成的物理图像。
AI.motivation: 随机时变高斯场涨落具有有限嵌套矢量Q、特征振荡频率ω0和阻尼γ，可导致赝能隙形成；需要评估现有解析近似在相干到准静态不同区域的有效性。
AI.method: 考虑公度（实）与非公度（复）涨落及宽参数范围，电子Green函数分别采用含历史依赖Bogoliubov能隙的双Poisson级数近似和精确静态连分式解，并与Monte Carlo精确解对比。
AI.result: 相干区双级数可描述谱密度中的动态边带形成；随着相干性丧失，理论过渡到由精确连分式描述的准静态涨落能隙区。MC解揭示了解析方法忽略commuting近似中Magnus型修正等限制，并确认连分式解在静态极限下精确；解析表达式在其适用范围内与MC数值总体满意一致。
AI.conclusion: 解析框架能够定性确认动态赝能隙形成，但其有效性受commuting近似等限制；MC比较明确了适用范围并验证了静态连分式解的精确性。

title: Matter that learns what matters
summary: Can a material learn what deserves its attention? We show that it can in a model optical network, in which action outcomes train a persistent record in each link. The record biases whether a source is consulted and sets how strongly it changes a stored answer, so useful sources gain attention and influence without being identified in advance. The network's experience thus shapes the information available for its future learning. Resonant readouts make this learning fragile: reinforcement can carry a record past resonance, where it persists but its influence weakens. We derive bounds within which relevant signals guide the answer, irrelevant signals are rejected and stored answers remain open to revision. These bounds guide a learning rule that limits reinforcement as records form; in simulations, it acquires useful records and keeps them functional. When relevance changes, an obsolete record can block its own replacement. A local state that strengthens negative writing after unsuccessful actions releases obsolete records and completes the learning sequence more often. How a memory is read should decide how it is written.

AI.tldr: 在一个模型光学网络中，材料可通过动作结果训练各链路的持久记录，从而学会关注有用来源；但共振读出使学习脆弱，需要限幅强化和失败后的负写入来保持记录可用且可替换。
AI.motivation: 探索材料或网络能否在不预先识别信息来源的情况下，根据经验学习“该关注什么”，并理解共振读出下记录形成、读出与修订之间的约束。
AI.method: 构建模型光学网络，每条链路具有由动作结果训练的持久记录；该记录偏置是否咨询某来源，并设定其对存储答案的修改强度。作者推导相关信号引导答案、无关信号被拒绝且答案仍可修订的边界，并据此设计随记录形成而限制强化的学习规则；当动作失败时，用局部状态增强负写入以释放过时记录。
AI.result: 在推导边界内，相关信号可引导答案、无关信号被拒绝、存储答案保持可修订；模拟中网络获得有用记录并维持其功能。当相关性变化时，过时记录会阻碍自身替换；增强负写入可释放过时记录，并更常完成学习序列。
AI.conclusion: 记忆如何被读出应决定其如何被写入；共振读出带来的脆弱性要求学习规则限制强化并支持负写入，从而使经验塑造注意力而不破坏记录的可修订性。

title: Symmetry-driven in-situ physical adjoint computing beyond reciprocity
summary: Nonreciprocity enriches wave control and information processing through directional transport, yet challenges conventional in-situ physical adjoint optimization, which relies on reciprocity to acquire adjoint responses. Here we demonstrate symmetry-driven in-situ physical adjoint computing (Sym-iPAC) in nonreciprocal systems, which enables access to adjoint responses on the original hardware through three classes of transpose symmetry: local geometric permutations, complex gauge reweighting, and latent symmetry in effective port dynamics revealed by Schur reduction. Experiments with programmable nonreciprocal microwave networks validate these transpose relations and yield adjoint gradients, enabling closed-loop optimization. These results establish experimentally accessible transpose symmetry as a route to in-situ physical adjoint computing beyond reciprocity.

AI.tldr: 提出Sym-iPAC，在非互易系统中利用三类转置对称在原始硬件上获取伴随响应，实现闭环优化。
AI.motivation: 非互易性可实现定向传输并增强波控制与信息处理，但会破坏依赖互易性获取伴随响应的传统原位物理伴随优化。
AI.method: 利用局部几何置换、复规范重加权，以及由Schur约化揭示的有效端口动力学潜在对称这三类转置对称；在可编程非互易微波网络中实验验证转置关系并获取伴随梯度。
AI.result: 实验验证了所提出的转置关系，成功获得伴随梯度并实现闭环优化。
AI.conclusion: 实验可及的转置对称为超越互易性的原位物理伴随计算提供了可行途径。

title: Precursor Ratio-Controlled Chloride Vacancies in Lead-Free KCuCl3-x Memristors for Forming-Free Gradual Resistive Switching and Neuromorphic Learning
summary: Defect engineering of memristive materials offers a powerful strategy for regulating ionic transport and analog resistive switching required for neuromorphic computing. Here, we report a wet chemical synthesis route for chloride-vacancy (VCl) engineering in lead-free all-inorganic KCuCl3-x thin films and establish a direct correlation between defect concentration, electronic structure, transport dynamics, and neuromorphic performance. Controlled precursor-ratio variation systematically tunes the VCl concentration in KCuCl3-x thin films, driving preferential vacancy formation at the terminal chloride sites, band-gap narrowing, and enhanced electronic disorder. W/KCuCl3-x/FTO memristors exhibit stable bipolar VCM-type resistive switching, with increasing VCl concentration promoting forming-free operation. An optimal VCl concentration (~ 1.3*10^21 cm^-3) provides a balance between ionic mobility and defect controllability, resulting in highly linear potentiation/depression characteristics and superior pulse endurance (>104 cycles). When the experimentally measured conductance characteristics of the optimized memristor are implemented as synaptic weights in artificial neural network simulations, recognition accuracies of 98.96% and 91.82% are achieved on the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets, respectively. These findings establish precursor ratio-controlled VCl engineering as an effective strategy for simultaneously optimizing ionic transport, analog switching, and neuromorphic learning in lead-free halide perovskite memristors, providing a general materials design principle for energy-efficient neuromorphic electronics.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过湿化学法在无铅全无机KCuCl3-x薄膜中调控氯空位浓度，建立缺陷浓度—电子结构—输运动力学—神经形态性能的关联，并实现高性能忆阻突触与神经网络识别。
AI.motivation: 忆阻材料的缺陷工程可调控离子输运和模拟阻变，从而满足神经形态计算对线性权重更新、低功耗和可靠性的需求；本文旨在开发无铅卤化物钙钛矿中的氯空位工程策略。
AI.method: 采用湿化学合成并通过前驱体比例系统调节KCuCl3-x薄膜的氯空位浓度，分析末端氯位点优先形成空位、带隙收窄和电子无序增强等效应；构建W/KCuCl3-x/FTO忆阻器，表征双极VCM型阻变、forming-free行为、 potentiation/depression线性及脉冲耐久性，并将优化器件的电导特性作为突触权重用于ANN仿真。
AI.result: 随着氯空位浓度增加，器件趋向forming-free；最优VCl浓度约1.3×10^21 cm^-3时兼顾离子迁移率与缺陷可控性，获得高线性增强/抑制特性和>10^4次脉冲耐久性；ANN仿真在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上分别达到98.96%和91.82%的识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: 前驱体比例控制的氯空位工程可同时优化无铅卤化物钙钛矿忆阻器的离子输运、模拟阻变和神经形态学习性能，为节能神经形态电子器件提供通用材料设计原则。

title: Orbital Hall response of spin-1 fermions with a curved central band
summary: We investigate the orbital Hall effect in a three-band system described by a low-energy Hamiltonian containing both linear and quadratic momentum-dependent contributions. The linear term lifts the degeneracy between the dispersive bands, providing a minimal setting to study orbital transport in a multiband system with a curved central band. Within a quantum kinetic approach, we derive the intrinsic orbital Hall response and analyze its microscopic origin in terms of interband coherence induced by an external electric field. We show that the orbital Hall conductivity arises from the interplay between the momentum-dependent orbital character of the eigenstates and transitions between different bands. The spin-1 structure provides a particularly transparent platform in which the contributions associated with different interband channels can be identified separately. We further show that the differential orbital Hall response provides a direct probe of the low-energy structure, exhibiting distinct scaling singularities associated with the linear and quadratic bands, respectively, while remaining independent of the ultraviolet cutoff. Our results establish a connection between the multiband quantum geometry of spin-1 fermions and their transverse orbital response, and provide a simple framework for investigating orbital transport beyond two-band models.

AI.tldr: 研究三带低能模型中同时含线性与二次动量项的自旋-1费米子体系的轨道霍尔效应，基于量子动理学方法揭示其由带间相干与能态轨道特征共同决定，并指出微分轨道霍尔响应可作为探测低能能带结构的直接探针。
AI.motivation: 突破通常以两带模型研究轨道输运的限制，建立一个最小但非平凡的三带自旋-1平台，以理解多带体系中弯曲中心带、线性项解除简并以及带间通道对横向轨道响应的贡献。
AI.method: 采用包含线性和二次动量贡献的三带低能哈密顿量，利用量子动理学方法推导内禀轨道霍尔响应，并从外电场诱导的带间相干角度分析其微观起源；利用自旋-1结构分离不同带间通道的贡献。
AI.result: 内禀轨道霍尔电导来自本征态随动量变化的轨道特征与不同带间跃迁的相互配合；自旋-1结构使各带间通道贡献可清晰区分；微分轨道霍尔响应直接反映低能结构，分别呈现与线性带和二次带相关的不同标度奇异性，并且不依赖紫外截断。
AI.conclusion: 工作建立了自旋-1费米子的多带量子几何与横向轨道响应之间的联系，提供了一个超越两带模型研究轨道输运的简洁框架。

title: Unified First-Principles Theory of Finite-Wave-Vector Photocurrents in Crystals
summary: Spatially structured light carries independent phase and envelope variations in addition to its polarization and frequency. We develop a first-principles theory of second-order dc photocurrents (especially shift and injection) that resolves how these optical degrees of freedom drive distinct dc responses in crystals. The second-order dc response couples two optical field components at the same frequency but with generally different wave vectors. Expanding the response to first order in these wave vectors identifies two rank-four material tensors: $\xi$, which couples to the optical phase gradient and contains the plane-wave photon-drag limit, and $\zeta$, which couples to the intensity gradient and describes a spatially varying dc current. Wannier-interpolated calculations for monolayer GeS show symmetry-allowed finite-wave-vector responses that survive at a centrosymmetric structure where conventional bulk photovoltaic effect vanishes. For a Gaussian beam with a uniform phase gradient, the phase-gradient contribution drives current in the same direction on both sides of the beam center, whereas the intensity-gradient contribution drives currents in opposite directions, showing that distinct photocurrent patterns can be selected through the wavefront and envelope of light. A multipolar analysis further resolves the optical corrections into electric-quadrupole, orbital magnetic-dipole, and band-dispersion contributions. Together, these results show how the spatial structure of light can serve as an independent control variable for nonlinear photocurrent generation and provide a first-principles route to predict this response in real materials.

AI.tldr: 建立了空间结构光驱动二阶直流光电流的第一性原理理论，用相位梯度张量ξ和强度梯度张量ζ区分并预测位移电流与注入电流等响应。
AI.motivation: 现有非线性光电流理论通常只考虑偏振与频率，尚未系统解析空间结构光中相位包络变化如何独立驱动晶体中的二阶直流响应。
AI.method: 将同频但波矢不同的两光场分量耦合的二阶直流响应按波矢一阶展开，定义两个四阶材料张量ξ（耦合光相位梯度，含平面波光子牵引极限）和ζ（耦合强度梯度，描述空间变化直流电流）；对单层GeS进行Wannier插值计算，并用高斯光束与多极分析分解光学修正。
AI.result: 单层GeS中对称性允许的有限波矢响应在常规体光伏效应消失的中心对称结构中仍可存在；均匀相位梯度高斯光束下，相位梯度项使光束中心两侧电流同向，而强度梯度项使两侧电流反向；多极分析将修正分解为电四极、轨道磁偶极和能带色散贡献。
AI.conclusion: 光的空间结构可作为非线性光电流产生的独立控制变量，该工作提供了在真实材料中第一性原理预测此类响应的途径。

title: Chern non-trivial two-dimensional square-net nodal line semimetal
summary: We investigate a two-dimensional $p_xp_y$ square-net tight-binding model with two sublattices and introduce a symmetry-informed, momentum-dependent spin-orbit coupling (SOC) with a finite-range real-space hopping representation. Its two components jointly gap the nodal line, while one breaks time-reversal symmetry, producing a Chern-insulating phase with an occupied band Chern number $C=2$. Nanoribbon calculations reveal edge-localized states traversing this gap, with two net chiral modes per edge. We further show that the conserved spin sectors are unitarily equivalent and therefore have equal Chern numbers, ruling out a nontrivial time-reversal-protected $\mathbb{Z}_2$ phase within this ansatz. Our results establish a phenomenological route to Chern topology in square-net two-dimensional systems and clarify the symmetry constraints governing the accessible insulating phases.

AI.tldr: 该文在双亚晶格二维 $p_xp_y$ 方网格紧束缚模型中引入对称性约束的动量依赖自旋轨道耦合（SOC），获得占据带陈数 $C=2$ 的陈绝缘相，并指出在该模型假设下不存在非平庸的时间反演保护 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 相。
AI.motivation: 研究方网格 $p_xp_y$ 体系中节点线如何被 SOC 打开能隙，以及对称性约束下可实现哪些拓扑绝缘相，尤其是陈拓扑与时间反演保护的 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 拓扑之间的关系。
AI.method: 构建双亚晶格 $p_xp_y$ 方网格紧束缚模型，引入具有有限程实空间跃迁表示的、对称性 informed 的动量依赖 SOC；通过能带陈数、纳米带边缘态以及守恒自旋扇区的幺正等价性分析拓扑性质。
AI.result: SOC 的两个分量共同打开节点线能隙，其中破坏时间反演对称性的分量产生占据带陈数 $C=2$ 的陈绝缘相；纳米带计算显示能隙中存在边缘局域态，每条边缘有两个净手性模式；守恒自旋扇区幺正等价且具有相同陈数，排除了该 ansatz 下非平庸的时间反演保护 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 相。
AI.conclusion: 结果为方网格二维体系提供了一条现象学上实现陈拓扑的路径，并澄清了决定可及绝缘相的对称性约束。

title: Dephasing-powered open quantum-dot battery
summary: We propose a simple realization of an open quantum battery powered by local dephasing. The setup consists of a triple-quantum-dot chain coupled at one end to a thermal reservoir, with the dot at the opposite end strongly detuned to form a high-energy storage element. Local dephasing populates this highly excited state and autonomously drives the system into a nonequilibrium steady state with high ergotropic efficiency. We find a limit where the ergotropic efficiency approaches unity, while the ergotropy itself approaches one-third of the energy detuning. We characterize the battery through its energy-storage performance, charging time, and stability, showing that the charged state remains long-lived after the dephasing source is switched off. We then demonstrate two complementary protocols for extracting the stored energy. First, nearly all the available ergotropy can be recovered through a simple cyclic unitary protocol involving only modulation of the detuned-dot gate. Second, coupling the detuned dot to an electronic load allows the extraction of electrochemical work exceeding the initial ergotropy, thereby accessing part of the battery's passive energy. Our results establish local dephasing as an autonomous resource for charging open quantum batteries and demonstrate simple routes for extracting the resulting stored energy in experimentally accessible mesoscopic platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由局域退相干自主充电的开放量子电池：三量子点链一端接热库，另一端强失谐量子点作为高能存储单元；局域退相干将系统驱动至高效非平衡稳态，并给出两种能量提取方案。
AI.motivation: 探索无需外部控制、可由开放量子系统环境效应自主充电的量子电池，并在可实验实现的介观平台中实现储能与做功。
AI.method: 构建三量子点链模型：一端耦合热库，另一端为强失谐高能存储量子点；利用局域退相干产生非平衡稳态，分析其能量存储、充电时间与稳定性，并设计循环幺正协议及耦合电子负载的提取协议。
AI.result: 在特定极限下，ergotropic效率趋近1，ergotropy趋近能量失谐的三分之一；退相干关闭后充电态仍长寿命。仅调制失谐量子点门可回收几乎全部ergotropy；耦合电子负载可提取超过初始ergotropy的电化学功，从而利用部分被动能量。
AI.conclusion: 局域退相干可作为开放量子电池的自主充电资源，且所提方案为在实验可及的介观体系中充电与提取能量提供了简单途径。

title: Zeptojoule Microwave Calorimetry with Nanosecond Recovery in Graphene
summary: Graphene calorimeters are predicted to combine extreme energy sensitivity with rapid thermal recovery, yet experiments remain far from ideal estimates. Here, we directly calibrate a graphene Josephson-junction microwave calorimeter using nanosecond pulses and independently determine the thermal parameters of the same operating device. At 110 mK, calibrated pulse measurements yield a characteristic switching-energy scale of 18.1 meV (2.90 zJ), while time-resolved two-pulse thermometry gives an intrinsic relaxation time of 19.5 ns. Pulse-width-dependent calorimetry and bolometric thermometry show that the electronic heat capacity is 12.4 times and the electron-phonon coupling is approximately 50 times larger than ideal estimates. A thermal model using these measured parameters predicts 21.2 meV, quantitatively reproducing the observed switching response. These results identify the microscopic origin of the sensitivity gap in graphene calorimeters and establish a self-consistent calibration framework for ultrafast nanoscale thermal detectors.

AI.tldr: 该文直接校准石墨烯约瑟夫森结微波量热计，并用独立热参数测量解释其灵敏度与理想预测之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯量热计理论上兼具极高能量灵敏度和快速热恢复，但实验性能远低于理想估计；作者旨在找出灵敏度差距的微观来源并建立自洽校准框架。
AI.method: 在110 mK下用纳秒脉冲直接校准器件，结合时间分辨双脉冲测温、脉冲宽度依赖量热与测辐射热计测温，独立提取电子热容、电子-声子耦合和本征弛豫时间，并用测得参数构建热模型预测开关响应。
AI.result: 校准得到特征开关能量尺度18.1 meV（2.90 zJ），本征弛豫时间19.5 ns；电子热容比理想估计大约12.4倍，电子-声子耦合约大50倍；基于实测参数的热模型预测21.2 meV，定量重现观测到的开关响应。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了石墨烯量热计灵敏度缺口的微观起源，即为电子热容和电子-声子耦合显著偏离理想值，并为超快纳米尺度热探测器提供了自洽的校准框架。

title: Second-Harmonic Bulk Response of Fractional Quantum Hall Fluids
summary: We develop a bulk description for the second-harmonic Hall response of fractional quantum Hall fluids with broken inversion and rotational symmetries, distinct from edge theories based on nonlinear edge-mode dispersion. By projecting a tilted massive Dirac model onto a single low-energy band, we construct a composite-boson Chern--Simons theory for the lowest Landau level that retains projection-induced nonlinear electromagnetic couplings. The nonlinear Hall resistivity vanishes in the dc limit, while its finite-frequency response retains the characteristic filling-factor dependence $\rho^{(2)}_{TLL}\propto\nu^{-2}$, where $\nu$ is the Landau-level filling factor. At low frequency, its real and imaginary parts scale as $(\omega/\omega_c)^2$ and $\omega/\omega_c$, respectively, where $\omega_c$ is the cyclotron frequency, and the response is strongly anisotropic with respect to the crystalline tilt axis. Notably, the Kohn-mode resonances present in the second-order conductivity cancel in the nonlinear Hall resistivity. These results establish finite-frequency nonlinear transport as a bulk probe of fractional quantum Hall fluids without requiring nonlinear edge-mode dispersion.

AI.tldr: 该文为破缺反演与旋转对称性的分数量子霍尔液体建立了二次谐波霍尔响应的体态描述，区别于依赖非线性边缘模式色散的边缘理论。
AI.motivation: 现有分数量子霍尔非线性响应常由边缘理论解释，需要判断有限频率非线性霍尔输运能否作为不依赖非线性边缘色散的体态探针。
AI.method: 将倾斜的大质量狄拉克模型投影到单一低能朗道能级，构建保留投影诱导非线性电磁耦合的最低朗道能级复合玻色子Chern–Simons理论，并计算二次谐波霍尔响应。
AI.result: 非线性霍尔电阻率在直流极限下消失；有限频率响应保持特征填充因子依赖 ρ_TLL^(2)∝ν^(-2)。低频下实部与虚部分别按(ω/ω_c)^2和ω/ω_c标度，且响应相对晶格倾斜轴强烈各向异性；二阶电导中的Kohn模式共振在非线性霍尔电阻率中相消。
AI.conclusion: 有限频率非线性输运可作为分数量子霍尔液体的体态探针，无需借助非线性边缘模式色散。

title: Perpendicular Anisotropy and g-Factor of Sputtered Ni Films on Si(111) Studied by Angle-Dependent Ferromagnetic Resonance
summary: Ni films with thicknesses of 312 and 1011\,\AA{} were grown on Si(111) by dc magnetron sputtering at room temperature and studied by atomic force microscopy, grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, magnetometry and angle-dependent ferromagnetic resonance. Both films are polycrystalline fcc Ni with smooth surfaces, a bulk-like (111) lattice spacing and a saturation magnetization of ${\approx}480$\,emu\,cm$^{-3}$, and both are magnetized in plane. The angular dependence of the resonance field, from the film plane to the film normal, is described by a uniaxial anisotropy model with first- and second-order terms. From this model, $g = 2.160\pm0.005$ and $2.101\pm0.014$ and effective perpendicular anisotropies of $(6.0\pm0.4)\times10^{5}$ and $(4.5\pm0.6)\times10^{5}$\,erg\,cm$^{-3}$ were obtained for the thinner and thicker film, respectively. The conventional analysis of only the in-plane and perpendicular resonances gives $g$-factors that are lower by 0.02--0.04. The perpendicular linewidths give upper limits for the Gilbert damping of $\alpha \le 0.030$ and $\le 0.038$.

AI.tldr: 通过角度依赖铁磁共振和单轴各向异性模型，研究了不同厚度Ni薄膜的g因子、垂直各向异性和Gilbert阻尼，并指出仅用面内与垂直共振的传统分析会低估g因子。
AI.motivation: 需要可靠测定Ni薄膜的磁各向异性、g因子和阻尼，并评估厚度及传统双方向FMR分析对参数提取的影响。
AI.method: 在室温下用直流磁控溅射在Si(111)上生长312和1011 Å的Ni膜，结合AFM、掠入射XRD、X射线反射率、磁强计和角度依赖铁磁共振；用含一阶和二阶项的单轴各向异性模型拟合从膜面到膜法线的共振场角度依赖。
AI.result: 两膜均为光滑多晶fcc Ni，具有近体相的(111)晶面间距和约480 emu cm^-3的饱和磁化强度，且易磁化在面内；得到g=2.160±0.005（薄膜）和2.101±0.014（厚膜），有效垂直各向异性分别为(6.0±0.4)×10^5和(4.5±0.6)×10^5 erg cm^-3；仅用面内和垂直共振的传统分析使g因子低0.02–0.04；垂直线宽给出Gilbert阻尼上限α≤0.030和≤0.038。
AI.conclusion: 完整的角度依赖FMR结合单轴各向异性模型能更准确地提取Ni薄膜的g因子和垂直各向异性；所研究的Ni膜具有厚度相关的有效垂直各向异性和较低的阻尼上限。

title: Emergent parafermions with tunable localization in a quantum circuit network
summary: \noindent Quantum circuit simulators with hybrid metal-semiconductor dots provide a versatile platform to realize Kondo anyons. These arise at critical points driven by frustrated Kondo screening of dot charge degrees of freedom and have been demonstrated experimentally in linear circuits of one or two dots. Here we study a triangular triple dot device, where geometric frustration gives rise to an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion shared among the three dots. We show that the parafermion can be tunably relocated to any pair of dots by applying gate voltages, and is supported in both the weak-tunneling `Kondo limit' and the strong transmission `quasiballistic' regime. The critical states survive strong coupling to external leads and other dots, establishing the basis for a scalable and reconfigurable network architecture in which non-Abelian excitations can be realized and manipulated.

AI.tldr: 研究三角三量子点器件中由几何阻挫诱导的涌现 Z3 仲费米子，并证明可通过栅压将其可调地移动到任意一对量子点，且在Kondo极限和准弹道区均存在。
AI.motivation: 混合金属-半导体量子点电路可模拟Kondo任意子，但此前仅在单点或双点线性电路中实现；需要探索三端/三角形结构以实现受几何阻挫保护的涌现非阿贝尔激发及可重构操控。
AI.method: 分析三角三量子点器件，其中三个点的电荷自由度发生阻挫Kondo屏蔽并在临界点产生共享的 Z3 仲费米子；通过栅压调节实现仲费米子在任意点对间的迁移，并考察弱隧穿Kondo极限与强透射准弹道区。
AI.result: 仲费米子可由栅压可调地局域到任意一对量子点，并在Kondo极限和准弹道区均得到支持；相应临界态在强耦合至外部引线及其他量子点时仍能存活。
AI.conclusion: 该三角三量子点平台建立了可扩展、可重构的网络架构基础，可用于实现和操控非阿贝尔激发。

title: Momentum-selective graphene spectroscopy of moir\'e excitons
summary: Far-field photoluminescence probes only the light-cone corner of an exciton's momentum content, whereas energy transfer to nearby graphene integrates in-plane momenta up to the inverse spacer thickness $1/z$. For a WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$ heterobilayer we build the transition polarization $\bm{P}_n(\qv)$ of each localized moir\'e exciton from the registry-dependent vector dipole texture and use each $\bm{P}_n$ for both baths. The two baths rank the states differently: the graphene-rate ratios differ from the optical ones, their ordering inverts with spacer thickness, and the distance exponents at $z=10$\,nm spread by more than two units. These ratios are independent of the transition-dipole prefactor. Within the $C_3$-symmetric leading-harmonic model the chiral $p_+$ and $d_-$ states are also dark at normal incidence yet transfer to graphene at rates comparable to the bright ground state. Their graphene rate depends on the sign of the texture phase, a quantity invisible in far-field emission, which we determine from first principles. In a device this prediction requires a splitting, larger than the symmetry-breaking mixing, that protects the chiral partners. Graphene proximity thus acts as a momentum-selective near-field probe of moir\'e excitons, and we propose its use as a practical spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 该文比较远场光致发光与石墨烯近场能量转移对WSe₂/MoSe₂摩尔激子动量的选择性，提出石墨烯可作为动量分辨探针并区分远场不可见的手性暗态。
AI.motivation: 远场光致发光只探测激子动量光锥角附近的信息，难以获得完整动量内容；需要一种近场、动量选择性的探针来表征局域摩尔激子及其暗态。
AI.method: 基于依赖配准的矢量偶极纹理构建每个局域摩尔激子的跃迁极化P_n(q)，并同时用于光学和石墨烯两个“浴”，计算WSe₂/MoSe₂异质双层中的能量转移速率并与远场发射比较。
AI.result: 两种探测对态的排序不同：石墨烯速率比与光学比不同，且其排序随间隔层厚度反转；在z=10 nm时距离指数相差超过2；这些比值不依赖跃迁偶极前因子。在C₃对称主导谐波模型中，手性p₊和d₋态在法向入射下暗，但向石墨烯转移速率可与亮基态相比；其石墨烯速率依赖纹理相位符号，该符号由第一性原理确定。
AI.conclusion: 石墨烯邻近可作为摩尔激子的动量选择性近场探针，并有望发展为实用光谱学；器件中需使手性伙伴的分裂大于对称破缺混合以保护该预测。

title: Andreev Reflection at a Graphene Normal-Superconductor Interface: A Lattice-Continuum Comparison
summary:
We compare quadratic continuum and nearest-neighbour tight-binding models of Andreev reflection at a clean graphene normal-superconductor interface. For abrupt changes in chemical potential and pairing potential, with unchanged hopping, the lattice model yields four independent boundary conditions. Its reflection probabilities agree with independent Kwant calculations to numerical precision for the channels examined.
  We investigate trigonal warping and its effect on the relation between momentum and group velocity. For $(\mu_N,\mu_S,\Delta_0,E)/t_0=(0.5,1,0.1,0.05)$, the Andreev-reflection probability for the $\xi=+1$ valley peaks at $19.9^\circ$ in the lattice model, versus $3.4^\circ$ in the quadratic continuum model. These parameters lie outside the expected validity regime of the low-energy approximation. As all energy scales are reduced at fixed ratios, the central angular response and conductance become more consistent with lattice results.
  The quadratic continuum boundary problem also requires short-wavelength auxiliary modes outside the validity range of the valley expansion. Thus, differences cannot be attributed to bulk dispersion alone. A small excitation energy relative to chemical potential does not ensure continuum validity; relevant energy scales, modes in both regions, and interface matching assumptions must also be considered.

AI.tldr: 比较石墨烯正常-超导界面Andreev反射的二次连续模型与最近邻紧束缚模型，发现低能连续近似在参数越界时显著失效，需同时考虑体色散、短波辅助模式与界面匹配。
AI.motivation: 检验谷展开二次连续模型在石墨烯Andreev反射中的适用性，并厘清trigonal warping、动量-群速度关系及边界条件对结果的影响。
AI.method: 对干净石墨烯正常-超导界面，在化学势和配对势突变、跃迁不变条件下比较二次连续模型与最近邻紧束缚模型；紧束缚模型给出四个独立边界条件，并用Kwant数值验证反射概率；通过固定比例降低所有能量尺度考察角度响应和电导。
AI.result: 紧束缚反射概率与Kwant计算达数值精度一致；在(μN,μS,Δ0,E)/t0=(0.5,1,0.1,0.05)时，ξ=+1谷Andreev反射概率峰值紧束缚为19.9°，二次连续模型为3.4°；降低所有能标并固定比例后，中心角度响应和电导更接近紧束缚结果。
AI.conclusion: 差异不能仅归因于体色散，二次连续边界问题还需谷展开有效范围外的短波辅助模式；小E/μ不足以保证连续模型有效，需综合考虑相关能标、两区模式及界面匹配假设。

title: Geometric tailoring of domain wall traps and diodes in ferromagnetic nanostripes
summary: Geometric tailoring of magnetic responses is a central theme in modern magnetism. By employing cross-sectional geometric modulation, we investigate how geometric variations influence the dynamics of field-driven domain walls. This approach enables the realization of a domain-wall trap, achieved through a nanostripe constriction, and a domain-wall diode, realized via a wedge-shaped expansion. We demonstrate that domain walls can be efficiently pinned by cross-sectional modulation, with the depinning field exhibiting strong dependence on the cross-sectional gradient. Under weak applied fields, the domain wall undergoes localized oscillations near the pinning site; under strong fields, this pinning breaks down, reproducing the typical diode characteristics. Theoretical calculations based on a biaxial ferromagnet model and a collective-variable approach are in excellent agreement with micromagnetic simulations. Finally, we delineate the parameter regime for realistic samples in which these predicted effects are most pronounced.

AI.tldr: 通过截面几何调制实现了畴壁陷阱与畴壁二极管，并揭示钉扎/退钉扎行为与截面梯度的强依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 几何裁剪磁响应是现代磁学的重要主题；本文旨在研究截面几何变化如何影响场驱动畴壁的动力学。
AI.method: 采用截面几何调制设计纳米条带收缩以实现畴壁陷阱、楔形扩张以实现畴壁二极管；基于双轴铁磁体模型和集体变量方法进行理论计算，并与微磁模拟对比。
AI.result: 畴壁可被截面调制有效钉扎，退钉扎场强烈依赖截面梯度；弱场下畴壁在钉扎位点附近局域振荡，强场下钉扎失效并呈现典型二极管特性；理论计算与微磁模拟高度一致，并界定了效应最显著的实际样品参数范围。
AI.conclusion: 截面几何调制是调控畴壁钉扎与定向输运的有效手段，为畴壁陷阱和畴壁二极管等磁器件设计提供了理论依据。

title: Synthetic staggered fields switch Neel vectors probed by magnetic resonance
summary: Electrical detection of antiferromagnetic order is a critical challenge for antiferromagnetic spintronics owing to their vanishing macroscopic magnetisation. While magnetic resonance has demonstrated sub-terahertz antiferromagnetic spin pumping and nonlinear magnon dynamics, its application to electrically contacted on-chip devices has room for further exploration. Here we show that magnetic resonance enables direct electrical detection of N\'eel vector states. A $180^\circ$ reversal in synthetic antiferromagnets is realised by current-driven effective fields with opposite polarisation acting on each magnetic sublayer, which we term synthetic staggered fields. The switching induces a $\pi$ phase shift of precessional motion in time, producing hysteretic rectified voltages in our phase-sensitive detection scheme. Angular-dependent resonance analysis offers further insight into the N\'eel vector directions, pointing to a model beyond the macrospin formalism. We address this by defect-incorporated micromagnetic simulations that reveal fragmented domain states after current excitation. An extracted current density of $7.4\times10^{9}$ A/m$^2$ is, to our knowledge, the lowest reported value for the room-temperature N\'eel vector switching and we show that it scales with the in-plane uniaxial anisotropy both experimentally and numerically. Synthetic staggered fields and the resonance-based methodology provide a research platform for nanoscale characterisation of electrically driven antiferromagnetic textures, guiding the development of high-frequency on-chip spintronic architectures.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用磁共振实现了对合成反铁磁体中Néel矢量态的直接电学检测，并通过电流驱动的合成交错场实现180°翻转。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁体宏观磁化近乎为零，导致其磁序的电学检测和操控困难，是反铁磁自旋电子学的关键挑战；尽管磁共振已用于亚太赫兹反铁磁自旋泵浦和非线性磁振子动力学，其在电接触片上器件中的应用仍需探索。
AI.method: 作者在合成反铁磁体中施加电流驱动的有效场，使每个磁性子层受到相反极化的作用，即合成交错场，从而实现Néel矢量180°翻转；采用相位敏感检测方案测量预进动运动的时间π相位移动所产生的滞回整流电压，并结合角度依赖共振分析判断Néel矢量方向。针对超越宏观自旋模型的行为，采用含缺陷微磁模拟分析电流激发后的碎片化畴态。
AI.result: 实验实现了电流驱动的Néel矢量180°翻转，并在相位敏感检测中观察到由预进动π相位移动导致的滞回整流电压；角度依赖共振分析揭示了Néel矢量方向及宏观自旋模型的不足；微磁模拟显示电流激发后形成碎片化畴态；提取的翻转电流密度为7.4×10^9 A/m^2，为目前已报道的室温Néel矢量翻转最低值，且实验和数值均表明其随面内单轴各向异性缩放。
AI.conclusion: 合成交错场与基于共振的方法为电驱动反铁磁织构的纳米尺度表征提供了平台，有助于高频片上自旋电子架构的发展。

title: Helicity-Selective Electron-Phonon Coupling Between $PT$-Partner States in $2H$-bilayer MoS$_2$
summary: Rotational symmetry ($C_n$) constrains chiral phonons, but how other symmetries affect their interactions remains largely unexplored. We perform a theoretical and computational study of chiral phonon coupling to parity-time ($PT$)-degenerate electron doublets in $2H$-bilayer MoS$_2$. Although $PT$ suppresses phonon singlet chirality, chiral phonon doublets can helically interact with $PT$-partner electronic states via a mechanism similar to pseudospin. Selection rules are then analyzed with the interplay of $PT$ and $C_3$. Our computational results of $2H$-bilayer MoS$_2$ suggest chiral phonons may be used to resolve intravalley electronic states in $PT$ systems.

AI.tldr: 该文理论研究2H双层MoS2中手性声子与PT简并电子双态的耦合，揭示PT与C3对称性共同决定的选择定则，并提出用手性声子分辨PT体系谷内电子态。
AI.motivation: 旋转对称性C_n对手性声子的约束已有研究，但其他对称性如何影响手性声子相互作用仍不清楚，尤其缺乏对PT对称体系中手性声子与电子耦合机制的理解。
AI.method: 结合理论分析与计算，研究2H双层MoS2中手性声子与PT简并电子双态的耦合；分析PT与C3对称性下的选择定则，并考察PT对声子单态手性的抑制及手性声子双态与PT配对电子态的类赝自旋螺旋相互作用。
AI.result: PT会抑制声子单态手性，但手性声子双态可通过类赝自旋机制与PT配对电子态发生螺旋相互作用；PT与C3共同决定选择定则。对2H双层MoS2的计算表明手性声子可用于分辨PT体系中的谷内电子态。
AI.conclusion: 手性声子与PT简并电子双态的耦合受PT和C3对称性调控，为利用手性声子探测和分辨PT对称体系中的电子态提供了理论依据。

title: Nanoscale mapping of native defects in Td-MoTe2 and their impact on graphene-based van der Waals heterostructures
summary: We investigate native defects and their impact on the electronic structure of Td-MoTe2 and graphene/Td-MoTe2 van der Waals heterostructures using scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy. STM reveals a high density of circular, hollow surface defects that we attribute to Te vacancies. STS on pristine MoTe2 shows semimetallic, V-shaped dI/dV spectra with subtle low-energy states. The vacancies suppress the tunnelling conductance below the Fermi level without introducing new sharp defect-related resonances, consistent with a vacancy-induced redistribution of Mo-Te spectral weight rather than the appearance of new electronic states. In the heterostructure, graphene preserves these MoTe2 fingerprints with no noticeable graphene doping or charge transfer. Our results demonstrate that isolated native Te vacancies act as spectroscopically weak perturbations to the low-energy electronic structure of graphene. The graphene overlayer further screens their impact on the electronic structure, making graphene/Td-MoTe2 heterostructures intrinsically tolerant to such interface defects.

AI.tldr: 利用STM/STS研究Td-MoTe2及石墨烯/Td-MoTe2范德华异质结中的原生Te空位及其对低能电子结构的影响。
AI.motivation: 理解原生缺陷如何影响Td-MoTe2及石墨烯/Td-MoTe2异质结的电子结构，并评估界面缺陷对石墨烯的影响。
AI.method: 采用扫描隧道显微镜和扫描隧道谱（STM/STS）表征表面缺陷、隧穿电导谱及异质结中的电荷转移行为。
AI.result: STM发现高密度圆形空心表面缺陷，归因于Te空位； pristine MoTe2的STS呈半金属V形dI/dV谱并含微弱低能态；空位抑制费米能级以下隧穿电导但不产生新的尖锐缺陷共振，符合空位诱导的Mo-Te谱权重再分布；异质结中石墨烯保持MoTe2谱学特征，无明显石墨烯掺杂或电荷转移。
AI.conclusion: 孤立原生Te空位对低能电子结构是谱学弱扰动，石墨烯覆盖层可屏蔽其影响，使石墨烯/Td-MoTe2异质结本征上耐受此类界面缺陷。

title: Dynamic helimagnetism via charged spin current
summary: We present a theoretical and numerical study of classical, localized spins coupled to conduction electrons that carry both charge and spin currents, deriving the effective equations of motion from the s-d exchange Hamiltonian. Applied to a periodically arranged one-dimensional spin chain, these equations yield two current-driven helical phases: a static helix stabilized by a pure spin current alone, and a coherently precessing helix that appears once a small charge-current component is added. For a given helical wavenumber, the precession angular frequency $\omega$ and the canting ratio $\Delta$ toward the hard axis follow analytically from the equations of motion, while the wavenumber $q_{\rm helix}$ of the precessing helix is selected by a heuristically constructed effective Lagrangian. Direct numerical integration of the same equations of motion reproduces all three observables wherever it yields a coherent helix. The helix chirality is set by a long-range, current-generated Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM)-type coupling rather than an intrinsic DM interaction, so materials without bulk or interfacial DM interactions could also host current-controlled helical order. Because the helical pitch, precession frequency, and canting ratio are all continuously tunable by the current amplitudes, these helices could serve as probes of spin currents.

AI.tldr: 该文从s-d交换哈密顿量推导经典局域自旋与传导电子（同时携带电荷流和自旋流）耦合的有效运动方程，并在一维周期自旋链中发现两类电流驱动的螺旋相：纯自旋流稳定的静态螺旋，以及加入小电荷流后出现的相干进动螺旋。
AI.motivation: 研究传导电子电荷流与自旋流如何通过s-d交换耦合驱动并调控局域自旋的螺旋有序，并探索无需本征Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用即可产生电流控制螺旋序的可能性。
AI.method: 建立经典局域自旋与传导电子耦合的理论模型，从s-d交换哈密顿量推导有效运动方程；将其应用于一维周期排列的自旋链，解析求取给定螺旋波矢下的进动角频率和硬轴倾斜比，并用启发式构造的有效拉格朗日量选择进动螺旋的波矢，最后通过直接数值积分验证。
AI.result: 得到两种电流驱动螺旋相：纯自旋流可稳定静态螺旋；加入小电荷流后出现相干进动螺旋。对给定螺旋波矢，进动角频率ω与硬轴倾斜比Δ可由运动方程解析给出，而进动螺旋的q_helix由有效拉格朗日量选取；数值积分在产生相干螺旋时重现全部三个可观测量。螺旋手性由电流产生的长程DM型耦合决定，而非本征DM相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 电流可连续调控螺旋螺距、进动频率和倾斜比；该机制使缺乏体相或界面DM相互作用的材料也可能承载电流控制的螺旋序，并使这些螺旋可作为自旋流的探针。

title: High-Q, high-power spin Hall nano-oscillators with thick NiFe layers enabled by SiC substrates
summary: Spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) are nanoscale microwave sources with potential applications in local spin excitation, neuromorphic computing, and oscillator-based Ising machines. Further improvements in output power and coherence are essential for these applications, and increasing the thickness of the ferromagnetic layer offers a promising route toward this goal. However, this comes at the cost of higher drive currents, which increase Joule heating and can degrade device performance. Here, we show that this bottleneck can be overcome by SiC substrates. By comparing otherwise identical W/NiFe nanoconstriction SHNOs on Al2O3, Si, and SiC, we find that the high thermal conductivity of SiC enables stable auto-oscillations in NiFe layers as thick as 10 nm, while the optimum performance occurs at 7 nm. The best SiC device reaches an average output power of 13.1 pW and a mean quality factor of Q = 23,000, representing the highest reported simultaneous output power and coherence for a single free-running SHNO. These results establish SiC and thermal substrate engineering as a route to thick-ferromagnet spintronic oscillators for coherent microwave generation in nanoscale devices.

AI.tldr: 通过采用高热导率SiC衬底，W/NiFe纳米收缩自旋霍尔纳米振荡器可在较厚NiFe层中保持稳定自激振荡，并同时实现高输出功率与高相干性。
AI.motivation: 自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNOs）在局域自旋激发、类脑计算和基于振荡器的伊辛机等应用中前景广阔，但需进一步提升输出功率和相干性；增加铁磁层厚度是有希望的途径，却会提高驱动电流并加剧焦耳热，从而恶化器件性能。
AI.method: 制备并对比了结构相同、分别位于Al2O3、Si和SiC衬底上的W/NiFe纳米收缩SHNOs，利用衬底热工程比较不同热导率对厚NiFe层自激振荡性能的影响。
AI.result: SiC的高热导率使NiFe层厚度可达10 nm仍保持稳定自激振荡，最佳性能出现在7 nm；最佳SiC器件平均输出功率为13.1 pW、平均品质因数Q=23,000，为单个自由运行SHNO已报道的最高同时输出功率与相干性。
AI.conclusion: SiC衬底及热衬底工程可为厚铁磁层自旋电子振荡器提供可行路径，用于纳米尺度器件中的相干微波产生。

title: Higher-harmonic spin-wave excitation by a superconducting antenna with vortices
summary: The interaction between superconductivity and magnetism provides new routes for controlling nonlinear excitations in hybrid systems. While dc-driven Abrikosov vortices (fluxons) are known to interact with spin waves, the ability of confined, nearly harmonic vortex oscillations to generate higher-frequency spin-wave modes remains unexplored. Here, by combining time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau modeling with spectral analysis of the microwave near field, we demonstrate higher-harmonic spin-wave excitation driven by a superconducting microstrip antenna in the Shubnikov phase. Unlike conventional harmonic-generation mechanisms associated with nonlinear magnetization dynamics, the magnetic layer remains a linear receiver, whereas the superconducting antenna generates the nonlinear microwave field. We show that nearly sinusoidal vortex motion and the accompanying redistribution of superconducting screening currents produce higher harmonics that couple to spin-wave modes. This response arises from spatial-to-temporal transduction, whereby harmonic vortex motion and the associated redistribution of screening currents convert a spatially nonuniform magnetic-field profile into higher temporal harmonics. Magnetic flux quanta thus act as active nonlinear elements for frequency conversion, extending the accessible spin-wave frequency range in superconducting--magnonic hybrids.

AI.tldr: 该文通过时变Ginzburg-Landau模拟与微波近场频谱分析，证明Shubnikov相中超导微带天线中受限涡旋的近谐振动可产生高次谐波并激发自旋波。
AI.motivation: 超导与磁性混合体系为调控非线性激发提供新途径；直流驱动Abrikosov涡旋与自旋波相互作用已有研究，但受限、近谐涡旋振荡能否产生高频自旋波模式尚不清楚。
AI.method: 结合时间依赖Ginzburg-Landau建模与微波近场频谱分析，研究Shubnikov相中超导微带天线驱动的涡旋动力学及其对自旋波的激发。
AI.result: 发现由超导天线产生的高次谐波可耦合至自旋波模式；磁性层保持线性接收，非线性来自超导天线。近正弦涡旋运动及超导屏蔽电流重分布产生高次谐波，其机制为空间非均匀磁场剖面向高时间谐波的“空间-时间转导”。
AI.conclusion: 磁通量子可作为频率转换的主动非线性元件，从而拓展超导-磁振子混合体系中可访问的自旋波频率范围。

title: Wrinkling dynamics of thin crystalline sheets and its dependency on topological defects
summary: We investigate the wrinkling dynamics of thin crystalline sheets under uniaxial compression using a Surface Phase-Field-Crystal-Helfrich (SPFCH) model, which captures the coupling between crystalline order, out-of-plane deformations, and topological defects. In particular, the model allows us to track and characterize two distinct classes of defects, namely those forming in the underlying hexagonal crystal lattice, such as dislocations and grain boundaries, and defects in the wrinkling patterns, known as wrinklons. By resolving the evolution and interactions of these defects, we investigate how the interplay between in-plane and out-of-plane relaxation mechanisms influences wrinkling onset and the coarsening regime. Our results indicate that crystalline defects do not affect coarsening scaling, but they quantitatively affect the onset of wrinkling and the emerging wrinkling wavelength, promote more irregular wrinkle patterns with a higher density of wrinklons, and modify long-timescale morphological evolution.

AI.tldr: 该文用SPFCH模型研究薄晶体片在单轴压缩下的起皱动力学，区分晶格缺陷（位错、晶界）与起皱缺陷（wrinklon），并揭示二者对起皱起始、波长、形貌和粗化行为的影响。
AI.motivation: 薄晶体片起皱涉及面内晶体有序、面外变形和拓扑缺陷的耦合；现有理解需要同时追踪晶格缺陷与起皱模式缺陷，以明确面内/面外弛豫机制如何影响起皱起始与粗化。
AI.method: 构建Surface Phase-Field-Crystal-Helfrich（SPFCH）模型，耦合晶体序参量、面外变形和拓扑缺陷；追踪六角晶格中的位错/晶界及起皱图案中的wrinklon，解析其演化与相互作用，并分析面内与面外弛豫机制的竞争。
AI.result: 晶格缺陷不改变粗化标度律，但会定量影响起皱起始与新生起皱波长；它们促使起皱图案更不规则、wrinklon密度更高，并改变长时间尺度下的形貌演化。
AI.conclusion: 晶格缺陷虽不决定粗化普适标度，但通过调控起皱起始、波长、缺陷密度和长期形貌，显著影响薄晶体片起皱动力学的定量特征与非平衡演化路径。

title: Information-theoretic entropy imaging of quantum matter
summary: Phase transitions can generate intricate spatial organization invisible to spatially averaged probes, yet quantitative measures of this organization remain limited. Here we develop "entropy imaging," an information-theoretic technique that harnesses lossless compression to quantify spatial complexity, predictability, and order in quantum materials. Using this approach, emergent spatial textures can be imaged and converted into an experimentally-accessible observable: the computable information density (CID), a compression-based measure of information complexity that approaches the Shannon entropy rate in the large-system limit. Applied to millikelvin microwave impedance microscopy of graphene, the method reveals a pronounced maximum in the CID near quantum Hall transitions, a quantitative measure of the information-rich spatial organization of the critical landscape. A disordered Hofstadter model reproduces this behavior and shows that the CID can identify the quantum critical point from a sequence of images, without ensemble averaging over disorder realizations. The same framework tracks fractional quantum Hall transitions and resolves isolated fractional puddles that coexist with a disordered background. By contrast, the trivial band-edge crossover in a MoSe2/WS2 moir\'e heterobilayer exhibits qualitatively different behavior, suggesting that the pronounced CID enhancement observed at the quantum Hall critical point is not simply a generic feature of a conductive-insulating crossover. We further show that the geometric information encoded in CID is not reducible to a correlation length, and it can even distinguish spatial textures with identical multifractal statistics. Together, these results establish lossless compression as a framework for quantifying emergent spatial organization in quantum materials, with portability across imaging modalities and physical systems.

AI.tldr: 作者提出“熵成像”框架，用无损压缩量化量子材料中的空间复杂性、可预测性与有序度，并将可计算信息密度（CID）作为实验可及观测量。
AI.motivation: 相变可产生空间平均探针无法看到的复杂空间组织，但缺乏定量刻画这类组织的方法。
AI.method: 利用无损压缩定义CID，使其在大系统极限下趋近Shannon熵率；将该方法用于石墨烯的毫开尔文微波阻抗显微图像，并用无序Hofstadter模型、分数量子霍尔系统及MoSe2/WS2 moiré异质双层进行验证与对照。
AI.result: 在量子霍尔转变附近观察到CID显著极大，反映临界景观的信息丰富空间组织；无序Hofstadter模型可仅凭图像序列识别量子临界点且无需无序系综平均；该方法可追踪分数量子霍尔转变并分辨无序背景中的孤立分数puddle；MoSe2/WS2 moiré的平庸带边交叉不呈现类似CID增强；CID编码的几何信息不可约化为相关长度，甚至可区分具有相同多重分形统计的空间纹理。
AI.conclusion: 无损压缩可作为量化量子材料中涌现空间组织的通用框架，并具有跨成像模态和物理系统的可移植性。

title: Modeling the CNOT gate in Germanium double quantum dots
summary: We model a controlled-NOT (CNOT) gate mediated by exchange interactions in a realistic Ge/GeSi hole spin-qubit device. We use for that purpose a computationally efficient framework based on a compact dressed basis of many-body singlet and triplet states, which enables fast time-dependent simulations that would be prohibitive within a conventional configuration-interaction approach. We discuss the dominant sources of infidelity in ideal (noise-free) devices. On the one hand, the nonadiabaticity of the tunnel barrier ramps, enhanced by the transverse component of the exchange interaction, imposes limits on the speed of the CNOT gate. On the other hand, the AC Stark shift of the conditional resonance and the off-resonant driving of the complementary transition can significantly degrade the gate fidelity and call for a careful optimization of the driving conditions. Finally, we investigate the impact of quasi-static charge noise on the fidelity of the CNOT gate. We find that the capture of charges near the qubits can strongly disrupt the conditional operation, while the nanometer-scale motion of charges results in a loss of fidelity that sensitively depends on the position and strength of the corresponding dipole. Our results quantify the requirements on barrier control, microwave driving, and charge-noise stability for high-fidelity two-qubit operations in Ge/GeSi hole-spin qubits.

AI.tldr: 该文建立高效缀饰基框架，模拟Ge/GeSi空穴自旋量子点中由交换相互作用介导的CNOT门，并量化无噪声与非静态电荷噪声下的保真度限制。
AI.motivation: 为在高保真两比特操作中明确Ge/GeSi空穴自旋量子比特对势垒控制、微波驱动和电荷噪声稳定性的具体要求。
AI.method: 采用由多体单态和三重态构成的紧凑缀饰基，实现快速含时模拟；分析理想无噪声器件中的主要非保真来源，并研究准静态电荷噪声影响。
AI.result: 非绝热势垒斜坡及交换相互作用横向分量限制CNOT速度；条件共振的AC Stark频移和互补跃迁的离共振驱动显著降低保真度，需优化驱动条件；量子点附近电荷俘获会严重破坏条件操作，纳米尺度电荷运动导致的保真度损失敏感依赖于相应偶极子的位置和强度。
AI.conclusion: 研究量化了Ge/GeSi空穴自旋量子比特实现高保真两比特操作对势垒控制、微波驱动和电荷噪声稳定性的要求。

title: OpenFerro: a unified framework for mesoscale ferroic dynamics and enhanced sampling
summary: Modeling ferroic materials requires connecting microscopic fluctuations to collective dynamics over mesoscales. We introduce OpenFerro, a unified lattice-field dynamics framework that combines flexible Hamiltonians, automatic differentiation, parallel execution, and enhanced sampling. The same framework can simulate ferroelectric domain motion, magnetic disordering, and coupled spin-lattice thermodynamics. On four graphics processors, a bulk BaTiO$_3$ benchmark with long-range dipolar interaction reaches $840^3$ unit cells, representing 3 billion atoms through the retained lattice variables. We simulate polarization textures in a PbTiO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ superlattice spanning $0.8~\mu\mathrm{m}$ laterally and a BaTiO$_3$ nanoparticle 200~nm in diameter, retaining unit-cell resolution. We also demonstrate enhanced-sampling simulations that reconstruct the polarization free-energy surface of bulk BaTiO$_3$ without a prescribed polynomial form. With moderate computational resources, OpenFerro achieves atomistic-resolution simulations at mesoscopic scales traditionally studied with continuum models.

AI.tldr: OpenFerro 是一个统一的晶格-场动力学框架，用于在介观尺度上以原子级分辨率模拟铁电、磁性和自旋-晶格耦合热力学。
AI.motivation: 铁性材料建模需要将微观涨落与介观尺度集体动力学联系起来，而现有方法常难以兼顾原子级细节与介观尺度模拟。
AI.method: OpenFerro 集成灵活哈密顿量、自动微分、并行执行和增强采样，可模拟铁电畴运动、磁无序及耦合自旋-晶格热力学。
AI.result: 在4块GPU上，含长程偶极相互作用的BaTiO3基准达到840^3个晶胞（保留晶格变量对应约30亿原子）；模拟了横向0.8 μm的PbTiO3/SrTiO3超晶格和直径200 nm的BaTiO3纳米颗粒并保持晶胞分辨率；增强采样无需预设多项式形式即可重建BaTiO3极化自由能面。
AI.conclusion: OpenFerro 以中等计算资源实现了传统上由连续模型研究的介观尺度原子级分辨率模拟。

title: Charge state and hydration of vacancies in silicon and silicon carbide in contact with water: A grand-canonical first-principles stability map
summary: The state of a vacancy in a semiconductor is normally described by the Fermi level alone. In wet-etched, electrochemically processed, or humid silicon and silicon carbide, a vacancy also takes up hydrogen and oxygen from water, in amounts set by pH and electrode potential. We treat both effects together by minimizing the grand potential of a vacancy complex over its charge state and hydrogen/oxygen content. The result is a stability map in Fermi level and hydrogen chemical potential, which the computational hydrogen electrode relates to pH and potential. We parameterize it with spin-polarized density functional theory in 64-atom cells, including the vibrational free energy of bound H and O, for the silicon vacancy, its H, O, and OH complexes, and both vacancies of 3C-SiC. Hydrogen binds cooperatively to the silicon vacancy, which goes directly from bare to fully passivated $V$H$_4$. In contact with water the bare vacancy is never the lowest-energy state. Near neutral pH it binds oxygen from water as the A center, the paramagnetic hydroxyl complex forms below about pH 5 at zero bias, and full passivation to $V$H$_4$ requires cathodic bias. In PBE the Fermi level barely moves these boundaries, because the acceptor levels lie at or above the conduction-band edge. In SiC the first hydrogen binds to the silicon vacancy by 1.97 eV but is unbound at the carbon vacancy (the $Z_{1/2}$ center), so hydrogen from water alone should not passivate it except under cathodic bias.

AI.tldr: 该文将半导体空位的电荷态与从水中摄取H/O的程度统一处理，构建了以费米能级和氢化学势为坐标的稳定性图，并映射为pH与电极电位条件；应用于Si和3C-SiC空位，揭示水环境中裸空位并非最低能态，钝化行为强烈依赖pH和偏压。
AI.motivation: 传统上仅用费米能级描述半导体空位，但在湿法刻蚀、电化学处理或潮湿环境的Si和SiC中，空位还会从水摄取H和O，其含量由pH和电极电位决定；需要同时考虑电荷态与H/O占据对空位稳定性的影响。
AI.method: 对空位复合体的巨势关于电荷态及H/O含量做最小化，得到费米能级-氢化学势稳定性图，并用计算氢电极关联到pH和电极电位；采用自旋极化DFT、64原子超胞，包含束缚H和O的振动自由能，参数化Si空位及其H、O、OH复合体以及3C-SiC两种空位。
AI.result: Si空位中H协同结合，可从裸空位直接到完全钝化的VH4；接触水时裸空位从不是最低能态。近中性pH下空位从水中结合氧形成A中心，零偏压下约pH<5形成顺磁羟基复合体，完全钝化为VH4需阴极偏压。PBE计算中费米能级对这些边界影响很小，因为受主能级位于导带边或之上。SiC中第一个H以1.97 eV结合到Si空位，但在C空位（Z1/2中心）不结合，因此仅靠水中的H通常不能钝化该中心，除非处于阴极偏压。
AI.conclusion: 空位稳定性必须同时考虑费米能级和H/O化学势；在水环境中裸空位不稳定，pH和电极电位决定其O/H/OH复合体及钝化状态。SiC的Z1/2中心对水中的H钝化有强偏压依赖，仅靠水环境H难以钝化。

title: Co layer Thickness Driven Structural Evolution and Magnetic Behaviour of Co/Ir/Co Trilayers
summary: Ferromagnetic heavy-metal (FM/HM) trilayer heterostructures provide a versatile platform for investigating the interplay between structural and magnetic properties. In this study, we investigate the effect of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of sputter-deposited $\mathrm{Co}(t_{\mathrm{Co}})/\mathrm{Ir}(5\,\mathrm{nm})/\mathrm{Co}(t_{\mathrm{Co}})$ varying from 2 to 10 nm. Structural characterization using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) reveals a nanocrystalline structure, with the crystallite size increasing with Co-layer thickness. Furthermore, X-ray reflectivity (XRR) reveals a thickness-dependent variation in interface morphology, with the interface roughness ratio reaching a maximum at $t_{\mathrm{Co}} = 4$ nm. Temperature-dependent zero-field-cooled and field-cooled (ZFC-FC) magnetization measurements reveal thickness-dependent characteristic temperatures and multiple relaxation regimes in selected samples, indicating complex thermally activated magnetic behaviour. In contrast, field-dependent hysteresis measurements reveal that the saturation magnetization increases with Co-layer thickness, whereas the coercivity exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic variation, with enhanced values at intermediate thicknesses. Moreover, low-temperature hysteresis loops display thickness-dependent exchange-bias-like shifts, particularly for $t_{\mathrm{Co}} = 2$-$4$ nm. These findings highlight the strong influence of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of Co/Ir/Co trilayers.

AI.tldr: 研究了Co层厚度（2–10 nm）对溅射沉积Co/Ir(5 nm)/Co三层膜结构与磁性的调控作用，发现晶粒尺寸、界面粗糙度、矫顽力和低温交换偏置样偏移均随Co厚度显著变化。
AI.motivation: FM/HM三层异质结构是研究结构与磁性相互作用的平台，但Co/Ir/Co体系中Co层厚度对结构、界面形貌及磁行为的影响仍需系统阐明。
AI.method: 制备Co(t_Co)/Ir(5 nm)/Co(t_Co)（t_Co=2–10 nm）溅射薄膜；用GIXRD和HRTEM表征结构，用XRR分析界面形貌；并进行ZFC-FC磁化测量、场依赖磁滞回线及低温磁滞测量。
AI.result: 薄膜呈纳米晶结构，晶粒尺寸随Co厚度增加；界面粗糙度比在t_Co=4 nm时最大。ZFC-FC显示厚度依赖的特征温度和多重弛豫区间；饱和磁化强度随Co厚度增加，而矫顽力呈非单调变化并在中间厚度增强；低温磁滞回线出现厚度依赖的交换偏置样偏移，尤其在t_Co=2–4 nm。
AI.conclusion: Co层厚度强烈影响Co/Ir/Co三层膜的结构与磁性，界面形貌、晶粒尺寸及热激活磁行为与厚度密切相关，可通过厚度工程调控其磁性能。

title: Spontaneous magnetic diode effect in Co$_{1/3}$TaS$_2$
summary: When electrons move through non-trivial spin textures in magnetic metals, conduction electrons couple to magnetic order through both their charge and their spin, acquiring non-trivial equations of motion and a dynamic spin polarization providing the foundation of spintronics. These mechanisms are, however, almost invariably reciprocal and the resistance a current encounters does not depend on its flow direction. Here we show that a chiral crystal lattice and an independently reversible chiral magnetic order together produce a diode whose forward direction is set by the magnetism rather than by the structure. In the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Co$_{1/3}$TaS$_2$, whose chiral lattice hosts a chiral magnetic order of its own, independent handedness, we observe a pronounced nonreciprocal resistance. Unlike conventional electrical magnetochiral anisotropy, which is driven by an external magnetic field, our spontaneous magnetic diode effect arises from an internal noncoplanar spin texture with vanishing net magnetization. Symmetry analysis and model calculations show that the effect originates from the interplay of noncoplanar spin order and spin-orbit coupling, which generates a chiral, time-reversal-symmetry-breaking electronic response. Crucially, reversing the magnetic handedness reverses the sign of the nonreciprocal resistance, demonstrating magnetic control of the diode polarity.

AI.tldr: 在具有手性晶格与独立可翻转手性磁序的三角晶格反铁磁体 Co_{1/3}TaS_2 中，观察到由内部非共面自旋织构产生的自发磁二极管效应；翻转磁手性可反转非互易电阻符号。
AI.motivation: 传统自旋电子学中的电荷/自旋输运机制通常具有互易性，电阻不依赖电流方向；作者希望探索手性晶格与手性磁序结合能否产生可由磁性而非结构控制极性的非互易输运。
AI.method: 在 Co_{1/3}TaS_2 中测量非互易电阻，并结合对称性分析与模型计算，分析非共面自旋序与自旋轨道耦合对电子响应的影响。
AI.result: 观察到显著的非互易电阻；该效应不同于由外磁场驱动的常规电致磁手性各向异性，而源于净磁化消失的内部非共面自旋织构。对称性和模型表明其来自非共面自旋序与自旋轨道耦合的协同作用，产生手性且破坏时间反演对称性的电子响应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了自发磁二极管效应可由内部手性磁序产生，且磁手性反转会反转非互易电阻符号，从而实现磁控二极管极性。

title: Optimised growth of epitaxial D019 Mn3Ge(0001) thin films via single target sputtering
summary: Materials with chemical identity Mn3X, where X is Sn, Ga, or Ge, are Heusler alloys with intriguing properties that are fundamentally and technologically interesting. They have topological properties with a non-trivial band structure that identify them as Weyl semimetals in the bulk. Their magnetic properties, which give rise to the topological band structure through spin-orbit coupling, are determined by their Kagome lattice structure, making them chiral non-collinear antiferromagnets. Among these materials, Mn3Ge is particularly interesting because it has a larger Berry curvature, leading to a large anomalous Hall conductivity and motivating potential spintronic applications. The desirable properties are only obtained when Mn3Ge has the D019 crystal structure, so producing an easily reproducible growth recipe is the main objective of this paper. Here we show that ultra-high-quality thin films of Mn3Ge with D019 symmetry can be grown from a Mn5Ge target on an Al2O3(0001) substrate with a Ru(0001) seed layer. The expected non-collinear antiferromagnetic order was confirmed by the finding of weak zero-field magnetisation (0.0086 +/- 0.0002) mu_B/Mn that does not saturate at high magnetic fields and has a Neel temperature of (291 +/- 2) K.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种可重复制备D019结构Mn3Ge高质量薄膜的方法，并确认其非共线反铁磁序。
AI.motivation: Mn3X（X=Sn、Ga、Ge）Heusler合金具有Weyl半金属能带和手性非共线反铁磁性；其中Mn3Ge因更大的Berry曲率而具有大反常霍尔电导，面向自旋电子学应用，但理想性质仅存在于D019相，因此需要易重复的生长工艺。
AI.method: 以Mn5Ge为靶材，在Al2O3(0001)衬底上引入Ru(0001)种子层生长Mn3Ge薄膜。
AI.result: 获得了具有D019对称性的超高质量Mn3Ge薄膜；测得弱零场磁化强度(0.0086±0.0002) μB/Mn，且在高磁场下不饱和，奈尔温度为(291±2) K，证实了预期的非共线反铁磁序。
AI.conclusion: 该生长方案可重复制备具有D019结构和所需拓扑/磁性特征的Mn3Ge薄膜，为相关自旋电子学应用提供材料基础。

title: Flexural Altermagnetism
summary: We establish flexural deformation as a versatile route for engineering altermagnetism in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets. By tailoring the flexure, we selectively break different symmetries to realize altermagnetic states with distinct wave symmetries and reverse their spin splitting. A tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for monolayer MnPS3 demonstrate d- and i-wave states and a switchable transverse spin current in the d-wave state.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用弯曲形变在二维共线反铁磁体中按需破缺对称性，从而工程化具有不同波对称性且自旋劈裂可反转的交变磁态。
AI.motivation: 二维共线反铁磁体中的交变磁性通常依赖特定晶体/磁对称性，需一种可调且通用的对称性破缺手段来实现不同交变磁相及自旋劈裂调控。
AI.method: 通过定制弯曲形变选择性破缺不同对称性，结合紧束缚模型与第一性原理计算，并以单层MnPS3为对象验证。
AI.result: 在单层MnPS3中实现了d波和i波交变磁态，并在d波态中获得可切换的横向自旋流。
AI.conclusion: 弯曲形变是一种通用且可逆的二维交变磁性工程策略，可调控交变磁波对称性与自旋劈裂方向，并支持自旋流切换。

title: Investigation of the Microstructural and Magnetic Properties of Ni on GeSn Layers
summary: Thermal processing of nickel (Ni) layers on germanium-tin (GeSn) can strongly modify the Ni film and the Ni/GeSn interface within a restricted thermal budget; however, the influence of GeSn crystalline quality on Ni-Ge-Sn interfacial evolution and the magnetic response of the Ni layer remains incompletely understood. Here, Ni (15~nm)/Ge$_{1-x}$Sn$_x$/Ge/Gd$_2$O$_3$/Si(111) heterostructures ($x = 0.08$ and $0.10$) were investigated following rapid thermal annealing at 573 and 973~K for 10~s using X-ray diffraction, pole-figure analysis, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling, and temperature- and field-dependent magnetization measurements. Annealing at 573~K preserves the crystallographic texture of Ge$_{0.92}$Sn$_{0.08}$, whereas Ge$_{0.90}$Sn$_{0.10}$ exhibits microtwin formation and reduced structural integrity. Annealing at 973~K, employed as a severe upper-bound thermal reference, causes extensive structural degradation in both heterostructures, with substantially greater deterioration in the higher-Sn sample. XPS depth profiling reveals progressive Ni-Ge-Sn intermixing accompanied by pronounced Sn surface segregation with increasing annealing temperature. Magnetization measurements show coexisting ferromagnetic and superparamagnetic contributions in the as-deposited and 573~K samples, whereas annealing at 973~K strongly suppresses the ferromagnetic response, producing highly unsaturated $M(H)$ loops together with reduced saturation magnetization and coercivity. These magnetic changes are consistent with extensive interfacial alloying and dilution of the metallic Ni layer. This study establishes a direct correlation between GeSn crystalline quality, interfacial diffusion, and magnetic behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究了快速热退火对Ni/GeSn/Ge/Gd2O3/Si(111)异质结构中Ni-Ge-Sn界面演化及Ni层磁性的影响，并建立GeSn晶体质量、界面扩散与磁响应之间的直接关联。
AI.motivation: Ni/GeSn热加工可在有限热预算内显著改变Ni薄膜及Ni/GeSn界面，但GeSn晶体质量如何影响Ni-Ge-Sn界面演化及Ni层磁性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 制备Ni(15 nm)/Ge1-xSnx/Ge/Gd2O3/Si(111)异质结构（x=0.08和0.10），在573 K和973 K下快速热退火10 s，采用X射线衍射、极图分析、X射线光电子能谱深度剖析以及温度和磁场依赖磁化测量进行表征。
AI.result: 573 K退火保持Ge0.92Sn0.08的晶体织构，而Ge0.90Sn0.10出现微孪晶和结构完整性下降；973 K退火导致两者显著结构退化，且高Sn样品更严重。XPS深度剖析显示随退火温度升高Ni-Ge-Sn逐步互混并伴随明显Sn表面偏析。磁性测量表明，沉积态和573 K样品存在铁磁与超顺磁共存贡献；973 K退火强烈抑制铁磁响应，M(H)回线高度不饱和，饱和磁化强度和矫顽力降低，与界面合金化和金属Ni层稀释一致。
AI.conclusion: GeSn晶体质量直接影响Ni-Ge-Sn界面扩散、Sn偏析及Ni层磁性，高温退火引起的界面合金化会显著削弱铁磁行为。

title: Phonon-assisted shift-current from first-principles: application to AlN monolayer
summary: In this work, we present a first-principles approach to investigate phonon-assisted shift current in extended systems. Our method combines the special displacement technique with real-time simulations based on the dynamical Berry phase. Merging these two frameworks enables direct access to non-linear optical responses at finite temperatures, while naturally incorporating phonon scattering and phonon-assisted electronic transitions into the time-dependent dynamics. This allows us to capture temperature-dependent features and lattice fluctuations that are essential for a realistic description of non-linear photocurrent generation. As a representative example, we apply our approach to the shift-current response of a monolayer of hexagonal AlN (h-AlN). This system provides an ideal testing ground because it features an indirect band gap and lacks inversion symmetry. Moreover, h-AlN layers of different thicknesses have been fabricated and characterized in a variety of experimental settings, opening the concrete possibility of testing our predictions. Our results demonstrate the relevance of phonon-mediated processes and the importance of temperature in determining the magnitude and spectral features of the shift current in layered materials.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合特殊位移技术与基于动力学Berry相的实时模拟的第一性原理方法，用于研究扩展体系中的声子辅助shift current，并在单层h-AlN中验证温度与声子散射对非线性光伏响应的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有非线性光电流描述常忽略有限温度下的晶格涨落、声子散射和声子辅助电子跃迁，难以真实刻画shift current的产生。
AI.method: 将特殊位移技术与基于动力学Berry相的实时模拟结合，在时域非线性光学响应中自然引入声子散射与声子辅助跃迁，计算有限温度下的shift current；以无反转对称且间接带隙的单层六方AlN为代表性体系。
AI.result: 该方法可直接获得有限温度下包含晶格涨落的非线性光响应；对单层h-AlN的计算表明声子介导过程显著，温度会改变shift current的幅度和光谱特征。
AI.conclusion: 声子辅助过程和温度效应对于层状材料中shift current的定量与光谱描述不可或缺，该框架可用于第一性原理预测有限温度非线性光电流并可实验检验。

title: Chemistry-resolved disagreement between Materials Project-compatible PBE(+U) and r2SCAN stability verdicts in the GNoME materials database
summary:
GNoME's stability labels rest on a Materials Project-compatible GGA/GGA+U workflow. Its authors report that 84% of discovered binaries and ternaries retain a negative decomposition energy under r2SCAN and 86.8% of tested quaternaries remain stable on the r2SCAN hull. We resolve that aggregate by chemistry over the 139,541 GNoME materials released with r2SCAN recomputations, a subset the dataset authors selected rather than sampled, using cluster bootstrap intervals over 8,429 structural-prototype proxy clusters.
  The aggregate conceals a 26.7-point spread at fixed element count, from 4.0% [3.3, 4.7] for plain quaternary intermetallics (no lanthanide, no 3d metal) to 30.7% [27.7, 33.8] for lanthanide-free 3d-containing quaternary oxides, a pair identified post hoc against a prospectively fixed threshold. Under our reading of the release's "All" reference set the two cells sit at 14.5% and 37.4%, preserving a 22.9-point spread. Presence of a Materials Project Hubbard-U-list element is strongly associated with disagreement, conditional on the other covariates, in a model over all 139,541 materials (cluster-robust odds ratio 3.45 [3.13, 3.80]). Neither selective U application nor hull proximity explains the association away: disagreement stays elevated outside the U-treated regime, and a natural cubic spline in the continuous PBE decomposition energy moves the odds ratio in the 117,018-material model only from 3.53 to 3.43 [3.07, 3.83]. For allocating a verification budget, composition supplements hull proximity rather than replacing it: over held-out cluster splits at a 20% budget, the two together surface 45.8% of disagreements against 40.4% for hull distance alone. An exploratory comparison against previously catalogued materials changes direction between populations. We measure disagreement between two workflows, not accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该文按化学组成分解GNoME的139,541个r2SCAN重算材料的稳定性一致性，发现总体稳定率掩盖了巨大化学差异；Hubbard-U元素与GGA/GGA+U→r2SCAN分歧强相关，成分信息可补充hull距离用于验证预算分配。
AI.motivation: GNoME的稳定性标签基于Materials Project兼容的GGA/GGA+U流程，作者报告r2SCAN下高比例材料仍稳定，但聚合数字可能掩盖不同化学子类的系统差异；需要按化学空间解析，并检验Hubbard-U应用和hull邻近性是否能解释工作流分歧。
AI.method: 使用GNoME发布的139,541个带r2SCAN重算材料（作者选定而非抽样），以8,429个结构原型代理簇做cluster bootstrap；按固定元素数和化学类别分层比较稳定率；用cluster-robust模型检验Hubbard-U元素关联，控制PBE分解能自然立方样条等协变量；并通过held-out cluster splits评估20%验证预算下“成分+hull距离”与仅hull距离的分歧筛选效果。
AI.result: 固定元素数下稳定率跨度达26.7个百分点：普通四元金属间化合物（无镧系、无3d金属）为4.0% [3.3, 4.7]，无镧系含3d金属四元氧化物为30.7% [27.7, 33.8]；该对比对在预设阈值下事后识别。按发布版“All”参考集，两格为14.5%和37.4%，仍保留22.9个百分点跨度。Hubbard-U元素存在与分歧强相关，cluster-robust OR=3.45 [3.13, 3.80]；排除选择性U处理或加入PBE分解能样条后仍高（117,018材料模型中OR从3.53变为3.43 [3.07, 3.83]）。20%预算下，成分+hull距离发现45.8%分歧，仅hull距离为40.4%。与既有目录材料的探索性比较在不同population间方向改变；研究衡量的是两工作流间分歧，而非准确性。
AI.conclusion: GNoME的总体稳定率不能代表各化学子类；Hubbard-U应用与GGA/GGA+U和r2SCAN间分歧密切相关，且不能由选择性U处理或hull邻近性完全解释；分配验证预算时，成分应补充而非替代hull距离。结果反映工作流分歧，不评价绝对预测精度。

title: On the Doppler Effect in Static Materials: Vortices and Black, White and Worm-Hole Like Wave Trajectories
summary: We demonstrate the Doppler effect in a static material. The effect is achieved with a network of thin waveguides whose lengths depend on the direction of travel, chosen to simulate the compression and expansion of the wave experienced by a source travelling with velocity $v$. Each edge of length $\ell$ becomes a pair of waveguides of lengths $\ell/(1\mp v/c)$, one for each direction of travel. On a lattice this gives the field pattern of a moving source. To demonstrate the effect, we design a vortex, an analogue black hole and wormhole.

AI.tldr: 该文在静态材料中利用方向依赖长度的波导网络模拟运动源产生的多普勒效应，并据此设计涡旋、类比黑洞和虫洞。
AI.motivation: 在不实际移动源或介质的条件下，复现运动源所经历的波压缩与膨胀及多普勒频移，为相关波动和类比引力现象提供静态平台。
AI.method: 将网络中每条长度为ℓ的边替换为两条方向相反的波导，其长度分别为ℓ/(1∓v/c)，以模拟以速度v运动源的多普勒效应；在晶格上叠加后得到运动源的场分布。
AI.result: 成功在静态材料中演示多普勒效应，并设计出涡旋、类比黑洞和类比虫洞等场结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过按传播方向设计波导长度，可在静态结构中等效实现运动源的多普勒物理及类比引力模型。

title: Evolution of microstructure and crystallographic texture in a novel Zr-4Nb-2Al alloy during hot rotary swaging
summary: A multi-step induction-assisted hot rotary swaging route was developed for the novel dual-phase Zr-4Nb-2Al alloy to investigate the evolution of microstructure, crystallographic texture, and mechanical properties during sequential deformation. Phase-transformation temperatures determined by electrical resistivity measurements were used to select processing conditions in the single-phase $\beta$ field at 880{\deg}C and the $\alpha+\beta$ field at 780{\deg}C. Induction heating with thermographic temperature control enabled reduction of the initial 12 mm rod to 6.3 mm, corresponding to a total area reduction of 72%. Swaging in the $\beta$ field refined millimetre-sized prior-$\beta$ grains to approximately 100 $\mu$m, while subsequent cooling produced a fine lamellar $\alpha+\beta$ microstructure. Further deformation in the $\alpha+\beta$ field disrupted the lamellar structure, promoted globularisation and recrystallisation of the $\alpha$ phase, and refined the $\beta$ phase. The microstructural evolution was accompanied by a pronounced $\langle 11\bar{2}0\rangle_{\alpha}\parallel\mathrm{SD}$ fibre texture in the $\alpha$ phase, whereas the $\beta$ phase exhibited predominantly $\langle 110\rangle_{\beta}\parallel\mathrm{SD}$ together with a $\langle 111\rangle_{\beta}\parallel\mathrm{SD}$ component. The phase constitution remained comparatively stable, with approximately 12-15 wt.% retained $\beta$ throughout processing. Subsequent $\alpha+\beta$ swaging decreased the compressive yield strength from 1103 to 839 MPa while increasing plastic deformability, with a maximum fracture strain of 32%. Radial hardness heterogeneity was progressively eliminated. These results demonstrate that induction-assisted rotary swaging in selected phase fields provides an effective route for tailoring microstructure, texture, and mechanical response in dual-phase zirconium alloys.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了多步感应加热辅助热旋锻工艺，用于双相Zr-4Nb-2Al合金，系统调控其组织、织构与力学性能。
AI.motivation: 双相锆合金在热变形中的组织、织构和性能演化复杂，需要通过选定相区进行多步热旋锻以实现显微组织与力学响应的可控 tailoring。
AI.method: 通过电阻率测定相变温度，选择880°C单相β区和780°C α+β区进行感应加热热旋锻；将初始12 mm棒材减至6.3 mm，总面积减缩72%，并表征组织、织构、相组成、压缩性能与硬度。
AI.result: β区旋锻将毫米级原始β晶粒细化至约100 μm，冷却后形成细层片状α+β组织；α+β区变形破坏层片、促进α相球化和再结晶并细化β相。α相形成显著⟨11-20⟩α∥SD纤维织构，β相以⟨110⟩β∥SD为主并含⟨111⟩β∥SD组分；保留β相约12–15 wt.%。后续α+β旋锻使压缩屈服强度由1103 MPa降至839 MPa，最大断裂应变达32%，径向硬度不均匀性逐步消除。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在选定相区进行感应加热辅助旋锻可有效调控双相锆合金的显微组织、织构和力学响应。

title: Winding-Controlled Topological Descendants of Antialtermagnets
summary: Odd-parity spin splitting constrains magnetic band crossings but does not determine their topological descendants. We show that the Chern contribution of an isolated inverted sector is controlled by the phase winding of its transverse mass pair: when the masses and tangential velocities reverse together, contributions from successive Dirac points add rather than cancel. This distinguishes topological winding from the polynomial degree labeling the magnetic parent. For specified complementary masses, periodic tetragonal $h$- and hexagonal $j$-wave models host eight and twelve same-chirality Weyl points on a momentum plane, with gapped-slice Chern numbers $|C|=4$ and $6$, respectively. A microscopic four-band $p$-wave model identifies an antiunitary obstruction to first-order transverse masses and demonstrates a symmetry-broken $C=1$ phase at quarter filling. First-principles calculations for the proposed coplanar spin-vortex texture of LaMnAu$_5$ reveal the $h$-wave nodal pattern, its anisotropic spin--orbit reconstruction, and a mirror-channel spectral response that reverses under opposite spin rotations. Together, these results distinguish the symmetry of an odd-parity magnetic parent from the mass structure controlling the topology of its descendants.

AI.tldr: 奇宇称自旋劈裂只约束磁性能带交叉，并不决定其拓扑后代；孤立反转扇区的Chern贡献由其横向质量对的相位绕数控制，当质量与切向速度同时反号时，连续Dirac点的贡献相加而非抵消。
AI.motivation: 区分奇宇称磁性母态的对称性/多项式阶数与真正控制后代拓扑的质量缠绕结构，澄清磁性能带交叉如何产生Weyl点及非零Chern数。
AI.method: 构建周期性四方h波与六角j波模型，解析横向质量对的相位绕数与Chern贡献；建立微观四能带p波模型分析反幺正阻碍及四分之一填充相；对LaMnAu5的共面自旋涡旋织构进行第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 在指定互补质量下，h波和j波模型在动量平面上分别具有8个和12个同手性Weyl点，其有隙切片Chern数为|C|=4和6；p波模型给出对一阶横向质量的反幺正阻碍，并在四分之一填充实现对称破缺的C=1相；LaMnAu5计算揭示h波节点图案、各向异性自旋轨道重构，以及相反自旋旋转下反转的镜像通道谱响应。
AI.conclusion: 奇宇称磁性母态的对称性不足以确定其后代拓扑；横向质量对的相位绕数及质量结构才是控制Weyl点手性、Chern数与谱响应的关键，从而为区分母态对称性与拓扑后代提供判据。

title: Exploring Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Representation Learning of Powder X-ray Diffraction Patterns
summary: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) is the primary high-throughput method for resolving crystal structures, a cornerstone of materials science. As high-throughput synthesis and self-driving laboratories advance, automated XRD pattern analysis has become vital for accelerating materials discovery. However, traditional matrix factorization methods fail when lattice variations cause non-linear peak shifts. At the same time, supervised learning approaches face a combinatorial explosion when handling multi-phase mixtures. To overcome these challenges, we adopt a self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to learn representation embeddings from 1D diffraction patterns. By optimizing a masked self-prediction loss directly within the latent space, the framework captures high-level crystallographic semantics. Downstream evaluations show that lightweight attentive probes trained on frozen JEPA representations achieve space group classification and lattice parameter estimation accuracy close to much larger supervised vision transformers. Furthermore, latent probing reveals that the learned representation space naturally organizes physical transformations, isolating smooth trajectories for peak broadening. Interestingly, decoding along latent paths between single-phase crystal representations yields realistic multi-phase mixture patterns, demonstrating an emergent continuous structure learned without explicit multi-phase supervision.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用自监督JEPA从一维粉末XRD图谱学习潜空间表示，以解决晶格变化导致的非线性峰移和多相混合的组合爆炸问题，并展示其在空间群分类、晶格参数估计及多相图谱生成上的潜力。
AI.motivation: 高通量合成与自驱动实验室需要自动化XRD解析；传统矩阵分解难以处理非线性的峰位偏移，监督学习在多相混合物上又面临组合爆炸。
AI.method: 采用自监督联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），对一维衍射图谱进行潜空间中的掩码自预测训练，学习高层晶体学语义表示；随后在冻结表示上训练轻量注意力探针进行下游任务，并分析潜空间结构。
AI.result: 基于冻结JEPA表示的轻量探针在空间群分类和晶格参数估计上接近更大的监督视觉Transformer；潜空间能自然组织物理变换并分离峰展宽的平滑轨迹；在单相晶体表示间沿潜路径解码可生成真实的多相混合图谱。
AI.conclusion: JEPA式自监督潜空间学习可有效捕获XRD晶体学语义，并在无显式多相监督下涌现连续结构表示，为自动化XRD分析和材料发现提供新途径。

title: First-Principles Investigation of the Structural, Electronic, Optical, Elastic, and Thermoelectric Properties of X2MoSeO6 (X = K, Rb, Cs)
summary: Understanding how alkali-metal substitution influences the coupled physical properties of molybdenum selenite oxides is essential for establishing their composition-structure-property relationships. Although the lighter members of the X2MoSeO6 family have been investigated, the heavier alkali-metal compounds remain comparatively unexplored, particularly regarding their integrated electronic, mechanical, optical, and thermoelectric responses. Here, a comprehensive first-principles investigation of X2MoSeO6 (X = K, Rb, and Cs) is presented using density functional theory and semi-classical Boltzmann transport calculations. The optimized structures exhibit progressive unit-cell expansion with increasing alkali-metal ionic size, while their indirect electronic bandgaps vary non-monotonically, reaching 2.646, 2.216, and 2.427 eV for K2MoSeO6, Rb2MoSeO6, and Cs2MoSeO6, respectively. All three structures satisfy the elastic stability criteria, with Hill-averaged bulk moduli increasing from 16.332 to 20.975 GPa across the series. K2MoSeO6 exhibits the strongest elastic anisotropy, whereas Rb2MoSeO6 possesses the highest static electronic dielectric constant (4.614) and maximum absorption coefficient (2.291*106 cm-1). Thermoelectric calculations reveal pronounced carrier-polarity-dependent behavior, with Rb2MoSeO6 attaining a positive Seebeck coefficient of 390.55e-6 V/K at 100 K and an electronic-only figure of merit (ZTe) of 7.286 at 300 K under the selected positive-Seebeck condition. By extending the investigation to the K-Rb-Cs series, this work establishes a comparative foundation for understanding and further exploring the functional characteristics of molybdenum selenite oxides.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理与半经典玻尔兹曼输运计算系统比较了X2MoSeO6（X=K、Rb、Cs）的电子、力学、光学和热电性质，建立了重碱金属取代对钼硒酸盐氧化物物性调控的比较基础。
AI.motivation: 理解碱金属取代如何影响钼硒酸盐氧化物的耦合物理性质，对建立其成分-结构-性质关系至关重要；轻碱金属成员已有研究，而K、Rb、Cs系列尤其是其电子、力学、光学与热电综合响应仍缺乏系统探索。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论进行结构优化和电子性质计算，并结合半经典玻尔兹曼输运计算评估热电性能；对X2MoSeO6（X=K、Rb、Cs）进行综合第一性原理研究。
AI.result: 随碱金属离子半径增大，晶胞逐步膨胀；间接带隙呈非单调变化，分别为K2MoSeO6 2.646 eV、Rb2MoSeO6 2.216 eV、Cs2MoSeO6 2.427 eV。三者均满足弹性稳定性判据，Hill平均体模量由16.332 GPa增至20.975 GPa；K2MoSeO6弹性各向异性最强，Rb2MoSeO6具有最高静态电子介电常数4.614和最大吸收系数2.291×10^6 cm^-1。热电性质呈显著载流子极性依赖，Rb2MoSeO6在100 K下正Seebeck系数达390.55×10^-6 V/K，并在所选正Seebeck条件下于300 K获得电子-only ZTe为7.286。
AI.conclusion: 通过扩展至K-Rb-Cs系列，该工作为理解和进一步探索钼硒酸盐氧化物的功能特性提供了比较性基础。

title: Phonon-Dressed Quasiparticles in Epitaxial Scandium Nitride Resolved by Soft X-ray ARPES
summary: Electron-phonon interactions govern quasiparticle energies, lifetimes, and temperature-dependent band structures in semiconductors. However, direct momentum-resolved experimental evidence of their impact on quasiparticle electronic structure remains scarce, particularly in nitride semiconductors. Here, we present conclusive experimental evidence of electron-phonon interaction-induced quasiparticle renormalization and pronounced spectral broadening in p-type scandium nitride (ScN), using soft x-ray angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. First-principles spectral-function calculations due to electron-phonon coupling reproduce the measured spectra, capturing a pronounced quasiparticle kink ~2.3 eV below the valence-band maximum, phonon satellite features arising from long-range electron-phonon coupling, and a direct bandgap zero-point renormalization of -124.3 meV within the non-adiabatic Allen-Heine-Cardona approach. We further show that the anomalous temperature-induced increase in the direct bandgap in ScN originates from the combined effects of thermal expansion and electron-phonon coupling, contributing comparably near room temperature. Our results establish ScN as a model platform for visualizing electron-phonon coupling and provide a quantitative benchmark for predictive first-principles descriptions of quasiparticle renormalization in semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用软X射线角分辨光电子能谱与第一性原理谱函数计算，在p型氮化钪中直接观测并定量解释了电子-声子耦合导致的准粒子重整化、谱线展宽和带隙零点重整化。
AI.motivation: 电子-声子耦合决定半导体的准粒子能量、寿命和温度依赖能带结构，但尤其在氮化物半导体中，动量分辨的直接实验证据仍然稀缺。
AI.method: 采用软X射线角分辨光电子能谱测量p型ScN的动量分辨电子结构，并结合电子-声子耦合驱动的第一性原理谱函数计算，以及非绝热Allen-Heine-Cardona方法计算带隙零点重整化。
AI.result: 实验与计算共同揭示了价带顶以下约2.3 eV处的显著准粒子拐点、由长程电子-声子耦合产生的声子卫星峰，以及直接带隙零点重整化为-124.3 meV；同时表明ScN中温度升高导致直接带隙异常增大的现象源于热膨胀与电子-声子耦合的共同作用，二者在室温附近贡献相当。
AI.conclusion: ScN被确立为可视化电子-声子耦合的模型平台，并为半导体准粒子重整化的预测性第一性原理描述提供了定量基准。

title: First-order magnetostructural transition in Ni-Mn-Sn powder - A matter of particle and grain size
summary: In Ni-Mn-based Heusler alloys, the magnetocaloric effect originates from a first-order magnetostructural transition (FOMST). However, the influence of particle and grain size on thermal hysteresis, transition width, and nucleation and growth mechanism remains poorly understood, as mechanical grinding can introduce residual stresses and processing-induced defects. In this study, we examined the size dependence of the FOMST in gas-atomized Ni-Mn-Sn powder by combining microstructural characterization with temperature-dependent XRD, magnetometry, calorimetry and single-particle measurements, enabling decoupling of size dependence from processing-related influences. We observed a pronounced size dependence of the transition ranges (Ms-Mf) and (Af-As), which decrease with decreasing particle size and approach zero for single-crystalline particles below ~20-30 micrometer. The thermal hysteresis decreases with increasing particle size, reaching a lower limit of 17 K for large polycrystalline particles above 100 micrometer. EBSD reveals a nearly constant grain size, implying a transition from polycrystalline to single-crystalline particles as particle size decreases. In polycrystalline particles, multiple grains transform gradually over an extended temperature interval because grain boundaries act as barriers to the progression of transformation. In contrast, single-grain particles lack preferred nucleation sites, resulting in larger hysteresis, while the absence of barriers to transformation propagation causes the entire particle to transform in a narrow range. These results demonstrate that the size dependence of the FOMST is governed by the interplay between particle size, grain boundaries, and the free particle surface.

AI.tldr: 本文利用气雾化Ni-Mn-Sn粉末并结合多尺度表征，系统研究了一级磁结构相变（FOMST）的尺寸依赖性，并阐明颗粒尺寸、晶界与自由表面对相变行为及热滞后的共同调控机制。
AI.motivation: Ni-Mn基Heusler合金的磁热效应源于FOMST，但颗粒与晶粒尺寸对热滞后、相变温区以及形核-长大机制的影响尚不清楚；机械研磨会引入残余应力和加工缺陷，难以区分本征尺寸效应与加工影响。
AI.method: 以气雾化Ni-Mn-Sn粉末为对象，结合显微结构表征、变温XRD、磁测量、量热分析和单颗粒测量，将尺寸依赖性与加工相关因素解耦。
AI.result: 相变温区(Ms-Mf)和(Af-As)随颗粒尺寸减小而降低，并在约20-30微米以下的单晶颗粒中趋近于零；热滞后随颗粒尺寸增大而减小，100微米以上大多晶颗粒达到约17 K的下限。EBSD显示晶粒尺寸基本不变，表明颗粒减小伴随多晶向单晶转变。多晶颗粒中晶界阻碍相变扩展，使多个晶粒在较宽温区内逐步转变；单晶颗粒缺乏优先形核位点导致较大热滞后，但无转变扩展势垒使整个颗粒在窄温区内转变。
AI.conclusion: FOMST的尺寸依赖性由颗粒尺寸、晶界和自由颗粒表面之间的相互作用共同决定。

title: Effect of niobium doping on the local structure and oxidation state of Co atoms in SrTiO$_3$
summary: XAFS spectroscopy combined with first-principles calculations are used to study SrTiO$_3$ samples simultaneously doped with cobalt and niobium. It is shown that additional doping of the samples with Nb donors results in a decrease in the oxidation state of cobalt atoms to +2, which is accompanied by an increase in the Co--O distance to the nearest oxygen atoms, in agreement with first-principles calculations. The impurity Co atoms are shown to occupy Ti sites and are on-center. The suppression of the oxygen-vacancy formation upon doping SrTiO$_3$(Co) with niobium was revealed. First-principles calculations indicate that the Coulomb interaction of ions with local electric fields generated by non-isoelectronic Nb impurities plays a decisive role in the local distortions of atomic positions observed around the cobalt atom in the unit cell. The possibility of controlling the magnetic moment of Co atoms by intentional change in the lattice parameter is demonstrated.

AI.tldr: 结合XAFS与第一性原理计算表明，Nb施主共掺杂使SrTiO3(Co)中Co价态降至+2、Co-O距离增大、抑制氧空位，并可通过改变晶格参数调控Co磁矩。
AI.motivation: 研究SrTiO3中Co与Nb共掺杂对Co局域结构、价态、氧空位及磁性的影响，并阐明Nb杂质引起的局域畸变机制。
AI.method: 采用XAFS光谱结合第一性原理计算，分析Co/Nb共掺杂SrTiO3中Co的价态、占位、Co-O距离、氧空位形成及局域晶格畸变。
AI.result: Nb施主掺杂使Co价态降低至+2，Co-O最近邻距离增大，与计算一致；Co占据Ti位且位于中心；Nb掺杂抑制氧空位形成；计算表明非等电子Nb杂质产生的局域电场与离子的库仑相互作用是Co周围局域畸变的关键；改变晶格参数可调控Co磁矩。
AI.conclusion: SrTiO3(Co,Nb)的局域结构、缺陷化学和磁性可由Nb共掺杂及晶格参数有效调控，局域电场驱动的离子库仑相互作用是理解其畸变的重要机制。

title: Harnessing Electrostructural Bistability to Control Defects in Polarizable Materials
summary: Structural defects are central to the functionalities of materials. However, conventional approaches to defect control are often slow and imprecise.
