This work identifies and characterizes a distinct physical phenomenon of electrostructural bistability that provides a rapid and precise pathway for engineering materials with defect-controlled physical properties. A generalized theory of conductivity bistability is developed and experimentally validated to unify two distinct regimes: previously reported electrothermal bistability in weakly polarizable insulators, such as silicon, and electrostructural bistability in strongly polarizable materials, such as TiO$_2$. In agreement with the theory, experiments on TiO$_2$ demonstrate that bulk-homogeneous defect concentrations in electrostructurally bistable materials can be tuned rapidly and deterministically by controlling applied electric current. Abruptly interrupting the current quenches the system into long-lived, room-temperature metastable states with distinct properties. This establishes a practical, rapid, and scalable pathway for defect engineering with direct relevance to nonvolatile memory devices.

AI.tldr: 提出并表征“电结构双稳态”现象，建立广义电导双稳态理论，并在TiO2中实现快速、确定性的体均匀缺陷调控及室温亚稳态，面向非易失存储器。
AI.motivation: 传统缺陷控制方法通常缓慢且不精确，亟需一种快速、精确且可扩展的缺陷工程路径来调控材料物理性质。
AI.method: 建立广义电导双稳态理论，统一弱极化绝缘体（如硅）中的电热双稳态与强极化材料（如TiO2）中的电结构双稳态；并在TiO2中通过控制外加电流进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明TiO2中体均匀缺陷浓度可由电流快速、确定性地调节；突然中断电流可使系统淬灭至具有不同性质的长寿命室温亚稳态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了实用、快速、可扩展的缺陷工程路径，对非易失存储器件具有直接意义。

title: First-Principles-Informed Modeling of Thermal Transport and Laser-Induced Heating in Ultrahigh-Temperature Carbides
summary: Using first-principles density functional theory and Boltzmann transport calculations, we systematically investigate the electronic structure, lattice and electronic thermal transport, optical response, and laser-induced heating of ultrahigh-temperature carbides (UHTCs), including Group IV (TiC, ZrC, and HfC) and Group V carbides (VC, NbC, and TaC), and SiC. The transition-metal carbides (TMCs) exhibit metallic electronic structures, whereas SiC exhibits semiconducting character. The calculated thermal transport properties reveal distinct contributions from phonons and electrons, with electronic heat transport becoming increasingly important at elevated temperatures in TMCs. The Group V carbides exhibit substantially lower lattice thermal conductivity than their Group IV counterparts, accompanied by pronounced Kohn anomalies and modified phonon dispersions associated with their distinct electronic structures, suggesting a possible connection between Fermi-surface topology, phonon dynamics, and lattice thermal transport. In contrast, SiC exhibits comparatively high lattice thermal conductivity, consistent with its long-lived acoustic phonons, but no electronic contribution due to its semiconducting nature. Optical calculations reveal relatively high reflectivity in the visible and infrared spectral ranges for the metallic carbides, whereas SiC exhibits lower reflectivity in the infrared region. Finally, one-dimensional and three-dimensional continuum heat-conduction models are employed to compare the thermal responses of these materials under specified laser irradiation conditions. The predicted temperature distributions depend on the thermal and optical properties of the materials as well as the specimen geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理DFT与玻尔兹曼输运计算系统研究了TiC、ZrC、HfC、VC、NbC、TaC和SiC的电子结构、晶格与电子热输运、光学响应及激光诱导加热，并结合1D/3D连续热传导模型比较其热响应。
AI.motivation: 超高温碳化物在极端热环境和激光辐照下的热管理与光学行为需要从电子、声子及宏观传热多尺度理解，尤其需区分金属性过渡金属碳化物与半导体SiC的差异。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论和玻尔兹曼输运计算电子结构、晶格与电子热导率及光学性质；再用一维和三维连续热传导模型模拟特定激光辐照下的温度分布。
AI.result: 过渡金属碳化物呈金属性，SiC呈半导体性；TMCs中电子热输运在高温下愈发重要。Group V碳化物晶格热导率显著低于Group IV，并伴随明显Kohn异常和声子色散改变；SiC因长寿命声子具有较高晶格热导率且无电子热导贡献。金属碳化物在可见光和红外区反射率较高，SiC红外反射率较低。激光加热温度分布取决于材料热学/光学性质及样品几何。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了费米面拓扑、声子动力学与晶格热输运之间的可能联系，并表明电子/声子贡献、光学反射和样品几何共同决定UHTC及SiC的激光热响应，为其热管理和极端环境应用提供依据。

title: Annealing-atmosphere control of paramagnetic defects in ZnO microparticles
summary: In this work, we used temperature-dependent electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy to reveal the effect of high-temperature annealing in N2 and air on paramagnetic and electronic properties of ZnO microparticles. EPR spectral simulations have shown that N2 annealing produces Zni, VO+, and shallow-donor centers, whereas Zni, VO+, and Hi-related centers are observed after annealing the ZnO microparticles in an air atmosphere. The resolved paramagnetic centers exhibit distinctly different behavior over 5-297 K. The shallow-donor and Hi signals are rapidly quenched below approximately 50 K, while the Zni contribution shows a nonmonotonic temperature dependence. In contrast, the VO+ signal persists up to room temperature and increases with temperature, consistent with charge redistribution among donor-related defects involving deep oxygen-vacancy states. The cavity Q-factor generally decreases with increasing temperature for both annealed samples, indicating atmosphere-dependent changes in the microwave losses. These results show that the annealing atmosphere controls the paramagnetic defect population, the temperature dependence of donor-related centers, and the associated electronic response of ZnO microparticles.

AI.tldr: 该文利用变温EPR谱及谱模拟揭示了N2和空气高温退火对ZnO微颗粒中顺磁缺陷种类、温度行为及电子响应的影响。
AI.motivation: 研究不同退火气氛如何调控ZnO微颗粒的顺磁中心和电子性质，并区分N2与空气退火产生的缺陷类型及其热行为。
AI.method: 采用5–297 K变温电子顺磁共振（EPR）光谱并结合EPR谱模拟，分析N2和空气退火ZnO微颗粒中的顺磁中心，同时考察腔体Q因子随温度的变化。
AI.result: N2退火产生Zni、VO+和浅施主中心；空气退火产生Zni、VO+和Hi相关中心。浅施主和Hi信号约在50 K以下快速猝灭，Zni呈非单调温度依赖，VO+信号持续至室温并随温度升高而增强，符合涉及深氧空位态的施主相关缺陷间电荷再分布。两种退火样品的腔体Q因子总体随温度升高而下降，表明微波损耗随退火气氛变化。
AI.conclusion: 退火气氛控制ZnO微颗粒的顺磁缺陷布居、施主相关中心的温度依赖以及相应的电子响应。

title: Deep Scientific Reasoning under Physical Constraints: Structure-Aware Spectrum Prediction
summary: Structured scientific spectra encode rich physical information while obeying hard constraints, such as conservation laws and characteristic spectral geometry. Accurate prediction of these spectra is central to materials discovery, yet existing methods often treat them as unconstrained sequences and therefore fail to enforce the underlying physical structure. Taking electronic density of states (eDOS) as the prototypical example, we introduce DeepSciReasoner, a general paradigm for predicting scientific spectra under physical constraints. The framework combines structure-aware spectrum decoding with constraint-preserving physical reasoning, allowing predictions to capture rich spectral structure while respecting the underlying physics. We evaluate DeepSciReasoner on eDOS, phonon density of states (phDOS), X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES), and Raman spectra, where it substantially improves prediction accuracy while maintaining physical consistency. These results establish DeepSciReasoner as a reusable blueprint for structured scientific spectrum prediction under hard physical constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeepSciReasoner 通用框架，在硬物理约束下预测科学谱，并在多类谱任务中提升准确性且保持物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 科学谱编码丰富物理信息并受守恒律和特征谱几何等硬约束，但现有方法常将其视为无约束序列，难以保证底层物理结构。
AI.method: 该框架结合结构感知谱解码与约束保持的物理推理，以电子态密度 eDOS 为原型，实现兼顾丰富谱结构与物理约束的预测。
AI.result: 在 eDOS、声子态密度 phDOS、XANES 和拉曼谱上，DeepSciReasoner 显著提高预测精度并保持物理一致性。
AI.conclusion: DeepSciReasoner 可作为硬物理约束下结构化科学谱预测的可复用通用蓝图。

title: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
summary: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates, as used by deep generative CSP baselines. TCSP3.0 achieves Top-1 and Top-20 match rates of 72.2% and 90.6% on T180, compared with 28.3% and 45.6% for TCSP2.0, and a Top-20 match rate of 74.0% on a new 800-target benchmark (T800). On T180 it also outperforms PNcsp+ and deep generative models CrystalFlow and MaskGXT (Top-1 72.2% versus at most 63.9%). Even without relaxation, TCSP3.0 reaches 67.8% at Top-1 and 90.6% at Top-20 in a median of 28 s per target on two CPU cores, about ten times faster than CrystalFlow. Paired ten-arm ablations on T180 and T800 show that most of the improvement comes from the correctness fixes; structural deduplication significantly improves the Top-5 match rate, embedding-based retrieval is required for coverage, and the remaining scoring features have small or null effects.

AI.tldr: TCSP3.0 修正了 TCSP2.0 中元素映射与顺序文本替换导致的成分错误，并加入检索、评分、去重及 ORB-v3 机器学习势弛豫排序，大幅提升模板基晶体结构预测的匹配率。
AI.motivation: 模板基 CSP 的准确性依赖模板检索、元素映射和候选排序；审计 TCSP2.0 在 T180 上发现 2347 个选中结构中有 469 个（20%）成分错误，原因是映射忽略化学计量系数且顺序文本替换会级联或破坏元素符号。
AI.method: 提出 TCSP3.0：强制保持化学计量系数的元素映射，在解析后的结构上同时替换元素，并验证每个候选的成分与晶胞；额外加入周期序检索、软氧化态证据、半径兼容性评分、结构去重，以及 ORB-v3 机器学习势弛豫和能量排序。
AI.result: 在 T180 上 Top-1/Top-20 匹配率为 72.2%/90.6%，TCSP2.0 为 28.3%/45.6%；在新 T800 基准上 Top-20 为 74.0%。T180 上 Top-1 超过 PNcsp+、CrystalFlow 和 MaskGXT（72.2% 对最高 63.9%）。无弛豫时仍达 Top-1 67.8%、Top-20 90.6%，双 CPU 核中位耗时 28 秒/目标，约比 CrystalFlow 快十倍。T180/T800 的十臂配对消融显示改进主要来自正确性修复；结构去重显著提升 Top-5，embedding 检索对覆盖必要，其余评分特征影响小或无影响。
AI.conclusion: TCSP3.0 的核心收益来自修复成分与替换错误；结构去重和 embedding 检索分别对 Top-5 与覆盖有明确作用，而多数附加评分特征贡献有限。

title: Spin and Charge Photocurrents from Electric-Magnetic Dipole Interference in Centrosymmetric Crystals
summary: A common view regarding even-order nonlinear optical (NLO) effects, such as second-harmonic generation and the bulk photovoltaic effect, is that the breaking of inversion symmetry is necessary. However, this view relies on the assumption that light interacts with materials solely through its electric field. Here, we demonstrate that interference between the electric and magnetic components of the same light field can induce even-order NLO effects even in centrosymmetric materials. Using charge and spin photocurrents as prototypical examples, we present a unified microscopic theory showing how such electric-magnetic dipole interference (EMDI) drives NLO responses in inversion-symmetric crystals. Bilinear in both electric and magnetic fields, these responses scale linearly with light intensity. Combining symmetry analysis with first-principles calculations, we decompose the EMDI-induced photocurrents into shift-like and injection-like contributions and classify their dependence on crystal symmetry, time-reversal symmetry, and light polarization. Notably, we reveal that these EMDI-induced responses in centrosymmetric materials are weaker than conventional responses in non-centrosymmetric materials roughly by a factor of fine structure constant $\alpha \approx [10^{-3}\text{--}10^{-2}] $. Nevertheless, they remain well within experimental reach. Our work thus unlocks NLO functionalities in centrosymmetric materials for e.g., materials characterization, photonics and optoelectronics. This is vital given that many functionally importantly materials, such as cubic Si and cubic $\mathrm{SrTiO_3}$, possess inversion symmetry.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并证明：即使材料具有反演对称性，同一光场的电场与磁场分量之间的干涉（EMDI）也可诱导偶数阶非线性光学效应，如电荷与自旋光电流；其响应与光强成线性关系，虽比非中心对称材料中的常规响应弱约精细结构常数 α≈10^-3–10^-2，但仍具实验可探测性。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为二次谐波产生、体光伏效应等偶数阶非线性光学效应必须打破反演对称性，但这基于光仅通过电场与材料相互作用的假设；作者希望突破该限制，在中心对称材料中实现偶数阶非线性光学功能。
AI.method: 构建统一的微观理论，以电荷和自旋光电流为原型，研究电磁偶极干涉（EMDI）如何在反演对称晶体中驱动非线性响应；结合对称性分析与第一性原理计算，将 EMDI 诱导光电流分解为 shift-like 与 injection-like 贡献，并分类其对面内晶体对称性、时间反演对称性和光偏振的依赖。
AI.result: EMDI 响应是电场与磁场的双线性项，因此随光强线性变化；在中心对称材料中可产生偶数阶非线性光学响应。其强度比非中心对称材料中的常规响应弱约精细结构常数 α≈10^-3–10^-2，但仍处于实验可及范围。
AI.conclusion: 该工作打破了“偶数阶非线性光学必须依赖反演对称性破缺”的常规认识，为中心对称材料（如立方 Si、立方 SrTiO3）的材料表征、光子学和光电子学应用解锁了非线性光学功能。

title: Interfacial Orbital Rashba Edelstein Effect Identified in CoO/Cu/Pt Trilayers
summary: We investigate the generation of orbital angular momentum currents at engineered Cu-oxide interfaces using CoO/Cu/Pt thin-film trilayers. Angular-dependent magnetoresistance measurements on samples with varying Cu interlayer thickness reveal systematic changes in both longitudinal and transverse resistance components, including a sign inversion of the signal. By systematically varying the Cu interlayer thicknesses, we disentangle the spin and orbital contributions to the magnetoresistive response. Our results show that large orbital currents originate from the interfacial orbital Rashba-Edelstein effect due to the presence of the Cu-O bonds at the CoO/Cu interface. Unlike previously studied CoO/Cu bilayers that rely on uncontrolled natural oxidation, our trilayer geometry enables reproducible and stable orbital-current generation at ambient conditions. Our results identify Cu-oxide interfaces as efficient sources of orbital angular momentum and clarify the microscopic mechanism underlying orbital current generation. Consequently, this work establishes a well-defined materials platform for all-orbitronic devices that does not require relativistic spin-orbit coupling or orbital-spin interconversion processes.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用CoO/Cu/Pt三层膜在工程化Cu-氧化物界面产生轨道角动量流，并通过改变Cu层厚度区分自旋与轨道对磁阻响应的贡献。
AI.motivation: 此前CoO/Cu双层依赖不可控自然氧化来产生轨道流，缺乏可重复性和稳定性；本文旨在构建稳定、可重复的Cu-氧化物界面轨道流源并阐明其微观机制。
AI.method: 制备不同Cu插层厚度的CoO/Cu/Pt三层膜，进行角度依赖磁电阻测量，分析纵向与横向电阻分量随Cu厚度的系统变化，以解耦自旋和轨道贡献。
AI.result: 磁阻信号随Cu厚度发生系统性变化并出现符号反转；大轨道流源于CoO/Cu界面Cu-O键诱导的界面轨道Rashba-Edelstein效应；三层膜结构在环境条件下实现可重复、稳定的轨道流产生。
AI.conclusion: Cu-氧化物界面是高效的轨道角动量源，该工作阐明了轨道流产生的微观机制，并为无需相对论自旋-轨道耦合或轨道-自旋互转换的全轨道电子学器件提供了明确的材料平台。

title: Controlling Surface Chemistry in Tin-Lead Perovskites for High-Efficiency Solar Cells
summary: Interfacial nonradiative recombination limits tin-lead perovskite photovoltaics. Here we show that neutral ethylenediamine chelates undercoordinated metals at tin-rich surfaces, weakens metal-iodide bonds, and removes excess tin, reconstructing the surface towards a stoichiometric tin-to-lead ratio. In contrast, protonated ethylenediammonium iodide initially passivates undercoordinated metal sites before undergoing defect-assisted deprotonation. Atomistic simulations reveal that subsurface iodide vacancies promote iodide migration and lower the energetic cost of deprotonation. Ethylenediamine-induced reconstruction produces stronger n-type surface character, facilitates electron extraction into C60, and suppresses interfacial nonradiative recombination, enabling methylammonium-free solar cells with a power conversion efficiency of 25.86%. Together, these distinct surface reaction pathways and the defect-assisted evolution of the passivating species underscore the importance of understanding perovskite surface chemistry for the rational design of molecular passivation strategies.

AI.tldr: 该工作揭示中性乙二胺与质子化乙二胺碘盐在锡铅钙钛矿表面遵循不同反应路径，中性乙二胺可重构富锡表面并抑制界面非辐射复合，使无甲铵电池效率达25.86%。
AI.motivation: 锡铅钙钛矿光伏受界面非辐射复合限制，需理解分子钝化剂在钙钛矿表面的化学演化以理性设计钝化策略。
AI.method: 对比中性乙二胺与质子化乙二胺碘盐的表面处理：中性乙二胺螯合欠配位金属、削弱金属-碘键并去除过量锡；质子化乙二胺碘盐先钝化欠配位金属位点，后发生缺陷辅助去质子化；结合原子尺度模拟分析 subsurface 碘空位对碘迁移和去质子化能垒的影响。
AI.result: 中性乙二胺诱导表面重构，使锡铅比趋于化学计量，增强n型表面特征，促进电子向C60提取并抑制界面非辐射复合；最终无甲铵钙钛矿太阳能电池获得25.86%的功率转换效率。
AI.conclusion: 不同表面反应路径及钝化物种的缺陷辅助演化表明，深入理解钙钛矿表面化学对合理设计分子钝化策略至关重要。

title: Edelstein Effect in Ferromagnetic Monolayers Fe3GaTe2 and Fe3GeTe2
summary: The Edelstein effect enables intrinsic current-induced spin polarization in noncentrosymmetric van der Waals magnets. Here, we compare the Edelstein responses of monolayer \ce{Fe3GaTe2} and \ce{Fe3GeTe2} using first-principles Wannier-based linear-response calculations. Despite sharing the same noncentrosymmetric $D_{3h}$ symmetry and selection rules, the two materials show markedly different time-reversal-even and -odd spin accumulations in magnitude, sign, and energy dependence. Strong responses occur mainly near $-0.4$~eV in \ce{Fe3GaTe2} and $+0.4$~eV in \ce{Fe3GeTe2}. At the intrinsic Fermi level, atom-resolved analysis shows that Ga-to-Ge substitution reverses the even contribution of the inequivalent Fe3 site for both in-plane magnetization directions and enhances its negative odd contribution, reorganizing the cancellation among atomic sites. Momentum-resolved calculations link the hole-side response of \ce{Fe3GaTe2} to a few large $\Gamma$-centered Fermi contours, whereas the electron-side response of \ce{Fe3GeTe2} involves dense Fe-$3d$ bands with strong interband contributions. The even response arises from incomplete cancellation of opposite-sign intraband Fermi-surface contributions, while the odd response originates from interband coherence between closely spaced states. Magnetization rotation reveals symmetry-constrained angular dependences with higher-order harmonics, especially in the $xz$ plane, while biaxial strain causes substantial amplitude changes and sign reversals. These results show how crystal symmetry, electronic structure, magnetization orientation, and lattice deformation govern the intrinsic Edelstein effect in \ce{Fe3$X$Te2} ($X=\mathrm{Ga},\mathrm{Ge}$).

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理Wannier线性响应比较单层Fe3GaTe2与Fe3GeTe2的本征Edelstein效应，揭示化学替换、能带结构、磁化方向和应变如何调控时间反演偶/奇自旋积累。
AI.motivation: 两种材料具有相同非中心对称D3h对称性和选择定则，但Ga/Ge替换对电流诱导自旋极化的影响机制尚不清楚，需要从原子、动量与能量分辨层面理解其差异及可调性。
AI.method: 采用基于第一性原理的Wannier线性响应计算，对比单层Fe3GaTe2和Fe3GeTe2的Edelstein响应，并进行原子分辨、动量分辨、磁化旋转和双轴应变分析。
AI.result: 两者时间反演偶和奇自旋积累在幅度、符号和能量依赖上显著不同，强响应分别主要出现在Fe3GaTe2的约-0.4 eV和Fe3GeTe2的约+0.4 eV。费米能级处Ga→Ge替换使不等价Fe3位点的偶贡献反号并增强其负奇贡献，重组原子位点间抵消；Fe3GaTe2空穴侧响应关联少数大Γ中心费米轮廓，Fe3GeTe2电子侧响应涉及密集Fe-3d能带和强带间贡献。偶响应源于异号带内费米面贡献的不完全抵消，奇响应源于近邻态间带间相干。磁化旋转呈对称约束的角依赖及高阶谐波，xz面尤著；双轴应变引起显著幅度变化和符号反转。
AI.conclusion: Fe3XTe2中的本征Edelstein效应由晶体对称性、电子结构、磁化取向和晶格形变共同决定，Ga/Ge化学替换与应变可作为调控自旋积累符号和大小的重要手段。

title: Crystal-surface polarity enables nonreciprocal transport in a centrosymmetric kagome magnet
summary: Every crystal surface breaks inversion symmetry even when the bulk is centrosymmetric, creating an intrinsic boundary polarity ($\mathbf{\mathit{P}}$). Here we show that this polarity enables zero-field nonreciprocal transport in the centrosymmetric kagome magnets TbMn$_6$Sn$_{6-x}$In$_x$. In symmetric TbMn$_6$Sn$_{4.4}$In$_{1.6}$ microdevices, opposing side surfaces exhibit second-harmonic longitudinal resistances of comparable magnitude and opposite sign. Reversing the spontaneous magnetization ($\mathbf{\mathit{M}}$) reverses both signals, whereas rotating $\mathbf{\mathit{M}}$ so that the toroidal moment $\mathbf{\mathit{P}} \times \mathbf{\mathit{M}}$ has no component along the current suppresses the response. In pristine TbMn$_6$Sn$_6$, the signal switches off across the spin-reorientation transition, providing a chemically ordered control of the same symmetry relation. Spatial potential mapping indicates that the nonlinear boundary contribution is distinct from the bulk linear conduction. Spin-orbit-coupled surface states associated with topological bands may enhance the effect. Crystal-surface polarity therefore offers a broadly applicable route to zero-field rectification in centrosymmetric magnetic conductors around room temperature.

AI.tldr: 在中心对称 kagome 磁体 TbMn6Sn6-xInx 中，晶体表面破缺反演对称产生的边界极性可实现零场非互易输运与整流。
AI.motivation: 中心对称体材料通常缺乏非互易响应；但表面必然破缺反演对称并产生内禀边界极性，作者希望利用该极性在近室温中心对称磁性导体中实现零场非互易输运。
AI.method: 制备对称 TbMn6Sn4.4In1.6 微器件，测量相对侧表面的二次谐波纵向电阻，并改变自发磁化 M 的方向；结合 pristine TbMn6Sn6 的自旋重取向转变和空间电势映射，区分边界非线性贡献与体线性电导。
AI.result: 相对侧表面二次谐波电阻幅值相当、符号相反；反转 M 使两信号同时反号；当 P×M 无电流方向分量时响应被抑制；TbMn6Sn6 中信号在自旋重取向转变处关闭；空间电势映射表明非线性边界贡献不同于体线性输运；自旋轨道耦合表面态/拓扑能带可能增强该效应。
AI.conclusion: 晶体表面极性为近室温中心对称磁性导体提供普适的零场整流与非互易输运调控途径，并可通过化学有序和磁构型控制同一对称关系。

title: Transition Metal-Anchored Newly Synthesized Aza-Triphenylene Monolayer for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution Reaction: Insights from DFT
summary: First-principles calculations were employed to explore the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) activity in two-dimensional aza-triphenylene monolayers functionalized with transition metals. Among the various metals studied, Co, Ru, and Y demonstrate outstanding catalytic efficacy, lowering the hydrogen adsorption free energy from -0.78 eV for pure aza-triphenylene to 0.05, 0.20, and 0.06 eV, respectively. Volcano plot analysis corroborates their enhanced HER activity. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations confirm thermal stability, while the electronic structure and charge transfer analysis reveal the strong catalyst-surface interaction. Metal decoration also improves the carrier mobility, particularly for Ru-functionalized aza-triphenylene. The climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations for Co-functionalized aza-triphenylene exhibit activation barriers of 1.61, 2.29, and 5.88 eV for the Volmer, Heyrovsky, and Tafel reactions, respectively, highlighting a preferred Volmer-Heyrovsky route with the Heyrovsky being the rate-determining step. These findings highlight the potential of transition-metal-functionalized aza-triphenylene as a promising platform for developing efficient HER electrocatalysts.

AI.tldr: 第一性原理计算表明，过渡金属（尤其Co、Ru、Y）功能化的二维氮杂三亚苯单层可显著优化析氢反应（HER）活性，其中Co功能化体系倾向Volmer-Heyrovsky路径且Heyrovsky为决速步。
AI.motivation: 为开发高效HER电催化剂，需要调控二维氮杂三亚苯的电子结构并提升其催化活性与载流子输运性能。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算研究过渡金属功能化氮杂三亚苯单层的HER性能，结合氢吸附自由能、火山图、从头算分子动力学、电子结构与电荷转移分析、载流子迁移率计算以及CI-NEB反应势垒计算。
AI.result: 纯氮杂三亚苯的氢吸附自由能为-0.78 eV，Co、Ru、Y功能化后分别降至0.05、0.20、0.06 eV；火山图证实活性增强，AIMD验证热稳定性，电子结构和电荷转移揭示强催化剂-表面相互作用，Ru功能化尤其改善载流子迁移率；Co功能化体系的Volmer、Heyrovsky、Tafel势垒分别为1.61、2.29、5.88 eV，表明Volmer-Heyrovsky路径更有利且Heyrovsky为决速步。
AI.conclusion: 过渡金属功能化氮杂三亚苯单层是有前景的高效HER电催化剂开发平台。

title: Phase field dislocation dynamics prediction of stacking fault widths in Cu-Al Alloys using generalised stacking fault energy from DFT and interatomic potentials
summary: The equilibrium width of intrinsic stacking faults is an important material parameter affecting key deformation phenomena. Here, we perform a comparative assessment of $\gamma$-surfaces generated using MD -- with a classical embedded-atom potential (ZW) and a machine-learned Gaussian Approximation Potential (GAP) -- and density functional theory (DFT), for Cu-Al alloys of varying Al content, and incorporate them as an energy term in PFDD simulations to obtain the equilibrium SFW. All three methods reproduce the lattice parameter and elastic moduli of Cu and Cu-Al alloys in reasonable agreement with each other and with experimental measurements from literature, but the MD-derived $\gamma$-surfaces, for both ZW and GAP, deviate substantially from DFT at the seven characteristic points, with the largest discrepancies at $T$ and $T_1$. When incorporated into PFDD, the DFT-derived $\gamma$-surfaces successfully predict an equilibrium SFW that increases with Al content and agrees well with standalone MD measurements and experimental values for pure Cu, whereas the MD-derived $\gamma$-surfaces do not yield an accurate SFW within PFDD, as the altered generalized stacking fault energy landscape causes the dissociating partials to become pinned soon after separation. These results show that DFT-derived $\gamma$-surfaces remain the more reliable route to alloy SFW prediction, and interatomic potentials must capture the shear path accurately to enable robust, efficient MD-PFDD modelling of stacking faults in alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了EAM（ZW）、GAP与DFT构建的Cu-Al合金γ-surface，并将其输入PFDD预测本征堆垛层错平衡宽度，发现DFT来源的γ-surface更可靠。
AI.motivation: 本征堆垛层错平衡宽度是影响关键变形行为的重要材料参数，需要评估MD势函数与DFT生成的γ-surface在合金SFW预测中的可靠性。
AI.method: 针对不同Al含量的Cu-Al合金，分别用经典EAM势（ZW）、机器学习GAP势的MD和DFT生成γ-surface，比较晶格参数与弹性模量，并将γ-surface作为能量项嵌入PFDD模拟以获得平衡SFW。
AI.result: 三种方法均能合理再现Cu及Cu-Al合金的晶格参数和弹性模量与实验趋势，但ZW和GAP的MD γ-surface在七个特征点显著偏离DFT，尤其在T和T1点差异最大；DFT γ-surface经PFDD可预测SFW随Al含量增加且与纯Cu的独立MD和实验值吻合，而MD γ-surface导致分位错分离后迅速被钉扎，无法给出准确SFW。
AI.conclusion: DFT-derived γ-surfaces仍是合金SFW预测更可靠的途径；用于高效MD-PFDD堆垛层错建模的原子间势必须准确描述剪切路径。

title: Photoinduced charging and spatially selective photochemistry on ferroelectric surfaces
summary: Ferroelectric surfaces exhibit polarization-dependent photoreactivity and provide a route to program chemical patterns through local electrical control of polarization. Observations accumulated over several decades show reaction products in domain interiors, at domain boundaries, and in other selected regions, indicating that the mechanisms extend beyond a single polarization-induced band-bending picture. Here we analyze light-induced charging and interfacial reactions on uniformly polarized ferroelectrics and domain patterns, for dry surfaces and surfaces in contact with an electrochemically active solution. A common semiconductor transport and charge-conservation framework distinguishes five cases: an isolated dry ferroelectric, a dry ferroelectric connected to a carrier reservoir, a blocking ferroelectric-electrolyte junction, a reactive interface with an external carrier return, and two opposite domains coupled through the solid and electrolyte. Analytical solutions and numerical evaluations connect stationary potentials versus illumination to differential optical spectra and finite light-step responses. We further examine the doping effects on static potentials in all five cases and dynamic photovoltage in the isolated film and a fixed-polarization, bare-surface contacted-film variant. For reactive interfaces, the same framework determines reduction and oxidation rates, their spatial distributions, and accumulated reaction amount. The analysis covers surface charging and photochemical conversion beyond deposition, while retaining the electrical and chemical boundaries that distinguish finite charging from sustained turnover, and explains the observed range of photodeposition morphologies. Finally, this framework builds the theoretical foundation for the modulated photovoltage imaging methods that can readily be realized in SPM under illumination.

AI.tldr: 该文建立统一的半导体输运与电荷守恒理论框架，解释铁电表面在光照下的充电、光电压及界面光化学反应，并覆盖五种典型边界条件。
AI.motivation: 数十年观测显示光反应产物可出现在畴内、畴界及其他区域，单一“极化诱导能带弯曲”图像难以解释，需要统一机制连接表面充电、载流子输运与电化学反应。
AI.method: 构建五类情形：孤立干铁电体、干铁电体接载流子库、阻挡型铁电-电解液结、带外部载流子回路的反应界面、以及经固体和电解质耦合的两个相反畴；用解析解和数值计算关联稳态电位-光照、微分光谱和有限光阶响应；分析掺杂对五类静态电位及孤立膜/固定极化裸表面接触膜动态光电压的影响；对反应界面计算还原/氧化速率、空间分布和累积反应量。
AI.result: 框架统一描述表面充电与光化学转化，区分有限充电与持续周转所对应的电气和化学边界，并能解释观测到的光沉积形貌范围；同时为光照下SPM可实现的调制光电压成像方法提供理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将铁电表面极化、光照载流子动力学、界面电化学和反应空间分布纳入同一框架，阐明多种光沉积形貌来源，并奠定调制光电压成像的理论基础。

title: Computational screening of amorphous lithium trivalent-metal chloride solid-state electrolytes
summary: Amorphous solid-state electrolytes (SSEs) are attractive candidates for safe, high-energy-density all-solid-state batteries. The recent discovery that amorphous LiTaCl$_6$ and LiNbCl$_6$ reach room-temperature ionic conductivities above 10 mS cm$^{-1}$ with activation energies below 0.2 eV has spurred a broad search for new amorphous halide Li conductors. Here we report a computational screening of amorphous lithium trivalent-metal chlorides (Li-M(III)-Cl) using molecular dynamics driven by a universal machine-learning force field. For the sixteen Li-M(III)-Cl compositions spanning fifteen rare-earth elements and indium, all phases exhibit fast room-temperature Li$^+$ diffusion, with diffusivities of roughly $2$-$5 \times 10^{-7}$ cm$^2$ s$^{-1}$. After scaling the conductivity versus diffusivity relation to an experimental LiTaCl$_6$ reference, the estimated room-temperature conductivities range from 7.7 mS cm$^{-1}$ for amorphous Li$_3$InCl$_6$ to 14 mS cm$^{-1}$ for amorphous Li$_3$ScCl$_6$. With a low activation energy of 0.18 eV, amorphous Li$_3$ScCl$_6$ is predicted to be among the most conductive amorphous halide electrolytes. To rationalize the composition-dependent transport, we identify two descriptors: the Li$^+$ vibrational density of states (VDOS) center, which correlates inversely with diffusivity, and the average number of correlated bodies in string-like Li$^+$ motion. Compositions in which Li$^+$ has a lower VDOS center and migrates more by individual hopping rather than by concerted motion exhibit higher Li-ion diffusivities. These results suggest rich Li-ion transport characteristics in amorphous halide SSEs.

AI.tldr: 该文用通用机器学习力场驱动分子动力学，系统筛选了16种非晶Li-M(III)-Cl卤化物固态电解质，发现均具有快速室温Li+扩散，估算室温电导率为7.7–14 mS cm-1，其中非晶Li3ScCl6最高且活化能仅0.18 eV。
AI.motivation: 非晶LiTaCl6和LiNbCl6近期展现出超过10 mS cm-1的室温离子电导率和低于0.2 eV的活化能，激发了对新型非晶卤化物锂导体的广泛搜索，同时需要理解其成分依赖的离子输运机制。
AI.method: 采用通用机器学习力场驱动的分子动力学模拟，筛选涵盖15种稀土元素和In的16种Li-M(III)-Cl非晶组成；以实验LiTaCl6为参考标定电导率-扩散系数关系，并分析Li+振动态密度（VDOS）中心及字符串状Li+运动中的平均关联体数等描述符。
AI.result: 所有16种非晶Li-M(III)-Cl相均表现快速室温Li+扩散，扩散系数约为2–5×10-7 cm2 s-1；估算室温电导率从非晶Li3InCl6的7.7 mS cm-1到非晶Li3ScCl6的14 mS cm-1。非晶Li3ScCl6活化能为0.18 eV，预测为最具导电性的非晶卤化物电解质之一。较低VDOS中心及更多个体跳跃而非协同运动的组成具有更高Li+扩散系数。
AI.conclusion: 非晶卤化物固态电解质具有丰富的Li+输运特性；机器学习的计算筛选可识别高电导候选材料，并提供VDOS中心和字符串状协同运动作为解释成分依赖输运的描述符。

title: Role of site-specific coordination for the structural and electronic properties of a Co-HATCN network on silver
summary: Two-dimensional metal-organic porous networks (2DMOPNs) on metal surfaces provide a versatile platform for exploring emergent electronic and magnetic phenomena in designed surface nanostructures. While the porous architecture is governed by coordination between molecular building blocks and metal centers, most 2DMOPNs utilize only one type of coordination site, leaving the impact of multiple coordination sites largely unexplored. We address this question by investigating the structural formation of a Co-coordinated 2DMOPN on Ag(111) with the linker molecule hexaazatriphenylene-hexacarbonitrile (HATCN), which has two chemically distinct nitrogen coordination sites at the peripheral nitrile groups and pyrazine-type core nitrogen atoms. Scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) reveals the transformation from a simple honeycomb HATCN structure to a Co-coordinated porous network with three structurally and electronically inequivalent molecules in a 6:3:1 ratio. The existence of two distinct coordination sites leads to selective Co coordination geometries for all three molecules, accompanied by site-specific charge transfer from Co into the former lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO), as revealed by momentum-resolved photoemission and density functional theory. Our results demonstrate that site-selective Co coordination not only controls the overall architecture of the porous network structure but also strongly influences the local electronic properties through site-specific metal-molecule interaction, providing a route to tailor the site-specific electronic structure of 2DMOPNs at the molecular level.

AI.tldr: 该文研究多配位点连接分子 HATCN 与 Co 在 Ag(111) 上形成二维金属有机多孔网络时，位点选择性配位如何同时决定网络结构与局域电子性质。
AI.motivation: 多数二维金属有机多孔网络仅利用单一类型配位点，尚不清楚同一分子中多种化学不同配位位点对网络构筑和电子结构的影响。
AI.method: 以具有外围腈基氮和吡嗪型核心氮两类配位点的 HATCN 为连接分子，在 Ag(111) 上制备 Co 配位二维多孔网络，结合扫描隧道显微镜、动量分辨光电子能谱和密度泛函理论进行研究。
AI.result: STM 观察到由简单蜂窝状 HATCN 结构转变为 Co 配位多孔网络，其中三种分子在结构和电子上不等价，比例为 6:3:1；两类配位点导致选择性 Co 配位几何，并引起从 Co 到原最低未占据分子轨道的位点特异电荷转移。
AI.conclusion: 位点选择性 Co 配位不仅控制多孔网络的整体架构，还通过位点特异的金属-分子相互作用显著调控局域电子性质，为在分子尺度定制二维金属有机多孔网络的位点特异电子结构提供了途径。

title: A thermodynamic correction layer for machine learning interatomic potentials
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials enable atomistic simulations with near \textit{ab initio} accuracy over large length and time scales. Foundation models extend this capability across the periodic table but inherit the thermodynamic description of the electronic structure methods used to generate their training data. Small errors in relative phase stability can therefore produce large errors in transformation temperatures. We introduce an additive thermodynamic correction layer that shifts phase free energies towards an assessed reference without retraining or modifying the base potential. A first order thermodynamic construction converts the required phase free energy shifts directly into configuration energy targets, which are fitted using a linear atomic cluster expansion and refined iteratively from measured free energies. We apply the method to melting and solid to solid transformations across elements with different crystal structures using a foundation GRACE model. After the correction, all transformation temperatures lie within the prescribed tolerance of the assessed values, including Ca, Ti, and Zr, where a solid to solid transition and melting are corrected together. Static energy curves, bulk moduli, and liquid structure remain close to those of the base model. Vacancy formation energies, thermal expansion, and liquid density depend on the corrected phase balance and change where the correction is large. The method requires neither retraining, differentiable dynamics, nor access to the parameters of the base potential. It provides a modular route for combining transferable atomistic models with assessed phase thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种加性热力学修正层，可在不重训练、不修改基础机器学习势的情况下，将相自由能校正到评估参考值，从而修正相变温度。
AI.motivation: 基础机器学习原子间势虽具近从头算精度并覆盖元素周期表，但继承训练数据电子结构方法的热力学描述；相对相稳定性的小误差会导致相变温度的大误差。
AI.method: 构建加性热力学修正层：用一阶热力学构造把所需相自由能移动直接转化为构型能量目标，以线性原子团簇展开拟合，并根据测得的自由能迭代精修；无需重训练、可微动力学或基础势参数。
AI.result: 在GRACE基础模型上用于不同晶体结构元素的熔化与固-固相变；修正后所有相变温度均在评估值规定容差内，包括同时修正Ca、Ti、Zr的固-固转变与熔化。静态能量曲线、体模量和液体结构仍接近基础模型；空位形成能、热膨胀和液体密度依赖修正后的相平衡，并在修正较大处发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供模块化途径，将可迁移原子尺度模型与评估相热力学结合，且无需重训练或访问基础势参数。

title: From Autonomous Knowledge Generation to Generalizable Property Prediction: A Precision-First Pipeline for Electro-Optic Materials Discovery
summary: Electro-optic materials, whose refractive index changes linearly with an applied electric field (the Pockels effect), set the speed and energy of optical modulators and microwave-to-optical links for quantum computing. Designing better materials requires optimizing composition alongside temperature, strain, and bias field. However, general repositories lack electro-optic tensor data. We present a pipeline that builds such a database from literature following the rule: "no value is better than a wrong value." The pipeline has five stages: physics-aware acquisition, layout-aware extraction via LLM and deterministic table parsers, a three-tier verification gate, cross-paper consensus using median and median absolute deviation, and a noise-robust surrogate model audited by leave-one-material-out (LOMO) testing. Physics enters directly: notation is mapped, point-group symmetry-forbidden Pockels components are rejected, equivalent labels are merged, and values carry provenance tags. In a run over 49 publications, the gate processed 816 candidates into 414 accepted, 215 held for review, and 187 rejected. Against a hand-certified gold standard of 303 values from 16 papers, the run achieved a precision of 0.51 and recall of 0.48 for exact record matches. Across four database snapshots, held-out materials where the surrogate model beat a predict-the-mean baseline grew from 1 of 4 to 9 of 13 as the database expanded from 10 to 22 materials. While not a controlled comparison, this trend supports the premise that a precision-oriented, physics-checked database can power forward models beyond its training set and clarifies requirements for inverse material design.

AI.tldr: 提出一套从文献构建电光张量数据库的流程，以“宁缺毋滥”为原则，结合物理规则、LLM/确定性表格解析、三级校验、跨论文共识与噪声鲁棒代理模型，并用LOMO测试审计。
AI.motivation: 电光材料（Pockels效应）决定光调制器和微波-光链路的速度与能耗，是量子计算等应用的关键；设计需联合优化组分、温度、应变和偏置场，但通用数据库缺乏电光张量数据。
AI.method: 五阶段流程：物理感知采集；基于LLM与确定性表格解析器的版面感知抽取；三级验证门；基于中位数和中位绝对偏差的跨论文共识；噪声鲁棒代理模型并用留一材料（LOMO）测试审计。物理规则直接介入：符号映射、拒绝点群对称性禁戒的Pockels分量、合并等价标签、为数值附加来源溯源标签。
AI.result: 在49篇文献上，验证门将816个候选处理为414个接受、215个待审、187个拒绝。以16篇论文中303个手工认证值为金标准，精确记录匹配的precision为0.51、recall为0.48。数据库从10种材料扩展到22种材料的四个快照中，代理模型在留出材料上优于预测均值基线的数量由1/4增至9/13。
AI.conclusion: 该趋势支持“以精确性为导向、经物理校验的数据库可支撑超出训练集的前向模型”的前提，并明确逆向材料设计的需求；但作者指出这并非受控比较。

title: No Value Is Better Than a Wrong Value: Finding and Handling Erroneous Data in Literature-Mined Datasets for AI
summary: Machine learning across materials science, chemistry, energy, and medicine increasingly relies on literature-extracted datasets due to a lack of curated databases. However, automated extraction introduces errors: text recognition misreads digits, units and notations are confused, values are misattributed, and LLMs hallucinate numbers. Drawing on our work building an electro-optic property database, we present a taxonomy of errors organized by their origin and signatures, alongside a layered framework for error detection. The framework combines schema and provenance checks, physical admissibility (bounds, symmetry, and governing equations), cross-source statistical consensus, model auditing, and suspicion-ranked review. In a production run, our verification gate halted 402 of 816 candidate values with typed reasons. Yet, an audit against curated references showed that 30 of 112 accepted values were defective; standard symmetry rules alone caught 21 of these. On measured BaTiO3 and KNbO3 tensors, constitutive identities caught 8 of 10 single-value errors and isolated the corrupted entries. In a controlled benchmark, the combined framework caught 81% of errors at 85% precision, including errors in single-report materials, bringing model accuracy on held-out data to within 3% of a model trained on clean data. Uncleaned data severely impairs discovery: 89% of the twenty largest values were errors, causing AI searches to prioritize false positives. Once bad numbers are controlled, missing measurement conditions emerge as the main limit, as distinct records become indistinguishable without full context. We outline directions for the field, including shared physics rule libraries and self-reporting databases.

AI.tldr: 针对文献自动抽取材料数据中的系统性错误，提出按来源/特征分类的错误分类学与分层校验框架，并在电光性质数据库和基准测试中验证其能显著拦截并纠正错误、恢复模型性能。
AI.motivation: 材料科学、化学、能源和医学的机器学习日益依赖文献抽取数据集，但缺乏人工 curated 数据库；自动抽取存在数字误读、单位/记号混淆、数值错配和 LLM 幻觉等错误，会污染数据并误导 AI 发现。
AI.method: 基于构建电光性质数据库的实践，建立按错误来源与签名组织的分类学，以及分层检测框架：schema 与 provenance 检查、物理可容许性（边界、对称性和控制方程）、跨来源统计共识、模型审计、可疑度排序人工复核；并用 BaTiO3/KNbO3 实测张量检验本构恒等式。
AI.result: 生产运行中校验门以带类型原因拦截 816 个候选值中的 402 个；对照 curated 参考审计发现 112 个接受值中 30 个有缺陷，仅标准对称性规则捕获其中 21 个；BaTiO3/KNbO3 张量的本构恒等式捕获 10 个单值错误中的 8 个并定位损坏条目；受控基准中组合框架以 85% 精确率捕获 81% 错误（含单报告材料），使留出数据模型精度与干净数据训练模型相差 3% 以内；未清洗数据中前 20 大值有 89% 为错误，导致 AI 搜索优先假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 分层校验可有效控制坏数值并接近干净数据训练性能，但坏数值受控后缺失测量条件成为主要限制，使不同记录在缺乏完整上下文时不可区分；领域需推进共享物理规则库与自报告数据库。

title: Magnetoelectric Exchange Spring for Spin-Wave Logic with Ultralow Energy Consumption
summary: Spin waves (magnons) are intrinsically free of Joule heating during their propagation in magnets. Exploring, understanding, and manipulating such quasiparticles not only helps reveal the exotic magnonic phenomena in condensed matter physics but also underpins the development of information devices with low energy consumption. However, achieving low-power and scalable control of spin-wave propagation remains a critical challenge. Herein, a magnetoelectric exchange spring has been artificially designed and constructed across an interface between ferroelectric BaTiO3 and ferromagnetic (La,Sr)MnO3 with low magnetic damping, in which polarization-modulated orbital reconstruction tailors local magnetic anisotropy and enables reversible control of spin-wave propagation. By successfully deviating from the Janovec-Kay-Dunn law, reversal polarization of engineered BaTiO3 (Ps~1.2 uC cm^-2, Vc~0.4 V) is sufficient to switch the coherent magnon transport in the (La,Sr)MnO3, indicating the magnetoelectric heterointerface may serve as a promising candidate for atto-joule control of spin-wave propagation (normalized to a 10*10 nm^2 device). Furthermore, taking advantage of amplitude, phase, and frequency to encode spin waves, all 16 compact Boolean logics with ultralow energy consumption have been designed. The artificial magnetoelectric exchange spring can be broadly applicable to various material choices, offering a versatile platform for developing energy-efficient and integrated magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过在BaTiO3/(La,Sr)MnO3界面构建人工磁电交换弹簧，利用极化调控的轨道重构改变局域磁各向异性，实现低能耗、可逆且可扩展的自旋波输运调控，并构建了16种低功耗布尔逻辑。
AI.motivation: 自旋波（磁振子）传播无焦耳热损耗，是低能耗信息器件的潜在载体；但如何实现低功耗、可扩展的自旋波传播调控仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: 在低磁阻尼铁磁体(La,Sr)MnO3与铁电体BaTiO3界面人工设计并构建磁电交换弹簧；通过极化诱导的轨道重构调节局域磁各向异性，从而可逆调控自旋波传播，并偏离Janovec-Kay-Dunn定律以降低极化翻转要求。
AI.result: 工程化BaTiO3的剩余极化Ps约1.2 μC cm^-2、矫顽电压Vc约0.4 V即可切换(La,Sr)MnO3中的相干磁振子输运；归一化到10×10 nm^2器件时，暗示可达到阿托焦耳级自旋波传播控制。进一步利用自旋波的振幅、相位和频率编码，设计了全部16种紧凑布尔逻辑，并具有超低能耗。
AI.conclusion: 人工磁电交换弹簧可广泛适用于多种材料组合，为低能耗、集成化磁振子器件提供了通用平台。

title: A van der Waals Floating-Gate Platform for Broadband Optoelectronic Neuromorphic Computing
summary: Artificial synapses that integrate nonvolatile memory with broadband optoelectronic learning are essential for next-generation neuromorphic computing. However, their realization remains challenging because conventional floating-gate memories exhibit limited optical functionality and poor scalability. Here, we report a van der Waals ReS2/hBN/InSe floating-gate synaptic transistor that combines efficient charge storage with broadband optoelectronic learning in a single device architecture. The heterostructure incorporates InSe as a floating-gate layer for stable charge storage, hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) as a tunneling dielectric, and ReS2 as a photoresponsive channel, enabling carrier tunneling under electrical and optical stimulation. Through the combined operation of these layers, the device achieves a large memory window, an on/off current ratio exceeding 10^6, stable multilevel conductance states, and reliable retention over 10^4 s. Broadband visible-to-near-infrared optical excitation enables controllable synaptic weight modulation and the emulation of essential synaptic functions, including short- and long-term plasticity, paired-pulse facilitation, and pulse-amplitude- and pulse-duration-dependent plasticity. Optical potentiation and electrical depression further enable bidirectional modulation of synaptic weights. Beyond these synaptic functions, the device demonstrates higher-order learning through associative and discrimination conditioning inspired by the Pavlovian learning paradigm, as well as reconfigurable Boolean logic driven by electro-optical inputs. These results establish a multifunctional van der Waals floating-gate platform that integrates nonvolatile memory, broadband optoelectronic learning, and adaptive information processing within a single transistor, providing a promising strategy for compact, energy-efficient neuromorphic hardware.

AI.tldr: 报道了一种ReS2/hBN/InSe范德华浮栅突触晶体管，在单一器件中集成非易失存储与宽带光电学习。
AI.motivation: 人工突触需同时具备非易失记忆与宽带光电学习能力，但传统浮栅存储器光学功能有限、可扩展性差，难以满足下一代神经形态计算需求。
AI.method: 构建ReS2/hBN/InSe范德华异质结浮栅突触晶体管：InSe作为浮栅层实现稳定电荷存储，hBN作为隧穿介质，ReS2作为光响应沟道；在电学和光学刺激下实现载流子隧穿，并利用可见至近红外宽带光激发调控突触权重。
AI.result: 器件实现大存储窗口、超过10^6的开关电流比、稳定的多级电导态和超过10^4 s的保持特性；可模拟短/长时程可塑性、配对脉冲易化及脉冲幅度/持续时间依赖可塑性，并实现光增强-电抑制的双向权重调制；进一步演示基于巴甫洛夫范式的联想与辨别条件学习以及电-光输入驱动的可重构布尔逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了集非易失存储、宽带光电学习和自适应信息处理于一体的多功能范德华浮栅平台，为紧凑、节能的神经形态硬件提供了有前景的策略。

title: Trajectory Functionals in the Thermodynamics of Radiation-Induced Damage in Structural Materials
summary: This paper delivers a novel self-consistent non-local kinetic framework based on dose-dependent semi-Markov renewal transport and the generalized Doob's h-transform to evaluate the structural degradation of WWER-1000/1200 fuel claddings. By leveraging the Feynman-Kac formalism, we map the continuous microscopic defect path trajectories generated by the Liouville operator directly onto the evolution of the macroscopically integrated damage potential. The framework accounts for long-range memory effects in the degradation kinetics via a non-vanishing structural commutator of the path Liouville operator and Zwanzig-Mori projection operators, which mathematically links the spatial restrictions of microscopic sinks to energetic path penalties. Spatial profiling of the cladding's mean lifetime, demonstrates a distinct sigmoidal, S-shaped degradation trajectory encompassing distinct incubation, linear growth, and avalanche breakdown stages. The numerical results reveal an abrupt, localized reduction in the operational lifespan near the cladding boundaries. This marginal vulnerability is shown to be a direct physical consequence of boundary stress field singularities at the fuel cladding interface and localized embrittlement. The developed path integral architecture provides a strict thermodynamic link between non-equilibrium fluctuations and the global Griffiths macro-barrier, offering a robust predictive tool for high-burnup nuclear fuel safety assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于剂量依赖半马尔可夫更新输运与广义Doob h变换的自洽非局域动理学框架，用于评估WWER-1000/1200燃料包壳的结构退化。
AI.motivation: 针对高燃耗核燃料包壳在长期辐照与应力作用下结构退化具有非局域、长程记忆和边界敏感等特征，需要建立能够连接微观缺陷路径与宏观损伤势演化的预测性理论工具。
AI.method: 利用Feynman-Kac形式将Liouville算符生成的微观连续缺陷路径轨迹映射到宏观积分损伤势演化；通过路径Liouville算符与Zwanzig-Mori投影算符的非零结构对易子刻画退化动力学中的长程记忆效应，并将微观汇的空间限制与能量路径惩罚数学关联；框架基于剂量依赖的半马尔可夫更新输运和广义Doob h变换，保持自洽非局域动理学描述。
AI.result: 包壳平均寿命的空间剖面呈现明显的S形退化轨迹，包括孵育、线性增长和雪崩击穿阶段；数值结果显示包壳边界附近工作寿命突然且局域性降低，该边缘脆弱性直接源于燃料包壳界面处边界应力场奇异性和局域脆化。
AI.conclusion: 该路径积分架构在非平衡涨落与全局Griffiths宏观势垒之间建立了严格热力学联系，为高燃耗核燃料安全评估提供了稳健的预测工具。

title: Rigid Band Shift in Electron-Doped Kagome Metal
summary: We study the effects of Sn-site doping on the electronic structure of nonmagnetic kagome metal YV$_6$Sn$_{6-x}$Sb$_x$ by infrared spectroscopy and density-functional theory. The results for samples with $x$ = 0 and 1.4 demonstrate that partial substitution of Sn by Sb acts as a rigid shift of the Fermi level while leaving the band dispersion largely intact. Our findings establish Sn-site substitution in YV$_6$Sn$_6$ as a route to systematically investigate band-filling-dependent electronic properties of nonmagnetic kagome metals.

AI.tldr: 在非磁性kagome金属YV$_6$Sn$_{6-x}$Sb$_x$中，Sn位Sb掺杂主要引起费米能级的刚性移动，而能带色散基本保持不变。
AI.motivation: 需要一种不显著破坏能带结构、可系统调控费米能级的方法，以研究非磁性kagome金属中能带填充依赖的电子性质。
AI.method: 结合红外光谱和密度泛函理论，比较$x=0$与$x=1.4$的YV$_6$Sn$_{6-x}$Sb$_x$样品的电子结构。
AI.result: 部分Sb替代Sn使费米能级发生刚性移动，同时能带色散基本完整保留。
AI.conclusion: YV$_6$Sn$_6$中的Sn位取代可作为系统研究非磁性kagome金属能带填充依赖电子性质的有效途径。

title: Nonlocal Einstein Relation in Confined Phonon Hydrodynamics
summary: Einstein relations connect carrier mobility to macroscopic transport coefficients and constitute a fundamental link between microscopic dynamics and transport. In phonon hydrodynamics, this connection is conventionally local: the drift-induced thermal conductivity is proportional to the local drift mobility. Here we show that this relation becomes intrinsically nonlocal under spatial confinement. We derive a nonlocal Einstein relation, $\kappa_H(y) = \int P(y-y')\mu(y'),dy'$, in which hydrodynamic thermal conductivity $\kappa_H(y)$ at one position depends on collective drift mobility $\mu(y')$ across the entire cross-section of the channel. In the small-Knudsen-number limit, our nonlocal theory recovers the viscous heat equation and the local Einstein relation. At finite Knudsen number, nonlocality produces intrinsic boundary slip and distinct size-scaling behavior of the drift mobility $\mu$ and hydrodynamic thermal conductivity $\kappa_H(y)$. First-principles calculations for graphite show that nonlocality broadens the channel-size window over which thermal conductivity exhibits superlinear size dependence. Temperature-dependent simulations further show that the nonlocal theory captures the emergence of a hydrodynamic peak in thermal conductivity normalized by ballistic conductance, whereas the local theory fails to accurately predict its magnitude. Our results establish a microscopic connection between collective phonon mobility and heat conduction beyond local hydrodynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出并验证了空间受限下声子流体力学中的非局域Einstein关系，将局域漂移迁移率与宏观热导率的联系推广为跨通道截面的非局域卷积关系。
AI.motivation: 传统声子流体力学假设漂移诱导热导率与局域漂移迁移率成正比，但在空间受限和有限Knudsen数下，这种局域Einstein关系可能失效，需要建立微观声子集体迁移率与宏观热输运之间的非局域联系。
AI.method: 推导非局域Einstein关系 κ_H(y)=∫P(y-y')μ(y')dy'，使某一位置的流体力学热导率依赖整个通道截面上的集体漂移迁移率；在小时Knudsen数极限下回归粘性热方程和局域Einstein关系，并结合石墨的第一性原理计算与温度依赖模拟进行验证。
AI.result: 有限Knudsen数下非局域性导致本征边界滑移，并使漂移迁移率μ与流体力学热导率κ_H(y)呈现不同的尺寸标度；石墨计算显示非局域性拓宽了热导率随通道尺寸超线性变化的窗口，且非局域理论能捕捉热导率除以弹道电导后出现的流体力学峰，而局域理论无法准确预测其幅度。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了集体声子迁移率与超越局域流体力学热传导之间的微观联系，表明空间受限下声子热输运需采用非局域Einstein关系描述。

title: Temperature-dependent magnetic properties of the antiferromagnet Mn$_2$Au
summary: Mn$_2$Au is one of the most promising materials for antiferromagnetic spintronics due to its high N\'eel temperature, moderate anisotropy, layered spin structure allowing current induced spin-orbit-torques, and ultrafast spin dynamics. Further understanding and control of the magnetic order in Mn$_2$Au for ultrafast spintronics applications via ultrashort electric/optical means requires accurate understanding of how its magnetic properties depend on temperature. Here we present atomistic spin dynamics simulations of the temperature-dependent macroscopic magnetic properties of Mn$_2$Au single crystals. We introduce a spin Hamiltonian based on previous ab initio calculations which produces temperature-dependent scaling of the anisotropy constants with magnetisation consistent with Zener-Akulov-Callen-Callen power laws. The calculated temperature dependence of exchange stiffness follows a scaling law with magnetisation of $m^{1.83}_e$ , and predicts a temperature-dependent domain wall width that agrees very well with direct simulation. Our model provides an understanding of temperature-dependent magnetic properties of Mn$_2$Au that enables large-scale simulation of the working conditions of spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过原子自旋动力学模拟，建立了Mn$_2$Au单晶温度依赖磁性的自旋哈密顿量模型，并验证了各向异性、交换刚度和畴壁宽度的温度标度行为。
AI.motivation: Mn$_2$Au因高奈尔温度、适中各向异性、层状自旋结构及超快自旋动力学而成为反铁磁自旋电子学的重要候选材料；但利用超短电/光脉冲实现磁序调控，需要准确理解其磁性质随温度的变化。
AI.method: 基于已有第一性原理计算构建自旋哈密顿量，并对Mn$_2$Au单晶进行原子自旋动力学模拟，计算宏观磁性的温度依赖性，包括各向异性常数、交换刚度和畴壁宽度。
AI.result: 模型给出的各向异性常数随温度/磁化强度的标度与Zener-Akulov-Callen-Callen幂律一致；交换刚度的温度依赖性遵循约$m_e^{1.83}$的标度律；由模型预测的温度依赖畴壁宽度与直接模拟结果高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该模型阐明了Mn$_2$Au温度依赖磁性的微观机制，并为自旋电子器件工作条件下的大规模模拟提供了基础。

title: Optical Thermometry in Monolayer WS2: Raman and Photoluminescence Spectroscopy from 5 K to 1273 K
summary: Reliable temperature measurement is essential for characterizing and engineering two-dimensional (2D) semiconductor devices, yet optical thermometry of 2D materials has so far been demonstrated only over narrow temperature windows spanning a few hundred kelvin. Here, we establish a comprehensive optical thermometry framework for monolayer WS2 from 5~K to 1273~K. We show that: (i) the out-of-plane A1g Raman mode shifts linearly with temperature above 100~K, with a slope of -0.0138 cm^{-1}/K in non-encapsulated WS2 (fitted over 298-1223~K) and a measurably smaller slope of -0.0121 cm^{-1}/K in an hBN-encapsulated sample (fitted over 100-1273~K); (ii) photoluminescence spectra measured over the same 5--1273~K range provide an independent optical indicator of the temperature: the neutral-exciton emission redshifts continuously with temperature and is well described by the semi-empirical P\"assler model. The two indicators probe distinct physical mechanisms, lattice anharmonicity and bandgap renormalization, and together provide contact-free thermometry for monolayer WS2 from 5~K to 1273~K, an approach applicable to 2D semiconductors more broadly.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了单层WS2从5 K到1273 K的宽温区光学测温框架，利用拉曼A1g模和中性激子光致发光两个独立指标实现无接触测温。
AI.motivation: 二维半导体器件表征与工程需要可靠温度测量，但现有二维材料光学测温通常只覆盖几百开尔的窄温区。
AI.method: 测量单层WS2在5–1273 K范围内的拉曼与光致发光光谱；分析A1g模随温度线性偏移，并用Pässler半经验模型拟合中性激子发射随温度的红移；比较未封装与hBN封装样品。
AI.result: A1g模在100 K以上线性偏移，未封装样品在298–1223 K拟合斜率为-0.0138 cm^-1/K，hBN封装样品在100–1273 K拟合斜率为-0.0121 cm^-1/K；中性激子发射随温度连续红移并可由Pässler模型描述。
AI.conclusion: 拉曼A1g模与激子PL分别反映晶格非谐性和带隙重整化，二者互补，可在5–1273 K范围内对单层WS2进行无接触测温，并可推广至更广泛的二维半导体。

title: Control of the Electronic and Atomic Structure of the Altermagnetic {\alpha}-MnTe Surface via Substrate-Induced Surfactants
summary: Altermagnets are a novel class of materials with unique momentum dependent spin-polarization of the electronic band structure, which opens up new avenues for spintronic devices. Altermagnetic {\alpha}-MnTe is particularly interesting for such applications due to its giant spin splitting and the persistence of altermagnetic order up to room temperature. Growth of thin films is, however, challenging and governed by interactions with the substrate. As a result, the surface of {\alpha}-MnTe thin films exhibits very different atomic structures in dependence of the substrate material. Whereas on SrF2(111) an atomically clean, perfectly (2x2) reconstructed surface forms, on InP(111)A the MnTe surface is always InTe terminated due to super-segregation of In from the substrate to the surface. Most strikingly, the InTe surfactant layer displays a quasi-periodic dislocation network to accommodate the InTe/MnTe lattice mismatch. This leads to the emergence of distinct surface states in dependence of surface termination that strongly affect the electronic band structure at the surface as shown by angle resolved photoemission and tunneling spectroscopy. Thus, control and characterization of the atomic structure of the surface is fundamentally important for understanding the properties of altermagnets and provides room for engineering and tailoring of spin-polarized states in actual devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示α-MnTe薄膜表面结构强烈依赖衬底：SrF2(111)上形成洁净(2×2)重构表面，而InP(111)A上因In超偏析形成InTe终止层及准周期位错网络，并导致显著不同的表面电子态。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体具有动量依赖的自旋极化能带，α-MnTe因巨大自旋劈裂和室温交错磁序而适用于自旋电子器件；但薄膜生长受衬底相互作用调控，表面原子结构差异会影响其表面电子性质，因此需要阐明并控制表面结构。
AI.method: 在不同衬底上生长α-MnTe薄膜，比较SrF2(111)与InP(111)A上的表面原子结构，并结合角分辨光电子能谱与隧穿谱表征表面电子态。
AI.result: SrF2(111)上形成原子级洁净、完美(2×2)重构表面；InP(111)A上MnTe表面始终为InTe终止，源于In从衬底向表面的超偏析，且InTe表面层形成准周期位错网络以缓解InTe/MnTe晶格失配。不同终止方式产生明显不同的表面态，并强烈影响表面电子能带结构。
AI.conclusion: 表面原子结构的控制与表征对理解交错磁体性质至关重要，并为实际器件中自旋极化态的调控与工程化设计提供空间。

title: Impact of organic spacer cations on the light and thermal stability of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites
summary: Long-term stability remains a critical challenge limiting the photovoltaic and optoelectronic applications of two-dimensional lead halide perovskites. In these materials, the choice of the organic spacer plays a key role not only in enhancing environmental stability, but also in determining their structural characteristics and carrier dynamics. Here, we present an environmental photo- and thermal-stability analysis of BA2PbI4 and PEA2PbI4 two-dimensional lead halide perovskites by means of confocal micro-Raman and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy techniques. We have investigated two different organic spacers, n-butylammonium (BA) and 2-phenylethylammonium (PEA), which provide comparable room-temperature luminescence in freshly exfoliated perovskite nanoflakes and degrade similarly through the removal of organic components and fast crystal phase decomposition into PbI2 and Pb0. However, we observed that the PEA organic cation significantly improves crystal morphology and suppresses lattice defects, resulting in slower degradation and enhanced resistance to light and thermal stress under ambient conditions. Our findings indicate that structural and chemical engineering, along with surface passivation and encapsulation strategies, are essential for achieving long-term stability in two-dimensional halide perovskite devices. Nevertheless, optimizing the balance between stability and device performance remains a critical consideration.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了BA2PbI4与PEA2PbI4二维铅卤钙钛矿的环境光/热稳定性，发现PEA间隔阳离子可改善形貌、抑制缺陷并减缓降解。
AI.motivation: 二维铅卤钙钛矿的长期稳定性限制其光伏与光电器件应用；有机间隔阳离子不仅影响环境稳定性，还决定结构特征与载流子动力学。
AI.method: 采用共聚焦微区拉曼光谱和X射线光电子能谱，对分别含n-丁基铵（BA）和2-苯乙基铵（PEA）有机间隔层的BA2PbI4与PEA2PbI4纳米片进行环境光稳定性和热稳定性分析。
AI.result: 新鲜剥离的两种钙钛矿纳米片具有相近的室温发光，且均通过有机组分流失和快速相分解为PbI2与Pb0而发生降解；但PEA有机阳离子显著改善晶体形貌并抑制晶格缺陷，从而降低降解速率，并增强环境条件下抗光和热应力能力。
AI.conclusion: 结构/化学工程结合表面钝化和封装策略对实现二维卤化物钙钛矿器件长期稳定性至关重要，同时需权衡稳定性与器件性能。

title: Direct observation of a spin-polarized surface Dirac gap in the antiferromagnetic topological insulator NdBi
summary: A gapped Dirac cone in antiferromagnetic topological insulators (AFM-TIs) is essential for realizing the quantized anomalous Hall effect, yet its intrinsic magnitude remains controversial. In the prototypical AFM-TI MnBi2Te4, however, the observed Dirac gap is significantly smaller than theoretical predictions or nearly absent, highlighting a long-standing discrepancy. Here we demonstrate that NdBi hosts a spin-polarized topological surface Dirac cone with a sizable gap of 17 meV at the Dirac point, in excellent agreement with density functional theory predictions (12 meV). This direct observation is enabled by high-resolution 7 eV laser-based spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, which unambiguously disentangles the spin-polarized surface Dirac cone from bulk-derived states. Furthermore, through temperature dependence and controlled surface contamination, we establish a direct linkage between surface magnetism and the Dirac gap, demonstrating that the gap opens only in the presence of surface magnetic order. These results provide definitive spectroscopic evidence for an intrinsic Dirac gap in AFM-TIs and establish NdBi as a model platform to resolve the long-standing discrepancy between experiment and theory in AFM-TIs.

AI.tldr: 该文利用7 eV激光自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱，在反铁磁拓扑绝缘体NdBi中直接观测到自旋极化的拓扑表面狄拉克锥及其约17 meV的狄拉克点能隙，并证明该能隙仅在表面磁序存在时打开。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体中的狄拉克能隙是实现量子化反常霍尔效应的关键，但其本征大小长期存在争议；典型材料MnBi2Te4中观测到的能隙显著小于理论预测甚至几乎缺失，实验与理论矛盾突出。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率7 eV激光基自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱（spin-ARPES）测量NdBi，将自旋极化表面狄拉克锥与体态来源态明确区分；并结合温度依赖测量和可控表面污染实验，建立表面磁性与狄拉克能隙之间的直接联系。
AI.result: 在NdBi的狄拉克点观测到约17 meV的自旋极化拓扑表面狄拉克锥能隙，与密度泛函理论预测的12 meV高度一致；温度依赖和表面污染实验表明，该能隙仅在表面磁序存在时打开。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了反铁磁拓扑绝缘体中本征狄拉克能隙的决定性谱学证据，并确立NdBi为解决该体系长期实验-理论矛盾的代表性平台。

title: Simultaneous suppression and temperature-driven crossover of particle-like and wave-like thermal transport in trigonal CsAg$_3$S$_2$
summary:
The simultaneous suppression of particle-like ($\kappa_p$ ) and wave-like ($\kappa_c$) thermal transport channels in crystalline materials remains a challenging problem, as reducing one channel can enhance the other. Here, we investigate the thermal transport in trigonal $P\Bar{3}m1$ CsAg$_3$S$_2$ using self-consistent phonon theory with cubic and quartic anharmonicity and the unified theory of thermal transport.
  Our calculations predict an ultralow lattice thermal conductivity of 0.222 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$ at 300 K, featuring simultaneously low $\kappa_p$ and $\kappa_c$ with a weak temperature dependence of $\sim$T$^{-0.42}$, which deviates significantly from the conventional $\sim$T$^{-1}$ behavior. This simultaneous suppression arises from localized Cs modes, which enhance anharmonic scattering, and the softer Ag-S framework, which reduces phonon group velocities, together suppressing $\kappa_p$, in conjunction with sparse, well-separated high-frequency S-derived optical modes that suppress $\kappa_c$ by limiting the coherent coupling between the phonon modes. Furthermore, the dominant transport channel exhibits a temperature-dependent crossover, with $\kappa_p$ contributing $\sim$74 \% of total lattice thermal conductivity at 300~K and $\kappa_c$ contributing $\sim$63 \% at 700~K. Combining the ultralow thermal conductivity with electrical transport calculated within the momentum relaxation time approximation (MRTA), we obtain a $ZT$ of 1.28 for $n$-type doping at 700 K. The present work not only clarifies the microscopic mechanism of ultralow thermal conductivity in trigonal CsAg$_3$S$_2$ but also identifies the covalent M-Ch framework modification within the AM$_3$Ch$_2$ family of ternary chalcogenides as an additional tuning parameter for further reducing $\kappa_p$ within the bonding-hierarchy design principle.

AI.tldr: 论文通过自洽声子理论（含三阶、四阶非谐性）与统一热输运理论，研究三方相 CsAg3S2 中粒子型与波动型热输运通道的同时抑制机制，预测其超低晶格热导率及高热电性能。
AI.motivation: 晶态材料中粒子型（κp）与波动型（κc）热输运通道通常此消彼长，如何同时抑制二者仍是难题；作者希望揭示 CsAg3S2 中超低热导率的微观机制，并寻找调控 κp 的新设计参数。
AI.method: 采用包含立方和四次非谐性的自洽声子理论计算声子性质，并结合统一热输运理论分离和计算 κp 与 κc；电输运在动量弛豫时间近似（MRTA）下计算，以获得 ZT。
AI.result: 计算得到 300 K 时晶格热导率仅 0.222 W m^-1 K^-1，κp 与 κc 同时较低，温度依赖约为 T^-0.42，显著偏离常规 T^-1。局域 Cs 模式增强非谐散射、较软的 Ag-S 骨架降低声子群速度，从而抑制 κp；稀疏且分离的高频 S 衍生光学模式限制声子模式间相干耦合，从而抑制 κc。主导输运通道随温度发生交叉：300 K 时 κp 约占总晶格热导率的 74%，700 K 时 κc 约占 63%。结合 MRTA 电输运，700 K n 型掺杂下 ZT 达 1.28。
AI.conclusion: 工作阐明了三方相 CsAg3S2 超低晶格热导率的微观机制，并指出在 AM3Ch2 三元硫族化合物中通过共价 M-Ch 骨架修饰可作为在键合层级设计原则下进一步降低 κp 的额外调控参数。

title: Zeeman-field-induced three-spin interactions and relativistic coupling to the scalar spin chirality
summary: Magnetic fields are commonly incorporated in atomistic spin models through the Zeeman energy of individual magnetic moments. Starting from a microscopic electronic Hamiltonian, we show that the Zeeman coupling of conduction electrons also generates field-linear three-spin interactions, the lowest-order corrections allowed by time-reversal symmetry. Using a Green-function expansion of the grand potential, we identify two classes of interactions. Isotropic terms of the form $(\mathbf S_i\cdot\mathbf S_j)(\mathbf S_k\cdot\mathbf B)$ exist without spin-orbit coupling, and their total strength obeys a sum rule involving the three-site electronic loop at the Fermi energy. Relativistic terms require spin-orbit coupling and include $\mathbf K_{ijk}\cdot\mathbf B,\chi_{ijk}$, where $\chi_{ijk}=\mathbf S_i\cdot(\mathbf S_j\times\mathbf S_k)$ is the scalar spin chirality. We show that this coupling is forbidden in the spin channel without spin-orbit coupling, whereas the orbital channel recovers the orbital-flux mechanism of Mott insulators. Exact diagonalization of the Hubbard trimer confirms the independence and additivity of both channels. For magnetic trimers in Rashba electron gases, we derive analytical expressions showing that $\mathbf K_{ijk}$ lies in-plane at first order in spin-orbit coupling but vanishes for $C_{3v}$-symmetric trimers, where an out-of-plane component emerges at second order. These interactions can shift magnetization-step fields and modify field-induced noncoplanarity. In the continuum limit, the chirality coupling splits skyrmions from antiskyrmions, while the relativistic terms generate a field-dependent Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction.

AI.tldr: 从微观电子哈密顿量出发，作者证明传导电子的Zeeman耦合会额外产生场线性的三自旋相互作用，并给出其两类形式及物理后果。
AI.motivation: 传统原子自旋模型仅用单个磁矩的Zeeman能描述磁场；本文追问微观电子Zeeman项是否还会诱导时间反演允许的最低阶三自旋耦合。
AI.method: 对微观电子哈密顿量做巨势的Green函数展开以分类并推导相互作用；用Hubbard三聚体精确对角化验证，并对Rashba电子气中的磁性三聚体进行解析推导。
AI.result: 得到无需自旋轨道耦合的各向同性项(Si·Sj)(Sk·B)，其总强度满足费米能处三格点电子环的求和规则；以及需自旋轨道耦合的相对论项Kijk·B χijk，其中χijk为标量自旋手性。无自旋轨道耦合时该耦合在自旋通道禁戒，而轨道通道恢复Mott绝缘体的轨道通量机制；三聚体计算确认两通道独立且可加。Rashba情形下Kijk在一阶自旋轨道耦合时位于面内，但对C3v对称三聚体消失，二阶出现面外分量。
AI.conclusion: 这些场线性三自旋相互作用会移动磁化阶跃场并改变场致非共面性；连续极限下手性耦合可分裂skyrmion与antiskyrmion，相对论项还产生场依赖的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用。

title: Pulsed Laser Deposition of Ferroelectric SrTiO3 Shells Enables Polarization-Controlled Charge Separation in TiO2 Photoanode
summary: Ferroelectric polarization offers a powerful route to govern the interfacial charge separation in photoelectrodes; however, chemically converted ferroelectric shells lack sub-nanometer thickness control, coherent strain retention, and chemically clean interfaces. Here, we use pulsed laser deposition to fabricate stoichiometric SrTiO3 shells on hydrothermally grown TiO2 nanorod arrays, achieving atomically defined core-shell architectures while preserving the one-dimensional transport geometry. The photocurrent density followed a volcano-shaped dependence on shell thickness and reached 1.9 mA cm-2 at 1.23 V versus RHE under AM 1.5G illumination for the optimized 15-mins sample, exceeding the established hydrothermal benchmark. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy revealed a tetragonally distorted, oxygen-stoichiometric shell, identifying coherent interfacial strain rather than defect dipoles as the origin of the ferroelectric order. Kelvin probe force microscopy directly imaged a polarization-induced built-in electric field whose magnitude scaled with charge-transfer efficiency and photocurrent density. Together, these complementary structural, chemical, electrostatic, and device-level measurements established a quantitative strain-polarization-built-in field-charge separation relationship. This work transforms ferroelectric photoanode engineering from empirical optimization into an atomically controllable and predictive materials strategy for high-efficiency solar water-splitting devices. This approach is readily extendable to visible-light absorbers and complex ferroelectric heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 利用脉冲激光沉积在TiO2纳米棒阵列上制备原子级可控的SrTiO3铁电壳层，建立应变-极化-内建电场-电荷分离的定量关系，并实现1.9 mA cm-2的光电流密度。
AI.motivation: 铁电极化可调控光电极界面电荷分离，但化学转化的铁电壳层难以实现亚纳米厚度控制、共格应变保持和化学洁净界面。
AI.method: 采用脉冲激光沉积在水热生长的TiO2纳米棒阵列上制备化学计量比SrTiO3壳层，保持一维传输几何；结合HRTEM、XPS、KPFM和光电化学测试表征结构与性能。
AI.result: 光电流密度随壳层厚度呈火山型依赖，优化15分钟样品在AM 1.5G、1.23 V vs RHE下达到1.9 mA cm-2，超过水热基准；壳层为四方畸变、氧化学计量比，铁电性源于共格界面应变而非缺陷偶极；KPFM直接成像极化诱导内建电场，其大小与电荷转移效率和光电流密度相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将铁电光阳极工程从经验优化转变为原子级可控且可预测的材料策略，并可拓展至可见光吸收体和复杂铁电异质结构。

title: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization reveals HiPIMS deposition rates exceeding direct current sputtering
summary: Pulsed sputter processes are essential for a wide range of applications from hard coatings to microelectronics. High power impulse magnetron sputtering (HiPIMS) offers unique possibilities for process design due to its high ionized flux fraction. Because of the high peak-current densities involved, correspondingly high plasma densities generate many ions. This enables tuning of kinetic energies by applying accelerating bias potentials. However, some HiPIMS processes have low deposition rates due to the back-attraction these ions experience with the negatively charged sputter target. Recent work in HiPIMS has targeted this problem, exploring complex pulsing schemes such as bipolar, multi-pulse, or chopped HiPIMS. These pulsing schemes introduce another problem: process complexity. As such, the process space, even with coarse intervals quickly blows up to 1E5-1E20 possible process combinations. This calls for efficient and intelligent sampling, which can be enabled by machine-learning algorithms such as Bayesian optimization. In this work we use multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) to efficiently sample the process space of pulse-packets, targeting high ionization flux fractions and deposition rates. Over 2,000 distinct processes were sampled during this exploration. Surprisingly, we found that many HiPIMS processes, including single pulse, can achieve deposition rates higher than DC references. In fact, at a working pressure of 1.0 Pa and moderate ionization rates of 5-20% we found that ms-scale pulses were ideal. We hypothesize these processes maximize gas rarefaction, creating a low-collision channel between the target and the substrate. These results showcase previously unreported behavior of pulsed sputter processes and challenge a long-held trade-off between film quality and speed in thin-film manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）高效搜索HiPIMS脉冲包工艺空间，发现许多HiPIMS工艺（包括单脉冲）在保持5–20%中等离化率时，沉积速率可超过DC参考，尤其在1.0 Pa下毫秒级脉冲表现理想。
AI.motivation: HiPIMS具有高离化通量分数，可通过偏压调控离子能量，但离子被负偏压靶材回吸会导致沉积速率偏低；双极、多脉冲、斩波等复杂脉冲方案虽可缓解该问题，却使工艺参数组合爆炸至约1E5–1E20，亟需高效智能采样。
AI.method: 采用多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）对脉冲包（pulse-packets）的HiPIMS工艺空间进行高效采样，以高离化通量分数和高沉积速率为目标，共采样超过2,000个不同工艺。
AI.result: 发现许多HiPIMS工艺（包括单脉冲）可实现高于DC参考的沉积速率；在1.0 Pa工作气压和5–20%中等离化率下，毫秒尺度脉冲最理想。作者假设这些工艺最大化气体稀薄化（gas rarefaction），在靶材与基底间形成低碰撞通道。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了此前未报道的脉冲溅射行为，挑战了薄膜制造中长期存在的“膜质量与沉积速度”权衡关系，并表明MOBO可有效导航复杂HiPIMS工艺空间。

title: High-efficiency solid-state electrochemical thermal switching through phonon engineering of 2D materials
summary: Reversible solid-state thermal switches with large thermal contrasts remain rare, yet are essential for advanced thermal management. Using universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) and density functional theory (DFT), we screen 57 transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs), spanning the 1T and 2H phases with Li and Mg intercalation. Among the candidates, Li$_a$ZrS$_2$ combines exceptional thermal conductivity switching with low heat capacity. Lithiation to Li$_{0.125}$ZrS$_2$ reduces the cross-plane thermal conductivity from approximately 3.7 to 0.05 W m$^{-1}$ K$^{-1}$. The switching behaviour exceeds that of previously reported solid-state electrochemical thermal switches. Device-level modelling further demonstrates the potential for waste-heat recovery, with a pulsed system capturing 86\% of the energy recovered by an ideal switch. We attribute the switching behaviour to substantial softening of the Zr--Zr framework, with the mean force constant decreasing from approximately 4.2 to 1.2 eV $\mathrm{\mathring{A}}^{-2}$, alongside enhanced scattering of heat-carrying acoustic phonons. These findings establish electrochemical intercalation as a promising route to engineering thermal transport in layered materials.

AI.tldr: 该文利用通用机器学习原子间势与DFT筛选57种Li/Mg插层TMDC，发现Li插层ZrS2具有超大可逆热导开关比，并展示其在余热回收中的器件潜力。
AI.motivation: 兼具大热对比度和可逆性的固态热开关仍很稀缺，而先进热管理亟需此类材料。
AI.method: 结合uMLIPs与DFT，系统筛选1T和2H相、Li和Mg插层的57种过渡金属硫族化合物，并进行器件级建模与声子/键合机制分析。
AI.result: Li0.125ZrS2将cross-plane热导率从约3.7降至0.05 W m^-1 K^-1，开关性能优于已报道的固态电化学热开关；脉冲器件可回收理想开关86%的能量；机制为Zr-Zr骨架显著软化，平均力常数由约4.2降至1.2 eV Å^-2，并增强声学声子散射。
AI.conclusion: 电化学插层是调控层状材料热输运的有效途径，Li插层ZrS2有望用于高性能固态热管理与余热回收。

title: Retention-constrained fine-tuning of a pre-trained aluminium MACE potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity
summary: Adapting a pre-trained machine-learning interatomic potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity requires improving defect accuracy without degrading the near-equilibrium elastic and vibrational response. Here we achieve this balance for the aluminium MACE potential QP17 by integrating conditional readout uncertainty, iterative full-parameter updates and protocol-compatible relative-energy anchoring. Sensitivities over 144 linear readout weights guide acquisition, with within-batch covariance updates and evolving neural representations. After four active-learning rounds (32 acquired configurations and 400 gradient updates), force-uncertainty acquisition reduces mean development force error from 22.43 to 21.52 meV/Angstrom, outperforming random sampling (22.70), geometry-diversity selection (22.46) and uniform training across all 104 candidate labels (22.71) under the same update budget. All three force-uncertainty runs satisfy bulk-mechanical retention criteria: historical relative-energy error decreases from 0.375 to 0.207 meV/atom, while harmonic phonon root-mean-square drift remains below 0.05 THz. Matched objective ablations reveal that relative-energy anchoring suppresses harmonic drift. Out-of-sample evaluations across planar faults, twin boundaries and grain boundaries demonstrate transferable gains in defect energies and deviatoric stresses, even though virial stresses are never fitted. A closed-loop molecular dynamics and density functional theory (MD-DFT) pilot confirms that automated acceptance gating intercepts updates that violate historical elastic-group energy or vibrational tolerances. Together, these components establish a retention-constrained fine-tuning protocol for improving plastic-deformation observables while preserving the tested bulk mechanical response.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种保留约束的主动微调协议，在提升铝 MACE 势 QP17 缺陷与塑性相关精度的同时，保持近平衡弹性与振动响应。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器学习原子间势用于非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性时，需要提高缺陷精度，但不能牺牲近平衡弹性与振动响应。
AI.method: 结合条件读出不确定性、迭代全参数更新和协议兼容的相对能量锚定；用144个线性读出权重的敏感度指导采集，并进行批内协方差更新与演化神经表示。经4轮主动学习（32个构型、400次梯度更新）比较力不确定性采集与随机采样、几何多样性选择和全候选均匀训练。
AI.result: 力不确定性采集将开发集平均力误差从22.43降至21.52 meV/Å，优于随机采样22.70、几何多样性22.46和均匀训练22.71；历史相对能量误差从0.375降至0.207 meV/atom，谐波声子RMS漂移低于0.05 THz。消融表明相对能量锚定抑制谐波漂移；在平面缺陷、孪晶界和晶界的外样本评估中，缺陷能量与偏应力转移增益明显，尽管未拟合virial应力；MD-DFT闭环试点显示自动接受门控可拦截违反历史弹性群能量或振动容差的更新。
AI.conclusion: 这些组件构成一种保留约束的微调协议，可改善塑性变形相关观测量并保持所测试的体相力学响应。

title: Third harmonic generation in the transition metal trichalcogenides
summary: The transition metal trichalcogenides (TMTs) are an interesting class of layered 2D materials that have strong anisotropic electrical and optical properties. We report on the polarization-dependent nonlinear optical response of exfoliated crystals at the third harmonic using non-resonant excitation with a 1560 nm femtosecond laser. All members of the TMT crystal family explored (ZrS3, HfS3, TiS3, and NbS3) display large anisotropy in their polarized third harmonic generation signal, with anisotropy ratios as large as chi_11/chi_22 ~ 6.5. From the expected nonlinear dependence of these monoclinic and triclinic crystals we extract the relative nonlinear susceptibility coefficients. We find that the anisotropy ratio is largest for ZrS3 and decreases across the family, a trend we associate with the proximity of the third harmonic energy to the strongly b-polarized absorption edge of each material. NbS3, the only triclinic crystal, displays a pronounced anisotropy in thick flakes that is strongly reduced in the thinnest flakes, which we attribute to a partial relaxation of the Peierls-type Nb-Nb dimerization that underlies the triclinic distortion. The large anisotropic nonlinear response in this crystal family sets it apart from other 2D materials and makes it particularly attractive for further investigation.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了剥离的过渡金属三硫族化物（ZrS3、HfS3、TiS3、NbS3）在1560 nm飞秒激光非共振激发下的偏振依赖三次谐波产生，发现强各向异性非线性光学响应，最大χ11/χ22约6.5，并归因于能带吸收边接近及NbS3中Peierls型二聚化变化。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属三硫族化物是具强各向异性电学和光学性质的层状二维材料，但其偏振依赖非线性光学响应，尤其三次谐波产生，尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 对剥离的ZrS3、HfS3、TiS3和NbS3晶体使用1560 nm飞秒激光进行非共振激发，测量偏振依赖的三次谐波产生信号，并基于单斜和三斜晶体的非线性依赖关系提取相对非线性 susceptibilities 系数。
AI.result: 所有研究的TMT材料均表现强的偏振三次谐波各向异性，χ11/χ22可达约6.5；各向异性比在ZrS3最大并沿该材料系列递减，与三次谐波能量接近各材料强b偏振吸收边相关；三斜NbS3厚片各向异性显著而薄片明显减弱，归因于Peierls型Nb-Nb二聚化的部分弛豫。
AI.conclusion: 该晶体家族具有远超其他二维材料的大各向异性非线性响应，尤其适合进一步研究非线性光学效应与结构/电子各向异性及厚度调控机制。

title: Autonomous atomistic-continuum coupling through uncertainty-aware active learning
summary: We develop an uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling approach for coupling an atomistic kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) surface-chemistry solver with a continuum multi-species fluid dynamics solver across disparate physical length and time scales. The surrogate model predicts boundary mass fluxes for six species and their uncertainties, which the continuum solver monitors to automatically trigger additional KMC simulations when new training data are needed. This enables efficient multiscale coupling and maintains a user-specified level of accuracy. We demonstrate the approach for reactive halide-perovskite vapor deposition, which involves a multi-species vapor jet impinging on a reactive substrate. The KMC solver uses a DFT-calibrated energetics model that we construct as part of this work and provides net deposition and desorption rates for six species. With a conservative uncertainty threshold, the surrogate-coupled approach reproduces cumulative mass fluxes of the directly coupled approach with errors typically within 10-20%, while capturing the non-monotonic dependence of net deposition on species partial pressure. Importantly, the results show that detailed crystal structure need not be explicitly represented to predict quantities exchanged between atomistic and continuum solvers; species-resolved mass fluxes provide a sufficiently low-dimensional representation of the atomistic response. For this accuracy target, the autonomous online-learning approach reduces the number of required atomistic simulations by two to three orders of magnitude relative to direct multiscale coupling.

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知代理模型，用于耦合原子尺度KMC表面化学求解器与连续介质多组分流体求解器；代理模型预测六种物种的边界质量通量及不确定性，并在需要时自动触发额外KMC模拟，从而在保持指定精度的同时显著降低多尺度耦合成本。
AI.motivation: 直接耦合原子尺度KMC与连续介质流体求解器跨尺度计算成本极高；需要一种能维持用户指定精度、并自动判断何时补充训练数据的在线学习方法。
AI.method: 构建DFT校准能量学模型的KMC求解器，输出六种物种的净沉积/解吸速率；训练不确定性感知代理模型预测边界质量通量及其不确定性，连续介质求解器监测不确定性并在超过阈值时触发新KMC模拟；以反应性卤化物钙钛矿气相沉积多物种蒸气射流为案例验证。
AI.result: 在保守不确定性阈值下，代理耦合方法复现直接耦合的累积质量通量，误差通常为10–20%，并捕捉净沉积对物种分压的非单调依赖；物种分辨质量通量足以作为原子尺度响应的低维表示，无需显式表示详细晶体结构；自主在线学习将所需原子模拟次数相对直接多尺度耦合减少2–3个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知代理模型可实现高效、精度可控的KMC-连续介质多尺度耦合；对于所关注的交换量，物种分辨质量通量是足够的低维表示，在线学习能大幅减少原子模拟需求。

title: Chemical Substitution as a Route to Anomalous Surface Superconductivity in NiBi$_3$
summary: Stabilizing two-dimensional superconductivity in a bulk superconducting material provides a unique route to exploring the interplay between superconducting condensates of different dimensionalities. Here, we present evidence for a distinct surface-associated superconducting state in Pb-substituted NiBi$_3$. NiBi$_{2.8}$Pb$_{0.2}$ exhibits a resistive onset at $T_{c,\mathrm{onset}}^{*}\approx8.1$~K, nearly twice the bulk superconducting transition temperature of approximately 4.1~K. The absence of a corresponding Meissner response or specific-heat anomaly at the higher-temperature transition supports its non-bulk origin. A cusp-like angular dependence of the critical field, well described by the two-dimensional Tinkham model, together with nonlinear current--voltage characteristics and signatures of a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless transition, establishes the low-dimensional character of this superconducting state. Remarkably, the surface-associated superconductivity persists well beyond the bulk upper critical field, reaching a maximum ratio of $H_{c3}/H_{c2}\approx4.3$, far exceeding the conventional Saint-James--de Gennes value of 1.695. These results demonstrate that Pb substitution can stabilize an anomalously enhanced low-dimensional superconducting state in NiBi$_3$, providing a platform for investigating superconductivity at the boundary of a bulk superconductor.

AI.tldr: 在Pb取代的NiBi3中观测到一种与表面相关的低维超导态，其转变温度约8.1 K，约为体相4.1 K的两倍，并表现出二维Tinkham临界场角度依赖、非线性I-V和BKT转变特征。
AI.motivation: 在体超导材料中稳定二维超导性，可为研究不同维度超导凝聚态之间的相互作用提供独特平台。
AI.method: 通过Pb取代NiBi3制备NiBi2.8Pb0.2，结合电阻转变、Meissner响应和比热测量判断其非体相起源，并利用临界场角度依赖、非线性电流-电压特性及BKT转变特征表征低维超导性。
AI.result: NiBi2.8Pb0.2在Tc,onset*≈8.1 K出现电阻起始转变，而体相Tc约4.1 K；该高温转变无对应Meissner响应或比热异常。临界场角度依赖符合二维Tinkham模型，并观察到非线性I-V和BKT转变特征；表面相关超导还可在体相上临界场以上存活，Hc3/Hc2最高约4.3，远超Saint-James-de Gennes值1.695。
AI.conclusion: Pb取代可在NiBi3中稳定异常增强的低维表面超导态，为研究体超导体边界处的超导性提供平台。

title: Field misalignment effect on the in-plane magnetoresistance in the high-temperature superconductor FeSe/SrTiO3
summary: The azimuthal angular dependence of the in-plane magnetoresistance provides a powerful probe for detecting rotational symmetry breaking in superconductors, which has significant implications for understanding the superconducting pairing symmetry and the intertwined orders. However, in two-dimensional or layered superconductors with strong anisotropy between in-plane and out-of-plane critical fields, measuring the in-plane magnetoresistance is particularly challenging as it is extremely sensitive to the field misalignment. Here we perform systematic electrical transport measurements on ultrathin FeSe films grown on SrTiO3 substrates. By remounting the same FeSe film to change the field misalignment, two qualitatively different angular dependences of the in-plane magnetoresistance are observed in the superconducting transition region, indicating the extreme sensitivity of the measurement to field misalignment. The observed anisotropic in-plane magnetoresistance can be well captured by our geometric model considering the field misalignment effect. Our work provides a practical framework for disentangling the misalignment effect and investigating the in-plane rotational symmetry breaking in two-dimensional or layered superconductors.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出超薄FeSe薄膜的面内磁阻角向依赖对磁场失配极其敏感，并建立几何模型区分失配效应与面内旋转对称性破缺信号。
AI.motivation: 面内磁阻的方位角依赖可用于探测超导体中的旋转对称性破缺，但在面内/面外临界场各向异性强的二维或层状超导体中，测量极易受磁场失配影响。
AI.method: 在SrTiO3衬底上生长超薄FeSe薄膜并进行系统电输运测量；通过重新安装同一FeSe薄膜改变磁场失配角，比较超导转变区的面内磁阻角向依赖，并构建考虑场失配效应的几何模型。
AI.result: 同一FeSe薄膜在不同磁场失配下呈现两种定性不同的面内磁阻角向依赖，表明测量对场失配极端敏感；观测到的各向异性面内磁阻可由考虑场失配的几何模型很好描述。
AI.conclusion: 工作提供了分离磁场失配效应与研究二维或层状超导体面内旋转对称性破缺的实用框架。
