title: Controllable charge-spin conversion in sliding multiferroic metal Fe3GaTe2
summary: Controlling charge--spin conversion within a single magnetic material is important for compact spintronic devices. Using first-principles calculations, symmetry analysis, and Wannier-based linear response, we study the Edelstein and spin Hall responses of sliding-ferroelectric bilayer \ce{Fe3GaTe2}. Two degenerate ground states with opposite interlayer sliding vectors and out-of-plane dipole moments are separated by a calculated switching barrier of about $16.3$~meV per unit cell. Magnetization orientation determines the allowed current-induced spin components, while ferroelectric switching induces component-selective sign reversals governed by $M_z\mathcal T$ for in-plane magnetization and by $M_z$ for out-of-plane magnetization. The Edelstein response is strongly energy dependent, with spin accumulation approaching $2~\hbar$ for $\mathbf m\parallel+y$ under a reference field of $1$~V/\AA. Momentum-resolved analysis links the TR-even and TR-odd Edelstein responses to $\Gamma$-centered constant-energy contours and localized interband features, respectively. Spin-conductivity contributions show the opposite momentum-space character, with broad sign-competing spin Berry curvature for TR-even and narrow Fermi-surface contours for TR-odd. The transverse spin Hall conductivity reaches $\sim10^{3}\,(\hbar/e)(\mathrm{S/cm})$ and depends strongly on ferroelectric state and magnetization direction. Magnetization rotations in the $xy$ and $xz$ planes reveal symmetry-allowed higher angular harmonics in both spin accumulation and spin-current responses. These results establish sliding-ferroelectric bilayer \ce{Fe3GaTe2} as a tunable platform for reconfigurable spin accumulation and spin-current generation.

AI.tldr: 该文通过第一性原理、对称性与Wannier线性响应研究滑动铁电双层Fe3GaTe2的Edelstein与自旋霍尔响应，表明其可实现由铁电态和磁化方向调控的可重构电荷-自旋转换。
AI.motivation: 在单一磁性材料内控制电荷-自旋转换对紧凑型自旋电子器件很重要，需要理解滑动铁电性与磁化方向如何共同决定自旋积累和自旋流响应。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算、对称性分析和基于Wannier函数的线性响应，计算滑动铁电双层Fe3GaTe2的Edelstein响应与自旋霍尔响应，并进行动量分辨分析；两个相反层间滑动矢量与面外偶极矩的简并基态间开关势垒约16.3 meV/单胞。
AI.result: 磁化取向决定允许的电流诱导自旋分量；铁电翻转导致分量选择性符号反转，面内磁化受M_z T对称性支配，面外磁化受M_z支配。Edelstein响应强烈依赖能量，在1 V/Å参考场、m∥+y时自旋积累接近2 ħ。动量分辨分析将TR-even与TR-odd Edelstein响应分别联系到Γ中心等能轮廓和局域带间特征；自旋电导贡献具有相反动量空间特征，TR-even为宽且符号竞争的自旋Berry曲率，TR-odd为窄费米面轮廓。横向自旋霍尔电导达约10^3 (ħ/e)(S/cm)，并强烈依赖铁电态与磁化方向。xy和xz面内磁化旋转显示自旋积累与自旋流响应中存在对称性允许的高阶角谐波。
AI.conclusion: 滑动铁电双层Fe3GaTe2是一个可通过铁电态和磁化方向调控的自旋积累与自旋流产生平台，适用于可重构自旋电子器件。

title: Phase fluctuations dominated superconductivity in a thick Granular Boron-Doped Diamond film
summary: We investigate the superconducting properties of a 1.2-{\mu}m-thick granular boron-doped diamond film, where tightly packed grains form a disordered network of Josephson junctions. The film exhibits a sharp superconducting transition at a critical temperature, T_c ~ 3 K. Its transport properties are well described by the Ambegaokar-Halperin theory of phase fluctuations. Direct measurements of the penetration depth using a two-coil mutual inductance technique reveal classic phase-fluctuation-dominated behavior: below T_c, the superfluid density (n_s) varies linearly over a wide temperature range - a hallmark of thermal phase fluctuations - before crossing over to a T^2 dependence at ultra-low temperatures. Both the large low-temperature penetration depth, {\lambda}(0) ~ 8.8 {\mu}m, and the slope of the linear ns variation in the thermal regime reveal a remarkably low superfluid stiffness in the range of 0.5-0.8 K. These results establish granular boron-doped diamond films as an excellent model system for investigating the role of long-wavelength phase fluctuations in three-dimensional superconductors.

AI.tldr: 该文研究1.2 μm厚颗粒型硼掺杂金刚石薄膜的超导性质，发现其由致密晶粒构成无序约瑟夫森结网络，表现为相涨落主导的三维超导体，并可作为研究长波相位涨落的模型体系。
AI.motivation: 颗粒型硼掺杂金刚石薄膜中超导晶粒通过弱连接形成无序约瑟夫森结网络，可能显著影响超流刚度并引入相位涨落；作者希望厘清其超导转变、穿透深度和超流密度行为，检验相位涨落理论在三维颗粒超导体中的适用性。
AI.method: 测量Tc约3 K的颗粒型硼掺杂金刚石薄膜输运性质，并用双线圈互感技术直接测量穿透深度，分析超流密度随温度的变化，并与Ambegaokar-Halperin相位涨落理论比较。
AI.result: 薄膜具有尖锐超导转变；低于Tc时超流密度在较宽温区呈线性变化，超低温下转为T^2依赖；零温穿透深度λ(0)约8.8 μm，线性区斜率给出超流刚度仅约0.5–0.8 K，显示极低超流刚度及热相位涨落主导特征。
AI.conclusion: 颗粒型硼掺杂金刚石薄膜是研究三维超导体中长波相位涨落作用的优秀模型体系，其超导输运和穿透深度行为可由相位涨落图像统一描述。

title: Methyl radicals dynamics on (100)--(2x1):H diamond surfaces based on refined variational transition state calculations of gas-surface reaction rate coefficients
summary: Theoretical modelling of diamond growth should ideally provide estimates of the growth rate depending on experimental conditions. To that end, a description of all possible reactions related to the competing adsorption, desorption and migration mechanisms is required. Here, we provide precise calculations of the reaction rate coefficient of methyl-related reactions on hydrogen-terminated (100) diamond surface, as $\mathrm{CH_3}$ is known to be the main growth precursor in chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth of diamond. To achieve this goal, we successfully combined Density Functional Theory (DFT) and variational transition state theory (VTST), allowing to extend our analysis to barrierless reaction. Our rigorous treatment of the quasi-free rotation of $\mathrm{CH_3}$ adsorbates on the surface allows us to overcome numerical errors for the finite difference calculations of the vibrational spectra for evaluating the partition functions of the system. Our results suggest that the mechanism that deplete the $\mathrm{CH_3}$ concentration the most is the absorption on a surface radical site. We also evidence the anisotropy of $\mathrm{CH_3}$ migration along the dimer of the (100)-(2x1):H surface. In a more general perspective, the calculated reaction rates coefficient for methyl reactions and migration presented in this work, together with the data for hydrogen reaction and other main gas surface reactions, bridge the gap between the atomic-scale description and the large-scale modelling of diamond growth.

AI.tldr: 该工作用DFT结合变分过渡态理论计算氢终止(100)金刚石表面甲基相关反应的速率系数，并揭示CH3吸附消耗与迁移各向异性。
AI.motivation: 金刚石CVD生长的理论建模需要基于实验条件估算生长速率，因此必须描述竞争性的吸附、脱附与迁移等反应；CH3被认为是CVD金刚石生长的主要前驱体。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论(DFT)与变分过渡态理论(VTST)，将分析扩展到无势垒反应；对表面CH3吸附物的准自由转动进行严格处理，以克服振动谱有限差分计算及配分函数评估中的数值误差。
AI.result: 给出了氢终止(100)金刚石表面甲基相关反应与迁移的反应速率系数；发现消耗CH3浓度最强的机制是在表面自由基位点上的吸附，并证实CH3沿(100)-(2x1):H表面二聚体迁移具有各向异性。
AI.conclusion: 计算的甲基反应与迁移速率系数可与氢反应及其他主要气-表面反应数据结合，弥合金刚石生长从原子尺度描述到宏观尺度建模之间的差距。

title: Non-magnetic impurities as a quantum microscope of finite size effects in spin chains
summary: Finite-size effects are ubiquitous in quantum matter, yet typically invisible in the thermodynamic limit; when system size is restricted, boundaries and confinement reveal modified spectra, correlations, and emergent phenomena. With growing access to well-controlled few-spin systems, these effects are now directly observable and offer a route to probing universal physics and enabling quantum information applications. Here, we study finite-size physics in the quasi-one-dimensional Ising-like quantum antiferromagnet Ba(Co$_{1-x}$Mg$_x$)$_2$V$_2$O$_8$ with $x = 2\%$ and $x = 5\%$, where non-magnetic Mg$^{2+}$ ions fragment the Co$^{2+}$ spin chains into finite segments. Combining inelastic neutron scattering and numerical calculations, we identify distinct regimes with fundamentally different low-energy quantum excitations: spinons confined to chain boundaries, and a cluster mode in shorter chains corresponding to a collective reversal of the N\'eel-ordered segment without classical analogue. Our results demonstrate how chemical substitution acts as a quantum microscope providing direct access to boundary-shaped excitations in strongly correlated spin systems.

AI.tldr: 利用非磁性Mg²⁺掺杂将准一维Ising型量子反铁磁体Ba(Co₁₋ₓMgₓ)₂V₂O₈中的Co²⁺自旋链碎片化，结合非弹性中子散射与数值计算，揭示了有限尺寸链中由边界限制产生的自旋子和无经典对应的团簇反转模式。
AI.motivation: 有限尺寸效应在量子物质中普遍存在，但在热力学极限下通常不可见；受限体系会改变谱、关联与涌现现象。随着少自旋体系可控性增强，有限尺寸效应可直接观测，并为探测普适物理和量子信息应用提供途径。
AI.method: 研究x=2%和x=5%的Ba(Co₁₋ₓMgₓ)₂V₂O₈，其中非磁性Mg²⁺离子将Co²⁺自旋链分割为有限链段；结合非弹性中子散射实验与数值计算分析低能量子激发。
AI.result: 识别出具有根本不同低能激发的区域：被限制在链边界的自旋子，以及较短链中的团簇模式；后者对应于Néel有序链段的集体反转，且无经典对应。
AI.conclusion: 化学替代可作为“量子显微镜”，在强关联自旋体系中直接访问由边界塑造的激发，并展示有限尺寸物理用于探测普适物理和量子信息应用的潜力。

title: Orbital-selective correlations in kagome flat bands of Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$
summary: Geometrical flat bands provide an ideal platform for studying electronic correlations and quantum-geometric effects. Although the ferromagnetic Weyl semimetal \CoSnS is generally considered a moderately correlated system, recent spectroscopy experiments have revealed a flat-band feature near the Fermi level ($\EF$) that is absent in conventional density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Using DFT plus dynamical mean-field theory and a minimal kagome model, we show that this feature arises not from heavy-fermion-like dynamical band renormalization, but from the shifting of a $d_{x^2-y^2}$ dominated geometrical kagome flat band toward $\EF$ driven by orbital- and spin-dependent self-energies. The relocated flat band enhances the local Berry curvature near $\EF$, resulting in a strongly energy-dependent anomalous Hall conductivity and a giant anomalous Nernst effect. Our findings establish an orbital-selective correlation mechanism for positioning geometrical flat bands at $\EF$, and propose anomalous thermoelectric transport as a sensitive probe of flat band induced topology.

AI.tldr: 该文指出该铁磁Weyl半金属中近费米能级的平带特征并非传统DFT所能描述，而是由轨道与自旋依赖的自能驱动d_{x^2-y^2}主导的kagome几何平带向E_F移动所致，并由此产生强能量依赖的反常霍尔电导和巨反常Nernst效应。
AI.motivation: 几何平带是研究电子关联和量子几何效应的理想平台；实验观测到近E_F的平带特征而常规DFT无法解释，因此需要澄清其关联起源及可观测效应。
AI.method: 采用DFT加动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）并结合最小kagome模型，分析自能对能带和平带位置的影响。
AI.result: 近E_F平带来自d_{x^2-y^2}主导的几何kagome平带在轨道和自旋依赖自能作用下的移动，而非重费米子式动力学能带重整化；平带移至E_F附近增强局域Berry曲率，导致强能量依赖的反常霍尔电导和巨反常Nernst效应。
AI.conclusion: 建立了将几何平带定位到E_F的轨道选择性关联机制，并表明反常热电输运可作为平带诱导拓扑性质的灵敏探针。

title: Growth Phase Map of {\alpha} and \b{eta} Tantalum as a Function of Growth Temperature and Oxygen Partial Pressure
summary: Tantalum thin films are used in low-loss superconducting quantum circuits, yet the growth conditions governing selection of $\alpha$-Ta(110), $\alpha$-Ta(111), and metastable $\beta$-Ta on c-plane sapphire remain uncertain. We deposited 100 nm Ta films by dc magnetron sputtering on Al$_2$O$_3$(0001) at 300-900 $^\circ$C while varying the O$_2$ partial pressure from a $5.5\times10^{-11}$ Torr ultrahigh-vacuum baseline to $2.23\times10^{-4}$ Torr. Absorption-corrected X-ray diffraction texture coefficients were used to construct a ternary phase-orientation growth map in terms of temperature and the oxygen-to-Ta impingement flux ratio ($2\Phi_{O_2}/\Phi_{Ta}\leq4.8\times10^{-6}$ to 19). Without added oxygen, $\alpha$-Ta(110) dominated at every temperature. At an O$_2$ pressure of only $2.5\times10^{-9}$ Torr ($2\Phi_{O_2}/\Phi_{Ta}=2.2\times10^{-4}$), $\alpha$-Ta(111) accounted for 98-99% of the normalized texture weight from 300 to 700 $^\circ$C, decreasing to 65% at 900 $^\circ$C. Substantial $\beta$-Ta formed only at the highest oxygen dose, dominating at 300 $^\circ$C and disappearing at 900 $^\circ$C. The apparent $\beta$(001)/$\alpha$(110) selection energy of $1.07\pm0.16$ eV is comparable to the activation energy for oxygen diffusion in Ta, consistent with oxygen transport influencing phase selection. Oxygen also produced orientation-dependent changes in crystallite size and microstrain. These findings establish oxygen-controlled processing windows for phase- and orientation-selective growth of Ta films for superconducting devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统绘制了c面蓝宝石上溅射钽薄膜的温度-氧通量相/取向生长图，表明微量氧可选择性稳定α-Ta(111)，高氧剂量促进β-Ta，并给出超导器件用Ta薄膜的氧控工艺窗口。
AI.motivation: Ta薄膜用于低损耗超导量子电路，但在c面蓝宝石上α-Ta(110)、α-Ta(111)与亚稳β-Ta的择优生长条件，尤其氧和温度的作用尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用直流磁控溅射在Al2O3(0001)上沉积100 nm Ta薄膜，温度300–900 °C，O2分压从5.5×10^-11 Torr超高分压基线调至2.23×10^-4 Torr；用吸收校正XRD织构系数构建温度与氧/钽撞击通量比（2ΦO2/ΦTa≤4.8×10^-6至19）的 ternary 相-取向生长图。
AI.result: 无额外氧时各温度均为α-Ta(110)主导；仅2.5×10^-9 Torr O2（2ΦO2/ΦTa=2.2×10^-4）时，300–700 °C下α-Ta(111)占归一化织构权重98–99%，900 °C降至65%；β-Ta仅在最高氧剂量显著形成，300 °C主导、900 °C消失。β(001)/α(110)表观选择能为1.07±0.16 eV，与Ta中氧扩散激活能相当；氧还引起晶粒尺寸和微应变的取向依赖变化。
AI.conclusion: 氧分压与温度共同决定Ta薄膜的相和取向选择，建立了α-Ta(110)、α-Ta(111)及β-Ta的氧控生长窗口，为超导器件中相/取向选择性Ta薄膜制备提供依据。

title: Electrically Reversible Layer-Tensor Responses in Bilayers
summary: The layer Hall effect provides a prototypical example of a hidden layer response in van der Waals bilayers: opposite layers carry compensating Hall currents at zero out-of-plane electric field, while an applied out-of-plane electric field $E_z$ selects one layer over the other and switches the net Hall response. Here we show that this field-switching mechanism is not restricted to Hall transport, but follows from a general symmetry principle for response tensors. We formulate a selection rule for the layer tensor effect (LTE) using Jahn symbols. For a tensor with Jahn symbol $J$ and rank $r$, the stacking operation that exchanges the two layers acts as a coset representative relating the $+E_z$ and $-E_z$ states. Tensor components that are odd under this operation are forced to cancel between layers at $E_z=0$, and acquire a macroscopic response satisfying $T_\alpha(+E_z)=-T_\alpha(-E_z)$. This criterion allows us to enumerate the symmetry-allowed electrically reversible tensor components associated with different Jahn symbols and to identify their physical realizations in common response tensors. We apply the theory to representative anomalous Hall, shift-current, nonlinear Drude, piezoelectric, spin Hall, and spin-photocurrent channels. Model calculations and first-principles simulations further confirm the predicted field-odd responses. Our results establish an electrically switchable LTE framework, providing a unified route to multifunctional layertronic responses in bilayer materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“层张量效应”（LTE）的一般对称性框架，将双层体系中可由面外电场 E_z 翻转的层霍尔效应推广到多种响应张量，并给出基于 Jahn 符号的选择规则与具体物理实现。
AI.motivation: 层霍尔效应体现了范德华双层中的隐藏层响应：零 E_z 时两层携带相互补偿的霍尔电流，施加 E_z 可选择其中一层并切换净响应。作者希望证明这种电场切换机制并非霍尔输运独有，而是源于响应张量的一般对称性原理。
AI.method: 作者用 Jahn 符号表述 LTE 选择规则：对具有 Jahn 符号 J、秩为 r 的张量，交换两层的堆叠操作作为联系 +E_z 与 -E_z 状态的陪集代表元。在该操作下为奇的张量分量在 E_z=0 时层间强制抵消，并获得满足 T_α(+E_z)=-T_α(-E_z) 的宏观响应。据此枚举不同 Jahn 符号对应的对称允许、电可逆张量分量，并应用于反常霍尔、位移电流、非线性 Drude、压电、自旋霍尔和自旋光电流等通道；模型计算与第一性原理模拟用于验证。
AI.result: 该框架系统识别了可由 E_z 电切换的层张量响应分量，并在反常霍尔、位移电流、非线性 Drude、压电、自旋霍尔和自旋光电流等代表性通道中给出物理实现；模型计算和第一性原理模拟进一步确认了预测的场奇响应。
AI.conclusion: 结果建立了电可切换的 LTE 框架，为双层材料中的多功能 layertronic 响应提供了统一路线，并将层霍尔效应推广为更普遍的层分辨张量响应对称性机制。

title: The Evolution and Current State of Swift-Heavy-Ion Track Modeling
summary: This paper briefly reviews the modeling approaches to the swift heavy ion (SHI) track formation. It presents a step-by-step derivation of the two-temperature model, highlighting its underlying assumptions and approximations. Special attention is given to identifying assumptions that fail under the typical SHI track conditions, and what methods currently exist to go beyond them. As an alternative to analytical approximations, a combined Monte Carlo- molecular dynamics model is demonstrated, outlining its basic assumptions, their justifications, and validations. Finally, the paper addresses bottlenecks of the current multiscale approach, its remaining weaknesses, and necessary further developments of the theory and models.

AI.tldr: 综述快重离子（SHI）径迹形成的建模方法，重点推导双温模型（TTM）、分析其假设失效条件，并介绍蒙特卡洛-分子动力学（MC-MD）联合模型及多尺度方法的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 明确TTM在典型SHI径迹条件下哪些假设不再成立，并梳理超越解析近似的现有方法与模型需求。
AI.method: 逐步推导TTM并讨论其基本假设与近似；识别失效假设及对应改进方法；展示MC-MD联合模型的基本假设、合理性与验证；评述当前多尺度方法的瓶颈与不足。
AI.result: 指出TTM在SHI径迹条件下的适用性限制，说明MC-MD可作为解析近似的替代方案，并总结其假设依据、验证情况及多尺度框架的剩余弱点。
AI.conclusion: 当前多尺度建模仍存在瓶颈，需要进一步发展理论与模型以更可靠地描述SHI径迹形成。

title: Equivalent Pseudo-angular Momentum Governs Selective Magnon-Phonon Hybridization
summary: Magnon-phonon hybridization provides a powerful route to couple spin and lattice excitations, yet the symmetry principle governing mode selectivity remains unclear. Here, we show that crystalline pseudoangular momentum provides a general criterion for selective magnon-phonon hybridization in noncollinear multisublattice magnetic systems. The rotation eigenvalue associated with pseudoangular momentum encodes polarization transformations, sublattice permutations, and Bloch phases, requiring magnetoelastic coupling between modes belonging to the same rotation sector. We illustrate this principle in a stacked kagome model with noncollinear spin order. An out-of-plane magnetic field tunes one magnon sector into resonance with a degenerate phonon doublet, yet only the pseudoangular-momentum-matched phonon develops a pronounced avoided crossing while the other remains nearly unmixed. Field reversal switches the selected rotation sector and reverses the rotational polarization of the hybridized phonon component without changing the hybrid-mode energies. Our results reveal pseudoangular-momentum matching as a general framework for understanding and controlling mode-selective spin-lattice hybridization.

AI.tldr: 该文提出晶体赝角动量匹配是非共线多子格磁体中实现选择性磁子-声子杂化的通用判据，并在堆叠kagome模型中验证了磁场可调控的模式选择性杂化。
AI.motivation: 磁子-声子杂化可耦合自旋与晶格激发，但决定模式选择性的对称性原理尚不清晰；作者旨在建立一般性选择定则。
AI.method: 引入晶体赝角动量及其旋转本征值，将偏振变换、子格置换和Bloch相位纳入同一旋转扇区；要求磁弹耦合仅发生在同一旋转扇区的模式之间。随后在具有非共线自旋序的堆叠kagome模型中，利用面外磁场调节磁子扇区与简并声子双峰共振。
AI.result: 仅赝角动量匹配的声子模式与磁子发生显著反交叉，另一声子几乎不混合；反向磁场切换被选择的旋转扇区并反转杂化声子分量的旋转偏振，而杂化模式能量保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 赝角动量匹配为理解和控制模式选择性自旋-晶格杂化提供了通用框架，并给出了通过磁场切换杂化通道与旋转偏振的机制。

title: Giant third-order nonlinearity amplifies second-harmonic transport in Ca3Ru2O7
summary: Nonlinear electrical transport enables the conversion and detection of electromagnetic signals, supporting wireless energy harvesting, sensing and frequency conversion. Achieving both a large response and electrical tunability remains a central materials challenge. Here we harness giant third-order nonlinearity to amplify and electrically control second-harmonic transport in the correlated polar metal Ca3Ru2O7. Superposing a dc bias on an ac excitation enhances the second-harmonic signal by more than an order of magnitude. The bias controls the polarity of the induced response and activates channels forbidden by symmetry at zero bias. Both transverse and longitudinal components scale quadratically with the ac excitation and are odd in the dc bias, with angular dependences consistent with third-order conductivity. The underlying third-harmonic electric-field responsivity reaches 4.5 \times 10-6 m2V-2 at 3 K, providing a quantitative measure of the strong nonlinearity. The induced response emerges below the spin-reorientation transition near 48 K, linking its enhancement to the reconstructed low-temperature electronic state. Theoretical calculations identify quantum-geometric contributions to the nonlinear conductivity and reproduce the observed response symmetry. These results demonstrate how strong higher-order nonlinearity can amplify an effective second-order response, providing a route to electrically tunable nonlinear transport in correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 在关联极性金属Ca3Ru2O7中利用巨大三阶非线性放大并电控二次谐波输运，dc偏置可使二次谐波增强逾一个量级并切换响应极性。
AI.motivation: 非线性电输运需要同时实现大响应与电可调，但二者兼得仍是材料难题；本文探索利用强高阶非线性来放大并调控有效二阶响应。
AI.method: 在ac激发上叠加dc偏置测量二次谐波输运，分析横向与纵向分量对ac的二次标度、对dc的奇对称性及角度依赖，提取三阶电场响应率，并用理论计算量子几何贡献。
AI.result: dc偏置使二次谐波信号增强超过10倍，可控制响应极性并激活零偏置下对称禁戒通道；横向和纵向分量随ac二次增长、随dc呈奇对称，角度依赖符合三阶电导；3 K下三阶电场响应率达4.5×10^-6 m^2 V^-2；响应在约48 K自旋重取向转变以下出现，理论计算重现观测对称性。
AI.conclusion: 强高阶非线性可放大有效二阶响应，为关联材料中电可调非线性输运提供途径；低温重构电子态及量子几何贡献对非线性响应至关重要。

title: Cooperation of itinerant and localized physics in the magnetic phase diagram of 214 Ruddlesden-Popper iridates
summary: The $5d^5$ Ruddlesden-Popper iridates Sr$_2$IrO$_4$ and Ba$_2$IrO$_4$ have attracted considerable attention as spin-orbit entangled analogues of the cuprates, yet the origin of their antiferromagnetic insulating state, of Slater or of Mott-Heisenberg type, remains debated. We find that both materials sit in an intermediate regime in which itinerant and localized electrons cooperate in stabilizing the antiferromagnetic order, with Ba$_2$IrO$_4$ slightly more correlated than Sr$_2$IrO$_4$. We obtain this by computing, within dynamical mean-field theory, the interaction-temperature phase diagram of a realistic three-orbital $t_{2g}$ Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. Our study shows that neither the behavior of the gap across the N\'eel temperature nor the spin-polaron features of the spectral function unambiguously identify the cooperative regime, whereas the two-peak structure of the optical conductivity is reproduced only there and therefore constitutes a reliable fingerprint. By placing both compounds in a common phase diagram, our results reconcile seemingly contradictory experimental and theoretical reports, and provide a unified framework for future studies of the 214 iridates and of other spin-orbit coupled correlated materials.

AI.tldr: 该文通过DMFT计算现实三轨道t2g Hubbard模型（含自旋轨道耦合），指出Sr2IrO4和Ba2IrO4的反铁磁绝缘态处于 itinerant 与 localized 电子协同稳定的中间区域，Ba2IrO4关联稍强于Sr2IrO4。
AI.motivation: 5d5 Ruddlesden-Popper铱氧化物Sr2IrO4和Ba2IrO4被视为铜氧化物的自旋轨道纠缠类似物，但其反铁磁绝缘态源于Slater机制还是Mott-Heisenberg机制仍存在争议。
AI.method: 在动态平均场理论（DMFT）框架内，构建含自旋轨道耦合的现实三轨道t2g Hubbard模型，计算相互作用-温度相图，并比较能隙、谱函数自旋极化子特征及光学电导。
AI.result: 两种材料均位于 itinerant 与 localized 电子协同稳定反铁磁序的中间区间，Ba2IrO4比Sr2IrO4略更关联；跨越Néel温度的能隙行为和自旋极化子谱特征不能唯一识别该协同区，而光学电导的双峰结构仅在该区出现，可作为可靠指纹。
AI.conclusion: 将两种化合物置于统一相图中可调和看似矛盾的实验与理论报道，并为214铱氧化物及其他自旋轨道耦合强关联材料研究提供统一框架。

title: Exact Magnetic Confinement of a Doped Hole by Kinetic Frustration
summary: We establish an exact mechanism of magnetic confinement driven purely by kinetic frustration. In a finite open sawtooth $U=\infty$ Hubbard chain of $L$ unit cells doped with one hole, the ground state at magnetization $M$ contains $M$ polarized triplet dimers surrounding a connected singlet region of length $\ell_{\rm s}=L-M$. A magnetic field selects $M$ and hence the confinement length. The hole forms a standing wave in the singlet region with exponential tails in the triplet background. Confinement requires neither disorder nor an exchange-generated string tension: destructive interference between direct and apex-mediated hopping makes the triplet bonds reflecting. At $t_2/t_1=[2+4\cos(\pi/(\ell_{\rm s}+2))]^{-1/2}$, they become perfectly reflecting, producing a position-degenerate compact localized state. At every fixed field $0<h<h_{\rm sat}$, the singlet region remains finite as $L\to\infty$ and shrinks stepwise with increasing field, whereas at $h=0$ it spans the system.

AI.tldr: 该文在有限开放锯齿形 U=∞ Hubbard 链中给出一种仅由动能阻挫驱动的精确磁约束机制：磁场选择磁化 M，从而控制由 M 个极化三重态二聚体包围的单态区长度 ℓ_s=L−M，并决定空穴的局域化与约束尺度。
AI.motivation: 旨在阐明无需无序、也无需交换作用产生的弦张力即可实现磁约束的微观机制，并揭示动能阻挫如何通过量子干涉导致反射边界和空穴局域化。
AI.method: 解析研究掺杂一个空穴的有限开放锯齿形 U=∞ Hubbard 链；按磁化 M 分析基态结构，将空穴视为单态区中的驻波并研究其向三重态背景的指数尾；通过直接跃迁与顶点介导跃迁的相消干涉分析三重态键的反射性质及紧致局域态条件。
AI.result: 基态含 M 个极化三重态二聚体和长度 ℓ_s=L−M 的连通单态区；磁场选择 M 并调节约束长度。空穴在单态区形成驻波，在三重态背景中呈指数尾。当 t2/t1=[2+4cos(π/(ℓ_s+2))]^{-1/2} 时三重态键完全反射，产生位置简并的紧致局域态。对每个固定 0<h<h_sat，单态区在 L→∞ 时仍有限，并随磁场增大逐级收缩；而在 h=0 时单态区覆盖整个系统。
AI.conclusion: 动能阻挫本身即可产生精确的磁约束：磁场可选择性设定三重态二聚体数目和单态区长度，并通过干涉使三重态键成为反射边界；该机制导致有限尺寸的磁约束区域和可调的紧致局域化，而不依赖无序或交换弦张力。

title: Tuning from intrinsic to disorder-dominated quantum states in a kagome antiferromagnet
summary: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet (AFM) provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing quantum spin-liquid (QSL) and magnetization-plateau states. Experimental progress, however, has been hindered by structural disorder, whose effects on these quantum states remain elusive. A key experimental challenge is therefore to connect intrinsic and disorder-dominated regimes through controlled disorder and identify emergent degrees of freedom associated with disorder. Here we introduce controlled point defects through electron irradiation into the spin-1/2 kagome AFM YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) and track the resulting evolution of its low-energy magnetic states. High-field magnetic torque measurements reveal that the 1/9 and 1/3 magnetization plateaus are strongly suppressed by only ~0.05% irradiation-induced defects, demonstrating that these delicate quantum many-body states are extraordinarily fragile against dilute disorder. Moreover, the irradiation induces a sign reversal of the magnetic torque only at low temperatures and low fields, indicating the emergence of correlated defect-induced moments rather than isolated free spins. Remarkably, the characteristic scaling of the magnetic specific heat, absent in pristine YCOB, progressively emerges with increasing disorder. These findings establish dilute disorder as an effective tuning parameter that drives the kagome AFM from intrinsic quantum states toward a disorder-dominated regime. The contrasting responses further identify pristine YCOB as an exceptionally clean kagome AFM for accessing intrinsic quantum states.

AI.tldr: 通过电子辐照在极干净的自旋-1/2 kagome反铁磁体YCOB中引入约0.05%的可控点缺陷，发现1/9与1/3磁化平台对稀薄无序极其脆弱，并揭示了缺陷诱导关联磁矩及无序主导低能磁态的涌现。
AI.motivation: 自旋-1/2 kagome海森堡反铁磁体是研究量子自旋液体和磁化平台态的典型平台，但结构无序对这些问题量子态的影响尚不清楚；关键挑战在于通过可控无序连接本征区与无序主导区，并识别无序诱导的新兴自由度。
AI.method: 在自旋-1/2 kagome反铁磁体YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5（YCOB）中利用电子辐照引入可控点缺陷，并通过高场磁转矩测量和磁比热测量追踪低能磁态随无序的演化。
AI.result: 仅约0.05%的辐照缺陷即可强烈抑制1/9和1/3磁化平台，表明这些精细量子多体态对稀薄无序异常脆弱；辐照仅在低温和低场下诱导磁转矩符号反转，说明出现的是关联的缺陷诱导磁矩而非孤立自由自旋； pristine YCOB中缺失的磁比热特征标度行为随无序增加逐步出现。
AI.conclusion: 稀薄无序可作为有效调控参量，驱动kagome反铁磁体从本征量子态进入无序主导区；同时，原始YCOB被确认为可用于访问本征量子态的极干净kagome反铁磁体。

title: Fermionic superfluid transition and pairing scale separation in the kagome flat band
summary: Flat-band systems provide a promising platform for exploring exotic correlated phases owing to quenched kinetic energy and enhanced interaction effects. In this work, we investigate the flat-band superfluid transition in the attractive kagome Hubbard model using large-scale determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations accelerated by fast Fourier transforms and delay updates. Through systematic calculations of the transition temperature, spin susceptibility, and density compressibility, we establish the finite-temperature phase diagram at the flat-band filling $\rho=5/3$ and find a clear linear scaling of the superfluid transition temperature with the interaction strength, $T_{\mathrm{c}}=0.0314|U|$. Our results reveal a wide separation of temperature scales between local pair formation and global phase coherence, which stabilizes a broad intermediate supercompressible bosonic fluid region of preformed pairs that bridges the normal Fermi gas and the flat-band superfluid. We further demonstrate that both the transition temperature and density compressibility are significantly enhanced in the flat band compared to van Hove fillings. Our findings highlight the essential role of flat-band-enhanced pair-density fluctuations in separating the pairing and phase-coherence scales, offering clear experimental signatures for probing flat-band superfluidity and superconductivity in cold-atom and kagome-material platforms.

AI.tldr: 利用FFT与延迟更新加速的大规模行列式量子蒙特卡洛，研究吸引型kagome Hubbard模型在平带填充ρ=5/3下的超流转变，发现Tc随相互作用强度线性标度并存在宽温区的预配对玻色液体。
AI.motivation: 平带系统中动能被淬灭、相互作用效应增强，有望产生奇异关联相；作者旨在澄清平带超流转变温度、配对与相位相干尺度以及平带相对van Hove填充的增强效应。
AI.method: 采用快速傅里叶变换和延迟更新加速的大规模行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟吸引型kagome Hubbard模型，系统计算转变温度、自旋磁化率和密度压缩率，并建立平带填充ρ=5/3的有限温相图。
AI.result: 得到超流转变温度随相互作用强度线性标度：Tc=0.0314|U|；发现局域配对形成与全局相位相干之间存在显著温度尺度分离，形成连接正常费米气体与平带超流的宽中间超可压缩玻色液体（预配对）区域；平带中的Tc和密度压缩率均显著高于van Hove填充。
AI.conclusion: 平带增强的配对密度涨落是分离配对尺度与相位相干尺度的关键，为冷原子和kagome材料平台探测平带超流/超导提供明确实验特征。

title: Theory of the $1/9$ Magnetization Plateau of the Spin-$1/2$ Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet
summary: We investigate the $1/9$ magnetization plateau of the spin-$1/2$ kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet using infinite projected entangled-pair states and identify a spin-density-wave state with a $27$-site unit cell and a lower variational energy than previous approaches. In contrast to higher-magnetization plateaus, which are well described by localized magnons on nonoverlapping hexagons and preserve a sixfold rotational symmetry, the $1/9$ plateau only keeps a threefold rotational symmmetry and consists of a tiling by three types of $9$-site clusters related by $\pm2\pi/3$ rotations. These conclusions are supported by a complementary cluster mean-field theory which correctly preserves the symmetry of the higher plateaus but leads to the same spontaneous symmetry breaking for the $1/9$ plateau with a qualitatively similar pattern of nine different local magnetizations.

AI.tldr: 利用无限投影纠缠对态研究自旋-1/2 kagome海森堡反铁磁体的1/9磁化平台，发现具有27格胞的自旋密度波态，其变分能低于此前方案。
AI.motivation: 1/9磁化平台与由非重叠六边形局域磁振子描述、保持六重旋转对称的高磁化平台不同，其基态性质尚不明确，需要确定其磁有序与对称性破缺模式。
AI.method: 采用无限投影纠缠对态（iPEPS）进行变分计算，并用互补的团簇平均场理论（CMFT）进行验证。
AI.result: 识别出27格胞的自旋密度波态，变分能低于先前方法；该态仅保持三重旋转对称，并由三类经±2π/3旋转相关的9格点团簇铺砌而成。CMFT在高平台保持对称性，但在1/9平台自发破缺对称性，并给出质量上相似的九种局域磁化强度。
AI.conclusion: 1/9平台是仅保留三重旋转对称的自旋密度波态，与高磁化平台中保持六重对称的局域磁振子图像形成鲜明对比。

title: Symmetry-resolved quasilocal entanglement as a key to Mott and pseudogap physics in plaquette CDMFT
summary: In order to identify intrinsic quantum resources in strongly interacting fermionic systems, we introduce a symmetry resolution of the parity-superselected two-site entanglement, as measured by both the fermionic negativity and the relative entropy of entanglement. We discuss how the symmetry resolution can be extended also to the full entanglement in pure and mixed two-site states. We apply our recipe to the Hubbard model, first for a dimer, and then for a plaquette cluster dynamical mean-field theory, an established method tailored to accurately capture short-range correlations. Following the evolution of the model through the interaction- and density-driven Mott transitions at zero temperature, we highlight how the three symmetry-resolved components of the two-site entanglement probe different key aspects of Mott and pseudogap physics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出按对称性分解的宇称超选择两格点纠缠度量，用于识别强关联费米子系统中的内禀量子资源，并在Hubbard二聚体及团簇DMFT中揭示Mott与赝能隙物理。
AI.motivation: 强关联费米子系统中需要能刻画短程量子关联与内禀量子资源的诊断量，而传统两格点纠缠未区分不同对称扇区，难以对应Mott和赝能隙等物理机制。
AI.method: 引入宇称超选择两格点纠缠的对称性分解，采用费米子negativity与相对熵纠缠度量，并推广到纯态和混合态两格点态的全纠缠；将其应用于Hubbard模型二聚体及plaquette团簇动力学平均场理论，追踪零温下相互作用驱动和密度驱动的Mott转变。
AI.result: 三个对称分辨的两格点纠缠分量在Mott转变和赝能隙演化中表现出不同行为，分别探测Mott物理与赝能隙物理的不同关键方面。
AI.conclusion: 对称分辨的两格点纠缠可作为强关联费米子系统中识别短程量子资源并区分Mott与赝能隙机制的有效诊断工具。

title: Quasiparticle Interactions in the $S = 1/2$ Heisenberg Antiferromagnetic Chain CuPzN
summary: We investigate spinon--spinon interactions in the quasi-one-dimensional $S=1/2$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet Cu(C$_4$H$_4$N$_2$)(NO$_3$)$_2$ (CuPzN) using inelastic neutron scattering. At zero field, the spectrum exhibits the canonical multi-spinon continuum of the Heisenberg chain. With increasing field we demonstrate the appearance of an energy gap $2\Delta$ towards momentum $q\rightarrow 0$ between the uniform magnetization precession mode and the shifted spinon continuum. $2\Delta$ is a direct measure of spinon backscattering interactions. Comparison with numerical matrix-product-state calculations and a recent analytical theory shows excellent agreement. By examining the integrable spin-1/2 chain, we provide an example of how quasiparticle interactions can be quantified experimentally in isotropic quantum spin systems.

AI.tldr: 利用非弹性中子散射研究准一维S=1/2海森堡反铁磁体CuPzN中的自旋子-自旋子相互作用，并通过磁场诱导的能隙2Δ定量表征自旋子背散射。
AI.motivation: 各向同性量子自旋体系中准粒子相互作用通常难以直接实验量化；本文以可积S=1/2海森堡链为平台，探索自旋子相互作用的可测指纹。
AI.method: 对Cu(C4H4N2)(NO3)2进行非弹性中子散射测量，比较零场与外加磁场下的激发谱，并将结果与矩阵乘积态数值计算及近期解析理论对照。
AI.result: 零场下观察到海森堡链典型的多自旋子连续谱；随磁场增加，在q→0处出现能隙2Δ，位于均匀磁化进动模与移动后的自旋子连续谱之间，且2Δ直接量度自旋子背散射相互作用；实验与MPS计算和解析理论高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明可在可积S=1/2海森堡链中通过磁场诱导能隙实验量化自旋子间相互作用，为各向同性量子自旋体系中准粒子相互作用的定量研究提供了范例。

title: Electronic Responses in Solid Oxygen with Coexisting Structural and Magnetic Orders
summary: Solid oxygen provides a unique platform for studying the interplay between structural and magnetic degrees of freedom, as each O$_2$ molecule possesses an $S=1$ spin and weak intermolecular van der Waals interactions allow substantial structural flexibility. In addition, because of its small intermolecular hopping integrals, this system is known to be a strongly correlated electron system with a multiorbital nature. In this study, we examine electronic states and magnetic and dielectric responses using a multiorbital Hubbard model with Peierls-type electron-lattice coupling. This model provides a minimal description of the interplay between structural and magnetic degrees of freedom in solid oxygen. We apply the Hartree-Fock approximation to obtain the ground-state phase diagram. Antiferromagnetic order appears when the onsite Coulomb interaction is strong, whereas three nonmagnetic bond-ordered states emerge when it is weak. At intermediate interaction strengths, antiferromagnetic order coexists with each of the three bond orders. These three coexistence phases all break time-reversal symmetry; one preserves spatial inversion symmetry, whereas the other two also break it. The two inversion-breaking phases exhibit linear magnetoelectric responses, whereas the inversion-symmetric phase exhibits altermagnetic spin splitting and a piezomagnetic response. These responses may provide experimental signatures of coexisting magnetic and structural orders in high-pressure solid oxygen suggested by recent experiments.

AI.tldr: 该文用多轨道Hubbard模型加Peierls型电子-晶格耦合研究固态氧中结构序与磁性序的耦合，给出基态相图及磁电/压磁响应。
AI.motivation: 固态氧中每个O2分子具有S=1自旋，分子间范德华作用弱使结构灵活，且小跃迁积分导致强关联多轨道电子行为，是研究结构自由度与磁自由度相互作用的理想平台。
AI.method: 构建包含多轨道Hubbard相互作用与Peierls型电子-晶格耦合的最小模型，并在Hartree-Fock近似下求解基态相图，分析电子态、磁性及介电响应。
AI.result: 强库仑相互作用下出现反铁磁序；弱相互作用下出现三种非磁性键序态；中等相互作用下反铁磁序与三种键序分别共存。三种共存相均破坏时间反演对称性，其中一种保持空间反演对称性，另两种破坏空间反演对称性。两种破反演相具有线性磁电响应；保反演相表现出交错磁自旋劈裂和压磁响应。
AI.conclusion: 这些响应可为近期实验暗示的高压固态氧中磁性与结构序共存提供可观测特征，并表明多轨道强关联与电子-晶格耦合是理解固态氧复杂相的关键。

title: Anisotropic magneto-elastic coupling in the quasi-2D Ising magnet Li$_2$FeSiO$_4$ and thermodynamic signature of low-energy orbital excitations
summary: The relevance of spin, lattice and orbital degrees of freedom in the quasi-2D Ising-like magnet Li$_2$FeSiO$_4$ is demonstrated by thermal expansion and specific heat measurements supported by numerical studies. By means of thermodynamic and Gr\"uneisen analysis, we separate the orbital signatures and quantify the energy gap and its pressure dependence from the experimental data as $\Delta\sim 300 - 350$ K and $\partial \ln \Delta/\partial p_{\rm c} \approx -4.6$ %/GPa). Both values excellently agree with the theoretical DFT predictions. The thermal expansion anomalies associated with the onset of long-range magnetic order imply significant magneto-elastic coupling and are used to determine the anisotropic uniaxial strain dependencies of $T_{\rm N}$. They are dominated by the in-plane (i.e., $c$ axis) response $(\partial \ln{ T_{\rm N}} )/\partial p_{\rm c} \simeq 15$ %/GPa while the (negative) $a$ axis and (positive) out-of-plane ($b$ axis) pressure dependencies are much smaller. Short-range magnetic order extends well above $T_{\rm N}$ but is not driven by the same energy scale as $T_{\rm N}$ as evidenced by the observation of non-monotonic in-plane distortion, sign-change of the Gr\"uneisen parameter, and failure of Gr\"uneisen scaling.

AI.tldr: 该文通过热膨胀、比热和Grüneisen分析结合数值计算，揭示Li2FeSiO4中自旋、晶格与轨道自由度的耦合，并定量给出轨道能隙、其压力依赖及磁有序的各向异性应变响应。
AI.motivation: 准二维Ising型磁体Li2FeSiO4中自旋、晶格和轨道自由度的作用尚需厘清；作者旨在分离轨道信号、量化轨道能隙及其压力依赖，并阐明长程/短程磁有序相关的磁弹性耦合与各向异性应变效应。
AI.method: 采用热膨胀和比热测量，并结合数值研究；利用热力学与Grüneisen分析从实验数据中分离轨道特征、提取能隙及压力依赖，同时由磁有序引起的热膨胀异常确定TN的各向异性单轴应变依赖。
AI.result: 得到轨道能隙Δ≈300–350 K，∂lnΔ/∂pc≈−4.6 %/GPa，与DFT预测吻合；长程磁有序伴随显著磁弹性耦合，TN压力依赖主要由面内c轴响应主导，∂lnTN/∂pc≈15 %/GPa，而a轴负值和面外b轴正值压力依赖小得多；短程磁序延伸至TN以上，但其能量尺度不同于TN，表现为面内畸变非单调、Grüneisen参数变号及Grüneisen标度失效。
AI.conclusion: Li2FeSiO4中轨道、晶格与自旋自由度高度关联；轨道能隙及其压力依赖可由实验与理论一致确定，磁有序具有强各向异性磁弹性耦合，且短程磁序不由决定TN的同一能量尺度驱动。

title: Collinear and Coplanar Altermagnetism in a Penrose Quasicrystal
summary: We generalize the previous group-theory based classification of collinear magnetism in the quasicrystal (QC) to general magnetic states. Taking the Penrose lattice as an example, we find that all magnetic states belonging to 2D irreducible representations (IRRPs) of the $D_5$ point group, including collinear states and coplanar ones, correspond to altermagnetism (AM). Unlike conventional collinear AM wherein zero magnetism is protected by, e.g. rotation or mirror reflection, which globally flip the spin in the magnetic pattern, the zero magnetism in these 2D-IRRP states is instead protected by a special group-theory-orthogonality theorem that basis functions belonging to different IRRPs are always mutually orthogonal. Taking the single-orbital Penrose-Hubbard as an example, our linear-response theory based calculations show that the largest portion of the parameter space is occupied by these 2D-IRRP states, and our further Ginzburg-Landau theory based analysis reveals that the polarization directions of the two basis magnetic states in the 2D IRRPs can be either parallel or perpendicular, leading to collinear or coplanar magnetic states. The special group-theory-orthogonality compensation mechanism and the absence of the PT symmetry finally leads to AM states, which are to be verified by the spin split in the spin-dependent angle-resolved-photoemission-spectrum and the spin conductance. These intriguing collinear and coplanar AM can also emerge in other QCs.

AI.tldr: 本文将准晶中基于群论的对撞磁分类推广到一般磁态，并以Penrose晶格为例证明：属于D5点群二维不可约表示（2D IRRP）的共线或共面磁态均对应交错磁（altermagnetism, AM）。
AI.motivation: 传统共线AM的零净磁化通常由整体翻转自旋的旋转或镜面反射保护；本文旨在超越该框架，理解准晶中一般磁态（尤其2D IRRP态）如何实现零净磁化并产生AM。
AI.method: 以Penrose晶格为对象，采用群论分类D5点群2D IRRP磁态；以单轨道Penrose-Hubbard模型为例，结合线性响应理论计算参数空间，并用Ginzburg-Landau理论分析二维表示中两个基磁态的极化方向。
AI.result: 发现2D IRRP磁态占据最大参数空间；其零净磁化由不同IRRP基函数相互正交的群论正交性定理保护，而非传统自旋整体翻转对称性。两个基磁态极化方向可平行或垂直，分别导致共线或共面磁态；群论正交性补偿机制与PT对称性缺失共同导致AM，并 predicted 自旋分辨ARPES中的自旋劈裂及自旋电导。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了准晶中一类由二维不可约表示和群论正交性补偿机制驱动的新型共线与共面AM，突破了传统共线AM的对称性保护图像，并预期可推广到其他准晶体系。

title: Chiral Superconductivity Adjacent to a Wigner Crystal in Rhombohedral Graphene
summary: Can the correlations favoring electron crystallization also generate superconductivity in the neighboring metal? We investigate this possibility in rhombohedral tetralayer graphene with repulsive Coulomb interactions. Self-consistent Hartree--Fock calculations identify a commensurate triangular Wigner-crystal state. To investigate pairing on the metallic side, we construct a crossing-symmetric particle--hole vertex using coupled parquet and Bethe--Salpeter equations, incorporating exchange vertex corrections beyond polarization-bubble screening. Near crystallization, the enhanced electronic correlations generate an effective attraction favoring chiral $f$-wave pairing. Superconductivity is confined to a narrow metallic region adjacent to the crystal, qualitatively consistent with the superconducting sleeve observed near an insulating regime in rhombohedral graphene. These results connect the emergence of chiral pairing and its location in the phase diagram to the electronic correlations favoring crystallization.

AI.tldr: 该文研究菱面体四层石墨烯中有利于电子结晶的关联能否在邻近金属区诱导超导，并预言结晶相邻的窄金属区出现手性 f 波配对。
AI.motivation: 探索电子晶体化相关关联是否也能驱动邻近金属态中的超导，以解释菱面体石墨烯中绝缘区附近观察到的超导“套筒”。
AI.method: 对具有排斥库仑相互作用的菱面体四层石墨烯进行自洽 Hartree–Fock 计算，识别出公度三角 Wigner 晶体；在金属侧构建满足交叉对称性的粒子–空穴顶点，结合 parquet 与 Bethe–Salpeter 方程，并纳入超出极化气泡屏蔽的交换顶点修正。
AI.result: 在结晶附近，增强的电子关联产生有效吸引，倾向于手性 f 波配对；超导仅局限于紧邻晶体的窄金属区，与菱面体石墨烯绝缘区附近超导套筒的定性特征一致。
AI.conclusion: 手性配对的出现及其相图位置可由有利于电子结晶的电子关联所连接和解释。

title: Nodeless d-wave pairing in monolayer FeSe revealed by intra-unit-cell Josephson interferometry
summary: The Josephson effect provides a direct phase-sensitive probe of superconducting order and has played a central role in identifying unconventional pairing symmetries1-6. Conventional Josephson interferometry, however, extracts phase information through engineered junction geometries and crystallographic orientations, rather than by resolving the internal phase structure of the pair state within a single unit cell. Here, we use a superconducting Nb tip to realize atomic-scale Josephson interferometry in monolayer FeSe/SrTiO3. Despite a fully gapped quasiparticle spectrum, the local Josephson response exhibits a striking intra-unit-cell pattern, with maxima centred on Fe-Fe bonds and robust nodal lines along the Fe-Se directions. We show that these nodal lines arise from destructive interference between Josephson tunnelling amplitudes associated with opposite-sign pairing components. Microscopic calculations reproduce the observed spatial pattern and identify it as a fingerprint of nodeless d-wave pairing. Our results establish intra-unit-cell Josephson interferometry as a local phase-sensitive probe of pairing symmetry in unconventional superconductors.

AI.tldr: 利用超导Nb针尖在单层FeSe/SrTiO3上实现原子尺度Josephson干涉测量，发现尽管准粒子谱完全有能隙，局域Josephson响应在单胞内呈现显著空间图案，并指认为无节点d波配对指纹。
AI.motivation: 传统Josephson干涉测量依赖人工结几何和晶向提取相位信息，无法在单个晶胞内分辨配对态的内部相位结构；本文旨在实现原子尺度的局域相位敏感探测以识别非常规超导配对对称性。
AI.method: 使用超导Nb针尖在单层FeSe/SrTiO3表面进行原子尺度Josephson干涉测量，获取局域Josephson响应的单胞内空间分布，并结合微观计算模拟该图案及其与配对分量相位的关系。
AI.result: 样品具有完全有能隙的准粒子谱，但局域Josephson响应呈明显单胞内图案：极大值位于Fe-Fe键中心，沿Fe-Se方向出现稳健节点线；计算表明节点线源于相反符号配对分量对应的Josephson隧穿振幅之间的相消干涉，该空间图案被识别为无节点d波配对的指纹。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了单胞内Josephson干涉测量作为非常规超导体配对对称性的局域相位敏感探针。

title: The fate of $s_{\pm}$ superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
summary: Motivated by the recent measurement of high-temperature superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate system La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ in the bulk as well as thin film samples, we seek to understand the role of the interlayer coupling in this system in dictating the pairing symmetry. Many proposals posit the existence of an $s_\pm$ superconducting phase in close competition with the mroe conventional cuprate-like $d$-wave state in both weak- and strong-coupling theories. However, at least in the latter, the effects of Coulomb repulsion and the double occupancy constraint have been largely neglected. In this manuscript, we propose a mean-field fractionalization treatment that captures the full $SU(2)$ particle-hole symmetry of the t-J model at half-filling, and show how a systematic treatment of this new symmetry leads to an added Coulomb pseudopotential constraint - one that is absent in the usual $U(1)$ treatment. We then apply this new fractionalization scheme to a simplified bilayer t-J model of La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$, showing how the Coulomb pseudopotential suppresses the existence of $s_\pm$ symmetry in favor of $d$-wave pairing.

AI.tldr: 通过保持半满t-J模型完整SU(2)粒子-空穴对称的平均场分数化处理，作者发现额外的库仑赝势约束会抑制双层镍酸盐La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$中的$s_\pm$配对，转而 favoring $d$-波配对。
AI.motivation: 近期在块体和薄膜La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$中观测到高温超导，亟需理解层间耦合如何决定配对对称性；现有弱/强耦合理论多讨论$s_\pm$与铜氧化物类$d$-波的竞争，但强耦合理论常忽略库仑排斥和双占位约束。
AI.method: 提出一种平均场分数化方案，完整保留半满t-J模型的$SU(2)$粒子-空穴对称性，并系统推导出比常规$U(1)$处理多出的库仑赝势约束；随后将其应用于La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$的简化双层t-J模型。
AI.result: 新引入的库仑赝势约束会压制$s_\pm$超导态，使$d$-波配对在简化双层t-J模型中成为更有利的对称性。
AI.conclusion: 强关联效应、双占位约束及$SU(2)$粒子-空穴对称性对La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$配对对称性至关重要；该分数化框架表明库仑赝势可使$d$-波优于$s_\pm$。

title: Scattering and Schmid-Bulgadaev Transition in Qubits Based on Josephson Junction Chains
summary: A Josephson junction subject to an ohmic dissipative environment undergoes a zero-temperature quantum phase transition called Schmid-Bulgadaev transition form an insulating state to a superconducting state upon increasing the impedance of the environment above the resistance quantum. Superconducting qubits based on Josephson junction chains represent a system where it is possible to dynamically explore both sides of this transition by probing the scattering of individual plasma modes of the junction chain on a SQUID at the boundary which was achieved in recent experiments. Here, we provide a theoretical analysis of the scattering in the system paying special attention to the non-perturbative superconducting regime. We find that in this regime, a specific diagrammatic resummation must be performed in order to correctly account for fluctuation renormalization of the SQUID's potential. We find analytic expressions for the modes' frequency shifts and quality factors which together provide a full description of scattering. We argue that the non-perturbative nature of the superconducting phase manifests itself through a power-law dependence of the frequency shifts on the SQUID flux and through non-monotonous dependence of the quality factors on the mode frequency. Our predictions may be readily verified in modern low-temperature experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文理论分析了约瑟夫森结链中单个等离子体模式在边界SQUID上的散射，重点研究非微扰超导区，并通过图解重求和获得模式频移与品质因数的解析表达式。
AI.motivation: 约瑟夫森结链量子比特可动态探索Schmid-Bulgadaev量子相变两侧，但非微扰超导区中模式散射的理论描述尚不完整，需要正确计入涨落对SQUID势的重整化。
AI.method: 对欧姆耗散环境下的约瑟夫森结链-SQUID边界散射进行理论分析；在超导非微扰区执行特定图解重求和，以计入SQUID势的涨落重整化，并解析求解等离子体模式的频移和品质因数。
AI.result: 得到可完整描述散射的频移与品质因数解析式；发现超导相的非微扰性质表现为频移对SQUID磁通的幂律依赖，以及品质因数随模式频率的非单调依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了此类边界散射的完整理论描述，其预测可在现代低温实验中被直接验证。

title: Tilt-Controlled Multi-Gap Superconductivity in Type-II Weyl Semimetals
summary: In type-II Weyl semimetals, strongly tilted Weyl cones produce coexisting electron and hole pockets, a natural multi-band setting for superconductivity, yet how the tilt controls the number and relative size of the superconducting gaps remains unclear. Here we classify the symmetry-allowed on-site pairing channels of a simple time-reversal symmetric tilted Weyl-semimetal model with $D_4$ symmetry and identify the fully symmetric $A_1$ channel as the leading instability for attractive on-site interactions, supporting a fully gapped two-gap state. The tilt acts as a microscopic control parameter, redistributing the band-resolved pairing susceptibility between the two Fermi-surface sectors rather than simply rescaling the total density of states. Once the tilt sufficiently enhances the secondary channel, a robust secondary gap develops and can exceed the primary gap even at weaker effective coupling, while inter-gap coupling locks both gaps to a common critical superconducting temperature. The Weyl cone tilt thus controls the emergence and hierarchy of multi-gap superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 该文研究了D4对称的倾斜Weyl半金属模型中，Weyl锥倾斜如何调控多带超导的配对通道、能隙数量及能隙层级。
AI.motivation: 第二类Weyl半金属中强倾斜Weyl锥导致电子与空穴口袋共存，为多带超导提供自然平台，但倾斜如何控制超导能隙数目及相对大小尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对时间反演对称且具有D4对称性的简化倾斜Weyl半金属模型分类对称允许的格点配对通道，并分析吸引型格点相互作用下的配对不稳定性与带分辨配对磁化率。
AI.result: 全对称A1通道为领先不稳定性，支持全开隙的双能隙态；倾斜作为微观控制参数在两个费米面扇区之间重新分配带分辨配对磁化率，而非简单缩放总态密度；当倾斜足够增强次级通道时，稳健次级能隙出现，甚至可在较弱有效耦合下超过主能隙，且能隙间耦合使两个能隙锁定到共同临界超导温度。
AI.conclusion: Weyl锥倾斜控制多能隙超导的出现与能隙层级，是调控第二类Weyl半金属超导配对结构的关键参数。

title: Universal Scaling of the Little-Parks Oscillation Amplitude
summary: The Little-Parks effect played a pivotal role in establishing fluxoid quantization in doubly connected superconductors and providing early evidence for electron pairing, central to BCS theory. More recently, it has emerged as an important phase-sensitive probe of superconducting order. Yet the amplitude of the Little-Parks oscillation has never been fully understood theoretically, as the conventional mean-field Ginzburg-Landau description does not account for its pronounced temperature dependence. Here, we develop a universal theoretical framework incorporating thermal fluctuations in reduced-dimensional superconducting rings. By analyzing Little-Parks measurements across multiple superconductors, we show that the resulting scaling quantitatively captures the temperature-dependent oscillation amplitudes over a broad range of materials and device geometries, resolving the long-standing discrepancy between theory and experiment.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个包含热涨落的普适理论框架，解释超导环 Little-Parks 振荡幅度随温度变化的长期理论与实验差异。
AI.motivation: Little-Parks 效应对通量量子化和电子配对验证至关重要，并已成为相敏感探针，但其振荡幅度的显著温度依赖性无法由传统平均场 Ginzburg-Landau 理论解释。
AI.method: 在低维超导环中引入热涨落，建立普适理论框架，并分析多种超导体的 Little-Parks 测量数据，提取振荡幅度的标度行为。
AI.result: 所得标度关系在广泛材料和器件几何范围内定量描述温度依赖的 Little-Parks 振荡幅度，消除理论与实验之间的长期不一致。
AI.conclusion: 热涨落是理解低维超导环 Little-Parks 振荡幅度的关键，该框架为相敏感超导测量提供统一解释。

title: Magnetic susceptibility and superfluid density of inhomogeneous superconducting films: the Tc-mosaic model
summary:
Whole-sample and mutual-inductance part-sample measurements of the linear magnetic susceptibility, $\chi$, of superconducting films are routinely used to obtain the London penetration depth, $\lambda(T)$, assuming uniform superconductivity. However, spatially resolved probes show that many films of current interest are inhomogeneous on micrometer scales. Here we ask whether a distribution of local transition temperatures in a fully gapped film can produce an apparent line-nodal, $T$-linear $\lambda(T)$. The film is modeled as a random Voronoi mosaic of domains with $T_c$ distributed between $T_{c,\min}$ and $T_{c,\max}$ with s-wave (also d-wave, for comparison) London response inside each domain. We show that detectable screening appears only below the percolation temperature, $T_p$, and the transition broadens with the spread of $T_c$. For s-wave domains, $\lambda(T)$ remains activated for any $T_{c,\min}>0$. Only for $T_{c,\min}=0$ does it become a power law, $\Delta\lambda\propto T^n$ with $n\approx1.7$, but then the onset of screening drops to $T_p=T_{c,\max}/2$. Weighting the $T_{c}$ distribution towards $T_c\to0$ (more low-$T_{c}$ domains) can bring $n$ closer to 1 ($n\approx1.2$), but simultaneously pushes the apparent transition, $T_p$, more than an order of magnitude below $T_{c,\max}$. For d-wave domains, the linear term survives, and its relative slope is enhanced almost fourfold for $T_{c,\min}=0$.
  Hence, a $T$-linear $\lambda(T)$ measured in a film with screening onset within a factor of a few of $T_{c,\max}$ by whole-sample or mutual-inductance part-sample measurements cannot originate from $T_c$ mosaicity in a fully gapped superconductor.

AI.tldr: 该文检验全能隙超导薄膜中的局域Tc分布能否伪装出线节点式T线性λ(T)，结论是在筛选起始温度接近Tc,max时不能。
AI.motivation: 整样品与互感部分样品磁化率测量常假设超导均匀以提取London穿透深度λ(T)，但许多薄膜在微米尺度不均匀；作者追问局域Tc分布是否会导致表观T线性λ(T)。
AI.method: 将薄膜建模为随机Voronoi镶嵌畴，各畴Tc在Tc,min与Tc,max间分布，畴内采用s波（并与d波对比）London响应，计算线性磁化率及筛选行为。
AI.result: 可探测筛选仅在渗流温度Tp以下出现且转变随Tc展宽；s波畴在Tc,min>0时λ(T)保持激活型，仅Tc,min=0时呈Δλ∝T^n（n≈1.7）且Tp=Tc,max/2；向低Tc加权可使n≈1.2但Tp远低于Tc,max；d波线性项保留，Tc,min=0时相对斜率增强近四倍。
AI.conclusion: 若整样品或互感部分样品测量中筛选起始温度在Tc,max数倍以内，则所测T线性λ(T)不能源于全能隙超导体中的Tc马赛克分布。

title: Momentum-resolved thermodynamics and barrier-free order-parameter collapse in spin-orbit-coupled superconductors under a Zeeman field
summary: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can enhance the critical Zeeman field of clean superconductors beyond the Pauli limit. We develop a momentum decomposition of the zero-temperature free energy to investigate spin-singlet $s$-wave superconductors with general time-reversal-symmetric SOC. The SOC component perpendicular to the Zeeman field enhances the critical field and suppresses first-order features, whereas the parallel component favors Pauli-limited thermodynamic behavior. Applying this framework to Rashba superconductors and Ising superconductors with weak Rashba SOC, we identify the origin of the abrupt collapse of the superconducting order parameter at the critical field. Competing angular contributions produce a nearly flat free-energy landscape, allowing a barrier-free order-parameter collapse distinct from the conventional Pauli-limited first-order transition.

AI.tldr: 通过零温自由能的动量分解，揭示SOC分量方向如何调控自旋单态s波超导体的Pauli极限及临界场处序参量突变机制。
AI.motivation: SOC可使洁净超导体临界Zeeman场超过Pauli极限，但不同SOC分量及Rashba/Ising体系中临界场处序参量突然塌缩的物理起源尚不清晰。
AI.method: 对具有一般时间反演对称SOC的自旋单态s波超导体，构建零温自由能的动量分解，并应用于Rashba超导体及弱Rashba SOC的Ising超导体。
AI.result: 垂直Zeeman场的SOC分量提高临界场并抑制一阶特征，平行分量倾向Pauli极限热力学行为；竞争的角度贡献使自由能景观近乎平坦，导致无势垒的序参量塌缩。
AI.conclusion: 该工作区分了SOC分量作用，并给出与常规Pauli极限一阶转变不同的无势垒序参量塌缩机制。

title: Local Broadband Gigahertz Spectroscopy via SQUID-on-Tip DC Readout
summary: Superconducting microwave circuits are shaped by their local electromagnetic environment, yet standard microwave measurements do not resolve the local fields and device features that govern their behavior. Here, we combine microwave spectroscopy, nanoscale magnetic sensing, and topographic imaging in a single tapping-mode SQUID-on-tip microscope. The nonlinear Josephson response converts local GHz excitations into Shapiro steps, enabling quantitative measurements of microwave frequency signals and their excitation strength using only DC readout. Applied to a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator, local spectroscopy reproduces the power-dependent resonance and nonlinear bifurcation observed in microwave transmission measurements. Spatially resolved measurements map the microwave response while simultaneously recording topography and static magnetic features, including vortices and Meissner screening currents. Electromagnetic simulations reveal how coupling through the superconducting probe leads limits spatial resolution and guides localized detector designs. Together, these capabilities establish a platform for correlating microwave circuit dynamics with the local structural and magnetic environment of superconducting devices.

AI.tldr: 该工作将微波谱、纳米磁传感与形貌成像集成于轻敲模式SQUID-on-tip显微镜，实现超导微波电路局域电磁环境与器件动力学的空间分辨关联测量。
AI.motivation: 标准微波测量无法分辨决定超导微波电路行为的局域场和器件特征，因此需要一种能在纳米尺度同时探测微波响应、形貌和静态磁性的手段。
AI.method: 作者构建了集成微波谱、纳米磁传感和形貌成像的轻敲模式SQUID-on-tip显微镜；利用非线性Josephson响应将局域GHz激发转换为Shapiro台阶，从而仅用直流读出定量测量微波频率信号及其激发强度，并结合电磁仿真分析探针耦合对空间分辨率的影响。
AI.result: 在超导共面波导谐振器上，局域谱复现了微波传输测量中的功率依赖 Resonance 与非线性分岔；空间分辨测量在记录形貌和静态磁特征（包括涡旋与Meissner屏蔽电流）的同时映射微波响应；仿真表明超导探针耦合限制空间分辨率，并为局域探测器设计提供指导。
AI.conclusion: 该平台建立了将微波电路动力学与超导器件局域结构和磁环境相关联的方法，为研究超导微波电路的局域电磁行为提供了新工具。

title: Cavity Loss in QED Coupled-Cluster Theory: Polariton Linewidths, Driven Steady States, and the Rabi Splitting
summary: Molecular polariton experiments are performed in lossy cavities, whereas correlated ab initio polariton theory has been developed almost entirely for lossless cavities. In this work, cavity loss is added to real-time QED coupled-cluster theory (QED-CCSD-22) through a complex cavity frequency, which gives the non-Hermitian no-jump part of the Lindblad master equation. The resulting polariton linewidths and driven-dissipative steady states are, to our knowledge, the first from QED coupled-cluster theory. The linewidths obtained from the complex Jacobian and from real-time propagation agree and are partitioned by the biorthogonal photon numbers of the two polaritons. A closed-form continuous-wave drive of the cavity gives driven steady states and their lineshapes.

AI.tldr: 该工作将腔损耗引入实时QED耦合簇理论，首次从QED-CCSD-22获得分子极化激元的线宽及驱动耗散稳态。
AI.motivation: 分子极化激元实验通常在有损耗腔中进行，而相关从头算极化激元理论多针对无损耗腔，缺乏对腔损耗的严格处理。
AI.method: 通过复数腔频率将腔损耗加入实时QED耦合簇理论QED-CCSD-22，得到Lindblad主方程的非厄米无跳跃部分；并采用复Jacobian、实时传播以及闭式连续波驱动求解。
AI.result: 由复Jacobian和实时传播得到的极化激元线宽一致，并可按两个极化激元的双正交光子数进行分配；闭式连续波驱动给出了驱动稳态及其线型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为QED耦合簇理论提供了处理腔损耗的途径，并首次给出基于QED-CCSD-22的极化激元线宽和驱动耗散稳态。

title: Relativistic Cavity Quantum Electrodynamical Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Method for Strong Light-Matter Coupling
summary: We present the relativistic four-component implementation of cavity quantum electrodynamical algebraic diagrammatic construction theory at second order (4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)) for the ab initio treatment of light-matter interactions. Starting from the unitary-transformed, origin-invariant Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian, a rigorous four-component Dirac-Hartree-Fock formulation including cavity effects is considered, forming the basis of the 4c-QED-EE-ADC(2) framework. Two variants are implemented, allowing cavity effects to be introduced either at the relativistic mean-field or exclusively at the electron-correlation level. Applications to Hg, AuH, and halogen hydrides demonstrate that cavity coupling significantly modifies relativistic excitation spectra, induces strong state mixing, and enables tunable polaritonic features. Potential energy surface calculations for HBr further reveal cavity-induced qualitative changes in excited-state surfaces. It is also observed that the inclusion of photonic degrees of freedom leads to a moderate computational overhead of approximately three to five times relative to standard 4c-EE-ADC(2).

AI.tldr: 该文提出并实现了二阶腔量子电动力学代数图解构造理论的相对论四分量版本（4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)），用于从头算处理光-物质相互作用。
AI.motivation: 需要在相对论框架下同时描述强自旋-轨道效应与腔场耦合，以准确处理重元素体系的光谱和激发态性质。
AI.method: 从幺正变换且原点不变的Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量出发，构建包含腔效应的四分量Dirac-Hartree-Fock参考态，并实现两种4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)变体：腔效应引入于相对论平均场层面或仅引入于电子相关层面。
AI.result: 对Hg、AuH和卤化氢的应用表明，腔耦合显著改变相对论激发谱、诱导强态混合并产生可调极化激元特征；HBr势能面计算显示腔场可导致激发态势能面的定性变化；引入光子自由度仅带来约3至5倍于标准4c-EE-ADC(2)的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 4c-QED-EE-ADC(2)为相对论多电子体系中的腔QED效应提供了可行且可扩展的从头算方法，并能捕捉腔诱导的光谱与激发态势能面变化。

title: Second order N-Electron Valence state Perturbation Theory for polaritonic systems
summary: Molecules strongly coupled to optical cavities often show multi-configurational character, which the cavity can enhance by mixing electronic states. Describing them accurately requires a complete treatment of correlation between all the involved quantum particles. The available QED ab-initio methods do not treat it in its completeness except for QED-FCI. We extend second-order N-electron valence state perturbation theory (NEVPT2) to polaritonic chemistry, in its state-specific (QED-NEVPT2) and quasi degenerate (QED-QD-NEVPT2) forms. Here, the correlation due to the interaction of more degenerate configurations comes from a QED-CASSCF reference, while that associated with instantaneous interactions between the particles is added by second-order perturbation theory. Application of the methods to ammonia, ethylene and formaldimine revealed that this approach represents the perfect alternative to the well established QED-Coupled Cluster approach when the molecular system is described by more degenerate configurations. The approaches developed in this work have the potential to become state-of-the-art methodologies for the description of reactivity and photochemistry in polaritonic systems.

AI.tldr: 该工作将NEVPT2扩展至极化激元化学，提出QED-NEVPT2与QED-QD-NEVPT2方法，用于强耦合光腔中多组态分子的相关能计算。
AI.motivation: 分子与光腔强耦合时具有显著多组态特征，腔场还可混合电子态；准确描述需完整处理所有量子粒子间相关。现有QED从头算方法除QED-FCI外难以完整处理，因此需要可兼顾多组态与QED相关的高效方法。
AI.method: 以QED-CASSCF为参考态处理更多简并构型间相互作用带来的相关，并通过二阶微扰理论加入粒子间瞬时相互作用相关；分别构建态特定QED-NEVPT2和准简并QED-QD-NEVPT2。
AI.result: 在氨、乙烯和甲酰亚胺上的应用表明，当分子体系由更多简并构型描述时，该方法可作为成熟QED-耦合簇方法的有力替代。
AI.conclusion: 所发展的QED-NEVPT2系列方法有望成为极化激元体系中反应性和光化学描述的最先进方法之一。

title: Preparing State-Selected Molecular Beams with high Efficiency using Quantum Cascade Lasers
summary: We demonstrate the ro-vibrational state-selective preparation of CO molecules ($v$ = 0, J = 0 $\rightarrow$ $v$ = 1, J = 1) in an internally cold molecular beam using a continuous-wave, narrow-linewidth distributed feedback type quantum cascade laser, with an output wavelength of 4.65 $\mu$m. Using a modulation-free wavelength stabilization scheme, we show that population transfer to near saturation levels can be obtained with sufficient long term stability, as needed for state-resolved scattering experiments. We show preliminary results of CO molecules prepared in the $v$ = 1 state, scattering from a clean Cu(100) surface. This study showcases the promise of QCL based excitation for state-selected molecular beam based scattering experiments, especially involving transitions in the mid-infrared domain ($\lambda$ > 4.5 $\mu$m) which are otherwise difficult to access using conventional sources.

AI.tldr: 利用4.65 μm连续波窄线宽DFB量子级联激光器，在内部冷却的CO分子束中实现从(v=0,J=0)到(v=1,J=1)的振转态选择性制备，并初步用于CO(v=1)与Cu(100)表面的散射研究。
AI.motivation: 态分辨分子束散射实验需要高选择性、高稳定性且接近饱和的振转态布居制备，尤其是传统光源难以覆盖的λ>4.5 μm中红外跃迁。
AI.method: 采用输出波长4.65 μm的连续波窄线宽分布反馈型量子级联激光器，并结合无调制波长稳定方案，对内部冷却CO分子束进行振转激发，将分子从(v=0,J=0)制备到(v=1,J=1)。
AI.result: 实现了接近饱和水平的布居转移，并具备满足态分辨散射实验所需的长期稳定性；给出了制备在v=1态的CO分子与洁净Cu(100)表面散射的初步结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了QCL基激发在态选择分子束散射实验中的潜力，特别适用于传统光源难以覆盖的λ>4.5 μm中红外跃迁。

title: State-specific perturbation theory for configuration interaction singles: Theoretical analysis, benchmarks, and improvement with size-intensive level shifts
summary: We recently proposed a state-specific second-order perturbation theory based on the configuration interaction singles (CIS) state, termed CIS(2). Here, we clarify its theoretical connections, assess the accuracy of its excitation energies in greater detail, and develop size-intensive level shifts to improve both accuracy and convergence of its amplitude equations. We first derive the MP2 structure of its working equations and show that our previously introduced Hybrid partition recovers CIS(D) when the ground-state Fock operator is used and the residual Fock action on the CIS reference is neglected. For this partition, an expanded benchmark shows that using the CIS-state Fock operator improves Rydberg and especially charge-transfer accuracy relative to CIS(D), while slightly worsening valence accuracy. We analyze how the hole and particle densities contribute to these changes in excitation energy, which differ among the classes. We then introduce size-intensive level shifts that preserve the ground-state correlation contribution of noninteracting fragments while leaving the ground-state MP2 energy unchanged. With appropriately calibrated parameters, these shifts improve overall accuracy and substantially accelerate convergence without increasing the formal scaling of the amplitude solve. Different optimal parameters for valence and Rydberg states reveal the limitations of a common parameter. The analysis further shows that shifting the contracted-triples block contributes markedly to the excitation-energy correction in addition to accelerating convergence.

AI.tldr: 该文澄清CIS(2)微扰理论的理论联系，系统评估其激发能精度，并引入尺寸密集型能级移动以提升精度和振幅方程收敛性。
AI.motivation: CIS(2)此前已提出，但其与CIS(D)等方法的理论关系、激发能精度及收敛性仍需明确和改善。
AI.method: 推导CIS(2)工作方程的MP2结构，证明Hybrid划分在采用基态Fock算符且忽略CIS参考态残余Fock作用时退化为CIS(D)；开展扩展基准测试并分析空穴/粒子密度对激发能变化的贡献；引入保持非相互作用碎片基态相关贡献且不改变基态MP2能量的尺寸密集型能级移动。
AI.result: 采用CIS态Fock算符的Hybrid划分相对CIS(D)改善Rydberg和尤其电荷转移精度，但价态精度略差；校准后的能级移动提高总体精度并显著加速收敛且不增加振幅求解的形式标度；价态与Rydberg态最优参数不同，表明统一参数的局限；移动收缩三体块除加速收敛外也显著贡献激发能校正。
AI.conclusion: CIS(2)与CIS(D)存在明确理论联系，CIS态Fock算符和尺寸密集型能级移动可提升特定激发类型精度与收敛性，但价态与Rydberg态需分别参数化，收缩三体块移动对激发能校正具有重要作用。

title: A Density-Matrix Formulation of Vibrational Circular Dichroism Spectra for M{\o}ller-Plesset and Configuration Interaction Methods
summary: We reformulate the overlap of wave-function derivatives that defines the atomic axial tensors (AATs) and velocity-gauge atomic polar tensors (VG-APTs) used to compute vibrational circular dichroism (VCD) rotatory strengths. In place of our earlier determinant-level derivatives, the new approach expresses these tensors as contractions involving molecular-orbital derivative integrals, perturbed and unperturbed one- and two-electron density matrices, and dot products of the perturbed correlated wave-function amplitudes. Following the elegant treatment of the diagonal Born-Oppenheimer correction by Gauss and co-workers, the formulation holds for any real, normalized CI-like wave function. The two-electron density contribution vanishes exactly, because one perturbation is real (nuclear) and the other imaginary (magnetic field or momentum); this removes multiple terms from our earlier AAT and VG-APT expressions for second-order M\o{}ller-Plesset perturbation theory (MP2) and configuration interaction singles and doubles (CISD). We also present a simplified form of the origin-independent length-gauge [LG(OI)] rotatory strength that avoids the singular-value decomposition of the outer product of the length-gauge APT and VG-APT vectors for each mode, and that clarifies how the LG(OI) and velocity-gauge rotatory strengths are related. Applying the density-based AATs and VG-APTs to ($P$)-hydrogen peroxide, (\textit{S})-methyloxirane, and (\textit{S})-3-chloro-1-butyne, we find that discrepancies among the gauges arise chiefly from basis-set incompleteness in the VG-APT. The charge-sum rule serves as a useful measure of that incompleteness, independent of the correlation method.

AI.tldr: 该文将用于VCD旋光强度的原子轴向张量（AAT）和速度规范原子极化张量（VG-APT）重构为基于分子轨道导数积分、扰动/未扰动一电子与二电子密度矩阵以及扰动相关波函数振幅点积的收缩表达式，并给出简化的LG(OI)旋光强度公式。
AI.motivation: 此前的行列式级导数表达式较复杂，且在MP2和CISD中包含可由对称性消除的多余项；需要建立适用于任意实、归一化CI类波函数的统一密度型表述，并厘清不同规范下VCD旋光强度的关系及基组不完备性诊断。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵与MO导数积分重写AAT和VG-APT；利用一个扰动为实（核位移）、另一个为虚（磁场或动量）的性质证明二电子密度贡献严格为零；推导避免对LG-APT与VG-APT外积逐模做奇异值分解的LG(OI)简化形式；并将其应用于(P)-过氧化氢、(S)-甲基环氧乙烷和(S)-3-氯-1-丁炔。
AI.result: 二电子密度项严格消失，从而删去早期MP2/CISD的AAT和VG-APT表达式中的多项；简化LG(OI)旋光强度并明确其与速度规范旋光强度的关系；计算表明不同规范间差异主要来自VG-APT的基组不完备，电荷和规则可作为独立于相关方法的不完备性度量。
AI.conclusion: 密度型AAT/VG-APT表述更通用且更简洁，适用于任意实归一化CI类波函数，为VCD规范依赖问题、相关方法扩展及基组完备性诊断提供了实用框架。

title: Lanthanide Crystal Field Theory in the J-Mixing Regime: $f^n$ Configurations
summary: The low-energy sector of the lanthanide $f^n$ shell is to first approximation governed by the interplay of three interactions: Coulomb repulsion, spin-same-orbit coupling and the ligand crystal field potential. To rationalize the energy landscape in different chemical environments, it is desirable to extract the phenomenological crystal field parameters from experimental data; however, in practice, high-dimensional fitting procedures complicate their routine determination. Here, we present a computational extraction procedure based on real tensorial sets and the $U(7)$ canonical chain that, unlike existing operator equivalent methods, takes all $J$ multiplets of the lowest-energy $LS$ term into account, ensuring meaningful results even in the presence of considerable $J$-mixing. Two series of lanthanide compounds, [Ln(III)(C$_8$H$_8$)$_2$]$^-$} and doped Ln(III):Y$_2$O$_3$} (Ln $\in$ {Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu}) serve as examples for high- ($D_{8h}$) and low-symmetry ($C_2$) scenarios. Consequences for the generalisation toward actinides are briefly discussed.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于实张量集与U(7)规范链的晶体场参数计算提取方法，可纳入最低能LS项的全部J多重态，从而在显著J混合下仍给出有意义的拟合结果，并在高对称D8h和低对称C2的镧系化合物中验证。
AI.motivation: 镧系f^n壳层低能结构主要由库仑排斥、自旋-同轨道耦合与配体晶体场势共同决定；从实验数据中提取唯象晶体场参数对理解不同化学环境中的能量景观很重要，但高维拟合使常规确定变得困难。
AI.method: 构建基于实张量集和U(7)规范链的计算提取流程；与现有算符等效方法不同，该方法考虑最低能LS项的所有J多重态，而非仅处理单一J或忽略J混合。
AI.result: 方法在两类镧系体系中进行示例应用：高对称D8h的[Ln(III)(C8H8)2]^-和低对称C2的掺杂Ln(III):Y2O3（Ln=Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu），表明其适用于不同对称性场景，并在存在明显J混合时仍能给出有意义的晶体场参数提取结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了更稳健的镧系晶体场参数提取方案，克服了高维拟合和J混合带来的常规困难，并简要讨论了向锕系体系推广的前景。

title: An Ab Initio Quantum-Chemistry-Based Three-Temperature Approach for Non-Equilibrium Hypersonic Flows: Application to Homogeneous 0-D Chemical Systems
summary: This work presents an ab initio quantum-chemistry-based one-bin, three-temperature (1-bin 3T) model for non-equilibrium thermochemistry of homogeneous chemical systems in their electronic ground state, derived using the multi-group maximum-entropy principle. The proposed framework captures both vibrational and rotational non-equilibrium effects, thereby enabling an accurate representation of thermochemical behavior in high-temperature gases. To account for departures from equilibrium dissociation, a non-equilibrium correction factor derived from ro-vibrational State-to-State (StS) analysis is incorporated into the population distribution. Because this correction is constructed from the quasi-steady-state (QSS) distribution, the resulting model is valid only for systems and conditions under which the QSS assumption holds. The proposed 1-bin 3T model is validated across a broad range of zero-dimensional test cases through comparisons with high-fidelity StS simulations and Direct Molecular Simulations (DMS). The results demonstrate excellent agreement between the reduced-order model and high-fidelity approaches for both dissociating and recombining environments. Overall, the 1-bin 3T model shows strong potential as an efficient and accurate framework for modeling non-equilibrium thermochemical behavior, while keeping computational costs orders of magnitude lower than the high fidelity ro-vibrational StS simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于从头算量子化学与多群最大熵原理的1-bin 3T模型，用于电子基态均相化学体系的非平衡热化学建模，并通过ro-vibrational StS与DMS验证其精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 高温气体中存在振动、转动及离解非平衡效应，高保真ro-vibrational State-to-State模拟计算成本过高，需要兼顾精度与效率的降阶热化学模型。
AI.method: 采用多群最大熵原理推导1-bin 3T模型，同时描述振动与转动非平衡；引入基于ro-vibrational StS分析、并由准稳态QSS分布构造的非平衡离解修正因子，将其纳入粒子数分布。
AI.result: 在广泛零维测试案例中，与高保真StS模拟和直接分子模拟DMS对比，模型在离解与复合环境下均表现出优异一致性，且计算成本比ro-vibrational StS低若干数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该1-bin 3T模型可作为高效、准确的非平衡热化学建模框架，但其有效性受QSS假设适用条件限制。

title: An Efficient Quantum Spectral-Galerkin Method for Linear Elliptic Equations
summary: This paper presents an efficient quantum spectral-Galerkin method for constant-coefficient second-order linear elliptic equations. The method employs a boundary-adapted Jacobi tensor-product basis that incorporates the boundary condition into the approximation space and produces Galerkin systems with polynomially bounded condition numbers and sparsity. For analytic solutions satisfying a suitable uniform regularity condition, spectral convergence allows the normalized Galerkin coefficient state to be prepared with complexity $\mathrm{poly}(d,\log(1/\epsilon))$, where $d$ is the spatial dimension and $\epsilon$ is the error tolerance, under standard sparse-access and state-preparation assumptions. At the state-preparation level, this improves the precision dependence over fixed-order finite-difference and finite-element discretizations. We further show how to estimate prescribed linear functionals of the solution, with an additional $O(1/\epsilon)$ factor arising from norm and inner-product estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效量子谱-Galerkin方法，用于常系数二阶线性椭圆方程；在解析解与标准稀疏访问/态制备假设下，以 poly(d, log(1/ε)) 复杂度制备归一化Galerkin系数态，并估计线性泛函。
AI.motivation: 固定阶有限差分和有限元离散在量子态制备精度依赖上受限，需利用谱方法的高阶收敛性改善对误差容限 ε 的复杂度依赖。
AI.method: 采用融入边界条件的边界自适应Jacobi张量积基，使Galerkin系统具有多项式有界条件数与稀疏性；对满足一致正则性条件的解析解利用谱收敛制备归一化Galerkin系数态，并基于范数与内积估计计算指定线性泛函。
AI.result: 在标准稀疏访问与态制备假设下，归一化Galerkin系数态的制备复杂度为 poly(d, log(1/ε))；相比固定阶有限差分/有限元，在态制备层面改善了精度依赖；估计指定线性泛函额外引入 O(1/ε) 因子。
AI.conclusion: 谱-Galerkin离散可显著降低量子求解该类椭圆方程态制备对精度的依赖，并为解的低维线性泛函估计提供可行路径，但泛函估计仍受 O(1/ε) 额外开销限制。

title: A neural accelerated surface-roughness-based Discrete Element Method (SR-DEM) for modeling granular systems
summary: The Discrete Element Method (DEM) is an indispensable tool for modeling and understanding the basic mechanical behaviors of (dry) granular media, a class of disordered material systems of significant interest to multiple scientific domains from (geo-)physics to (chemical) engineering. At the core of all present DEM frameworks is a phenomenological friction law--commonly chosen to be of the Amontons-Coulomb type--that models the frictional interaction among constituent grains. Here, inspired by research in the tribology community, we present an alternative, fundamentally different framework, termed surface-roughness-based DEM (SR-DEM), in which contact friction is handled in a more physics-based manner. In this framework, instead of using a friction law, we explicitly resolve the surface topography of each grain and let friction emerge from collective frictionless interactions of surface asperities. In essence, we trade phenomenology for physics at the cost of an increased computational demand. To mitigate the cost, we introduce an FE$^2$-like algorithm and a feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM)-based neural network surrogate, both of which are parallelized on GPU to accelerate contact computation. Crucially, using this framework in 2D, we (1) demonstrate the possibility of recovering a two-body-based Amontons-Coulomb-type friction behavior using a simple representation of surface topography, and (2) identify many-body-based frictional behaviors--more specifically, the angle of repose values--that cannot always be captured by current DEM frameworks under the same level of model complexity. We conclude by discussing future directions for SR-DEM, as well as exciting new opportunities it could unlock for a wide range of emerging applications, including (designing) suspension rheology and metamaterial mechanics.

AI.tldr: 提出表面粗糙度驱动的离散元框架 SR-DEM，用显式表面形貌与无摩擦微凸体集体作用替代传统唯象摩擦定律，并用 GPU 并行算法与神经网络代理加速接触计算。
AI.motivation: 现有 DEM 普遍依赖 Amontons-Coulomb 型唯象摩擦律，难以从物理机制层面刻画颗粒摩擦；作者希望以更基于物理的方式处理接触摩擦。
AI.method: SR-DEM 显式解析每个颗粒的表面地形，让摩擦由表面微凸体间的无摩擦集体相互作用涌现；为降低计算成本，引入类 FE^2 算法和 FiLM 神经网络代理，并在 GPU 上并行化接触计算。
AI.result: 在二维中，使用简单表面形貌可重现基于两体相互作用的 Amontons-Coulomb 型摩擦行为；同时识别出基于多体相互作用的摩擦行为，例如休止角，而现有 DEM 在同等模型复杂度下并不总能捕捉这些行为。
AI.conclusion: SR-DEM 以增加计算需求换取物理性，展示了替代唯象摩擦律的潜力，并为悬浮流变学、超材料力学等新兴应用提供新机会。

title: A Differentiable Framework for Inverse Identification of Heterogeneous Cohesive Laws
summary: This work develops a differentiable finite element framework based on an intrinsic cohesive-zone formulation for identifying traction-separation laws from global force-displacement histories and spatially sparse strain measurements. The framework employs physics-constrained neural networks to represent flexible, thermodynamically structured cohesive laws, with sensitivities computed through automatic differentiation and a discrete adjoint that accounts for the history-dependent evolution of interfacial damage. To enable identification of spatially heterogeneous cohesive behavior, we extend learned constitutive priors to irreversible interfacial damage by constructing a shared, low-dimensional family of cohesive laws from representative traction-separation histories. This representation exploits common constitutive structure and parameter sharing to reduce the number of unknowns and regularize the inverse problem, while allowing local cohesive behavior to vary spatially through latent coordinates. Numerical investigations involving double-cantilever beams and fiber-matrix composites demonstrate that accurate reproduction of global force-displacement responses does not necessarily imply accurate recovery of the underlying cohesive laws. Incorporating spatially resolved strain measurements substantially improves constitutive identification, even when the admissible responses are constrained by a learned prior. Comparisons with conventional bilinear cohesive models and Bayesian optimization further illustrate the benefits of the learned constitutive representation and adjoint-based identification for high-dimensional inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于内在黏聚区格式的可微有限元框架，利用全局力-位移历史与稀疏空间应变测量反演牵引-分离律，并通过物理约束神经网络与离散伴随实现历史相关界面损伤下的高维本构识别。
AI.motivation: 传统上仅用全局力-位移响应反演黏聚本构可能存在非唯一性；即使能准确拟合宏观响应，也未必能恢复真实牵引-分离律，因此需要引入空间应变信息并构建可正则化的灵活本构表示。
AI.method: 建立基于内在黏聚区公式的可微有限元框架；用物理约束神经网络表示满足热力学结构的柔性黏聚律；通过自动微分和考虑界面损伤历史演化的离散伴随计算灵敏度；将学习到的本构先验扩展到不可逆界面损伤，构建由代表性牵引-分离历史得到的共享低维黏聚律族，以参数共享减少未知量并正则化反问题，同时用潜坐标允许局部黏聚行为空间变化。
AI.result: 在双悬臂梁与纤维-基体复合材料算例中，准确复现全局力-位移响应并不必然意味着准确恢复底层黏聚律；加入空间分辨应变测量可显著改善本构识别，即使响应受学习先验约束；与传统双线性黏聚模型和贝叶斯优化比较，学习本构表示与伴随法识别在高维反问题中更具优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将可微有限元、物理约束本构表示、离散伴随与稀疏应变测量结合，可更有效地识别空间非均匀且历史相关的牵引-分离律，并强调全局响应拟合不足以保证本构反演准确性。

title: Two-dimensional framework for modeling load transfer in nanocomposites with thin, stiff, and prestressed reinforcements
summary: This paper presents a novel framework for simulating load-transfer mechanisms in nanocomposites reinforced by thin, stiff, and prestressed reinforcements, such as, e.g., nanosheets or nanoplatelets. The reinforcements are modeled as open material surfaces treated as membranes endowed with their own elastic properties and residual surface tension; the matrix is assumed to be isotropic elastic. In the two-dimensional plane-strain setting considered here, each material surface is represented by a sufficiently smooth curve of otherwise arbitrary shape. The theoretical part of the framework is based on the Gurtin--Murdoch theory in which the surfaces are represented by traction jumps across them. The elastic fields in the matrix are exactly expressed by the integral representations written in terms of the unknown traction jumps that are functions of the second-order derivatives of the displacements. The computational part is based on the isogeometric boundary element method (IGABEM) that utilizes non-uniform rational B-splines (NURBS). The unknown traction jumps are found from the numerical solutions of the coupled system of singular boundary integral equations, after which the elastic fields in the matrix are evaluated. The procedure of extracting the values of the stress intensity factors (SIFs) at the tips of the surfaces is described. The proposed algorithm is validated against available benchmark solutions for multiple surfaces located along either straight segments or circular arcs. Selected parametric studies are performed to examine the influence of surface curvatures, relative spacing, orientation, and interactions. An example involving a graphene nanoplatelet-reinforced epoxy is presented.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模拟薄、硬且预应力增强体（如纳米片/纳米板）增强纳米复合材料中载荷传递机制的新框架，结合Gurtin–Murdoch表面弹性理论与等几何边界元法（IGABEM）。
AI.motivation: 需要准确刻画纳米增强体的表面弹性、残余表面张力及任意曲线形状对基体载荷传递和应力场的影响，并处理多增强体间的曲率、间距、取向和相互作用。
AI.method: 将增强体建模为具有自身弹性性质和残余表面张力的开放材料表面/膜，基体为各向同性弹性体；二维平面应变下表面为任意形状的光滑曲线。基于Gurtin–Murdoch理论以跨表面牵引跳跃表示表面作用，用未知牵引跳跃的积分表示精确表达基体弹性场；采用基于NURBS的IGABEM离散并求解耦合奇异边界积分方程，随后计算基体弹性场，并给出表面端点应力强度因子（SIFs）提取方法。
AI.result: 算法针对沿直线段或圆弧分布的多表面基准解进行了验证；开展了参数研究以考察表面曲率、相对间距、取向及相互作用的影响，并给出了石墨烯纳米片增强环氧树脂的算例。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可有效模拟含薄、硬、预应力纳米增强体的纳米复合材料中的载荷传递与应力集中行为，适用于分析曲率、空间排布和多表面相互作用，并可应用于石墨烯纳米片增强聚合物体系。

title: kstress: a LAMMPS package for calculating the 2D wavevector-dependent stress tensor and its anisotropy in amorphous solids
summary: The stress tensor resolved in wavevector $\qvec$ and time $t$, $\sigma_{\alpha\beta}(\qvec,t)$, gives access to the elastic moduli of amorphous solids as a function of the probed length scale, and to the long-range stress correlations that distinguish an amorphous solid from a liquid. Its evaluation requires the contribution of every interacting pair and therefore an interface to the force loop of the molecular dynamics code. In the current work, we present: i) an optimized implementation of the LAMMPS~\cite{lammps} module for calculating $\sigma_{\alpha\beta}(\qvec,t)$, in which trigonometric functions are calculated only for the basic wavevectors and, in addition, all the relevant wavevectors are supplied as an explicit list rather than generated as a full grid, so that only the wavevectors of interest are computed and stored, and ii) a validation protocol for the code illustrated for a two-dimensional polydisperse Lennard-Jones (2DpLJ) glass-forming liquid. Based on these technical achievements we elucidated how the affine moduli for the 2DpLJ model depend on the norm $q$ of the wavevector. In particular, we demonstrate that the longitudinal affine modulus shows a minimum near $q_\text{max}$ corresponding to the main peak of the structure factor. Our data also point to the peaks in the $q$-dependencies of vibrational frequencies well below $q_\text{max}$ for both transverse and longitudinal modes. The potential relevance of this feature to the ``boson peak'' is discussed as well.

AI.tldr: 该文优化了LAMMPS中波矢与时间分辨应力张量σ_αβ(q,t)的计算，并在二维多分散Lennard-Jones玻璃形成液体上验证，进而揭示仿射模量和振动频率的波矢依赖及其与玻色峰的可能联系。
AI.motivation: σ_αβ(q,t)可用于获得非晶固体中随探测长度尺度变化的弹性模量以及区分非晶固体与液体的长程应力关联，但其计算需要每个相互作用对的贡献并接入分子动力学代码的力循环，因此需要高效实现与验证方案。
AI.method: 提出优化的LAMMPS模块实现：三角函数仅对基本波矢计算，并将相关波矢以显式列表提供而非生成完整网格，从而只计算和存储感兴趣的波矢；同时给出用于二维多分散Lennard-Jones玻璃形成液体的代码验证流程。
AI.result: 基于该实现阐明了2DpLJ模型中仿射模量对波矢模长q的依赖：纵向仿射模量在对应结构因子主峰的q_max附近出现最小值；横向和纵向振动频率的q依赖峰均远低于q_max；并讨论了该特征与玻色峰的潜在相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了高效且可验证的σ_αβ(q,t)计算工具，并揭示了非晶玻璃中尺度依赖的弹性模量与振动频率特征，为理解玻色峰等非晶固体动力学现象提供了线索。

title: A GPU-efficient local ADER finite-difference method for compressible-flow DNS
summary: Algorithm design tailored to graphics processing units (GPUs) can substantially improve the efficiency of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations. Efforts to adapt CFD solvers to GPUs often focus on spatial discretization, while time advancement commonly relies on multistage Runge--Kutta (RK) methods. However, these RK methods require repeated residual evaluations and full-domain operations, increasing the cost of compressible-flow direct numerical simulation (DNS). To reduce this overhead, we develop a local arbitrary high-order derivatives (ADER) finite-difference method that couples a compact ten-point quadratic predictor to a conservative central corrector through operator matching. With two quadrature nodes, one Picard correction, and selective dissipation, smooth convective tests recover third-order convergence under fixed-CFL refinement and near-seventh-order spatial behavior when background spatial error dominates. Temporal states remain kernel-local, and halo communication overlaps interior computation. Tests of smooth advection, periodic turbulence, and wall-bounded flows assess accuracy and flow statistics. On a $302^3$-node viscous Taylor--Green benchmark without heat conduction, throughput reaches 230.87 million node updates per second on one V100 GPU in double precision, 1.944 times that of spatially matched three-stage Runge--Kutta integration. Weak-scaling efficiency reaches 99.44\% from 4 to 32 V100 GPUs at 1.812 billion nodes.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种面向GPU的局部ADER有限差分方法，用紧凑十点二次预测器与守恒中心校正器通过算子匹配耦合，减少多级Runge-Kutta时间推进中重复残差评估和全域操作的开销，从而提升可压缩流DNS在GPU上的效率。
AI.motivation: GPU上的CFD算法优化多集中于空间离散，而时间推进常依赖多级Runge-Kutta方法；后者需要反复计算残差并执行全域操作，给可压缩流直接数值模拟带来显著额外成本。
AI.method: 开发局部任意高阶导数ADER有限差分格式：将紧凑十点二次预测器与守恒中心校正器通过算子匹配耦合；采用两个求积节点、一次Picard校正和选择性耗散；时间状态保持核内局部，并将halo通信与内部计算重叠。

title: Towards Exact Multidimensional Fluxes: A Structure-Preserving Data-Informed Framework for Riemann Solvers
summary:
Finite-volume and discontinuous Galerkin methods update cells using the space-time flux integral over their faces, which typically depends on the solutions to local Riemann problems. In the multidimensional Riemann problem setting, this integral is difficult to evaluate exactly because of complex wave interactions. In this work, we show that the exact space-time flux integral is a polynomial in the time step and face dimensions. This motivates a learning-based approach, as only the mapping from the initial states to the polynomial coefficients needs to be learned. We propose a structure-preserving, data-informed Riemann solver framework that uses a neural network trained on high-resolution simulation data to learn this mapping. Key structural properties, including consistency and symmetry, are enforced by construction. Provided that the high-resolution simulations converge to the exact flux integrals and the network accurately predicts the coefficients, this framework yields near-exact flux integrals for use in numerical simulations.
  We demonstrate the framework using classical implosion and explosion problems for the two-dimensional Euler equations. In an unsplit MUSCL-Hancock scheme, the learned Riemann solver remains stable at a CFL number of 0.9, whereas the same scheme using the exact one-dimensional Riemann solver fails. Compared with the latter scheme at CFL=0.45, the learned scheme is slightly more accurate and requires approximately 30% less computational time.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结构保持、数据驱动的多维黎曼求解器：利用神经常网络学习初始状态到时空通量积分多项式系数的映射，并在二维欧拉方程中验证其稳定性与效率。
AI.motivation: 有限体积与间断伽辽金方法依赖面上的时空通量积分，而多维黎曼问题因复杂波相互作用难以精确计算；因此需要一种既能保持结构性质又能提高稳定性和效率的方法。
AI.method: 发现精确时空通量积分是时间步长和面尺寸的多项式，只需学习初始状态到多项式系数的映射；构建数据驱动黎曼求解器，用高分辨率模拟数据训练神经网络，并按构造强制满足一致性和对称性等关键结构性质。

AI.conclusion: 该框架在理论上可在高分辨率模拟收敛且网络准确预测系数时给出近精确通量积分，并在实际算例中展现出更高CFL稳定性、略优精度和显著计算效率。
